articleTitle: A Circularly-Polarized Zhong-Shaped MIMO Antenna with Meta-Materials for WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a circularly-polarized (CP) Zhong-shaped MIMO antenna with meta-materials. One of meta-materials is printed on the side of the patch antennas which can enhance isolation, and another meta-material is suspended on the upper of the patch antennas which can achieve polarization conversion from linear to circular polarization. The simulated results show that the bandwidth of the proposed antenna cover from 2.22 to 2.75 GHz, and the coupling is less than −18 dB. In addition, the designed MIMO antenna has better performance in terms of radiation patterns and CP, which makes it a potential candidate for many practical indoor wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Promoting 5G MIMO Antenna with Isolation Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a single-layer metamaterial (MTM) superstrate is presented to realize the high isolation for a 5G multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna. The metamaterial cell is composed of a layer structure with an improved split-ring and a square metal mesh at different surface, which has been arranged periodically to form a meta-surface structure and placed over a 2-port MIMO antenna with an interval of 2 mm to achieve low coupling. The obtained results show that the created MIMO antenna owns a −10dB impendence bandwidth ranging from 4.77GHz to 5.08 GHz so that it covers the 5G band of 4.8∼5GHz. It also provides a low coupling of −45dB within the operating frequency bands and achieves a peak gain of 7.7dB, which is a suitable candidate for 5G indoor applications.

articleTitle: Research on Arbitrary-Order FDTD Method Based on Face-Centered Cubic Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An iterative formulation of arbitrary-order FDTD method is proposed based on a face-centered cubic (FCC) in this paper. Through the distribution of electromagnetic field nodes in FCC grid, the coefficients of arbitrary-order iterative formulations are theoretically derived. We validate the proposed method by two numerical examples. The results of this studies can provide guidance for the practical application of high-order FCC-FDTD method.

articleTitle: Performance Improved Voltage Controlled Oscillator and Double Balanced Mixer Chip Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This article presents a low-power and layout dimension efficient LC-VCO (voltage-controlled oscillators) and double balanced mixer are designed and implemented in tsmc <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.18\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> COMS 1P6M process for microwave communications applications. The proposed VCO circuit applies PMOS cross-coupled pairs LC circuits. From the sourcing voltage of 0.9 V, the overall VCO total power dissipation of 1.54 mW, and tuning range is 532 MHz from 9.25 to 9.78 GHz. The double balanced mixer proposed converter gain of 8 dB, noise figure of 15.6 dB, IIP3 of −4.6 dBm, input P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1dB</inf> of −1 6dBm. The tuning voltage is from 0 to 0.9V, and chipset core placement with layout optimization is 0.24mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Accurate Modal Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antennas Using Sub-Structure Characteristic Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper explores the application of characteristic modes (CMs) to obtain the modal behaviors of practical microstrip patch antennas with finite extent. Two different types of CMs are applied to compare their differences. We found that the sub-structure CMs lead to more correct modal behaviors of patch antennas with finite substrate and ground plane than full-structure CMs.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Wideband Endfire Antenna with Small Ground Clearance for 5G Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A wideband vertically polarized endfire antenna is presented for 5G millimeter-wave mobile terminals. The antenna is implemented with a single-layer SIW structure and has a small ground clearance of only 2.5 mm. A pair of top-hat dipoles, consisting of metallic disks and vias, are loaded in front of the antenna aperture and partially connected with the SIW structure, which can dramatically improve the impedance matching and stabilize the in-band gain fluctuations. Two matching pins are inserted in the SIW to further broaden the bandwidth. The antenna achieves a −10 dB bandwidth of 25.4%, covering the n257, n258, and n261 bands simultaneously. A <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 4$</tex> endfire antenna array is constructed for beamforming applications. Good beam scanning performances are obtained.

articleTitle: Generation and Manipulation of OAM Beams Using Pancharatnam-Berry Coding Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an approach to generate a circularly polarized (CP) multiple orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams using single-feed reflective metasurface at microwave regime is proposed. The CP multi-OAM beams are generated under planewave illumination via combining different kinds of reflection phase coding sequences and carefully adjusting the phase shift of each meta-atom across the metasurface aperture which is fed by a single CP horn antenna. The conventional OAM coding phase sequence is generated first and then combined with a focusing phase sequence to reduce the divergence angle and improve the gain. After that a chessboard coding sequence (0101/1010….) is applied across the metasurface aperture to obtain 4 CP OAM beams. A polarization-insensitive PB meta-atoms are used to construct the proposed metasurface. The multiple beams are investigated by means of full-wave simulations. Currently, a prototype of the proposed metasurface is being fabricated and measured in an anechoic chamber and the measured results will be presented during the conference.

articleTitle: Tunable milimiterwave equalizer based on folded substrate integrated waveguide
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a tunable milimiterwave equalizer is proposed, which is mainly composed of a microstrip through line and folded substrate integrated waveguide (FSIW) resonant cavities. The physical mechanism of the FSIW equalizer is analyzed in detail. The amplitude responses can be tuned by adjusting the depth of the screws into the cavities or pushing/pulling the metal layer in FSIW. The full-wave simulation results demonstrate that the broadband equalizer has a gain control of about 12 dB in the frequency band of 29 ∼ 34 GHz, while the volume is only one-half of the conventional SIW equalizer.

articleTitle: Heatmap-Based Multiple Co-Channel Transmitter Localization with Fully Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a novel method based on deep learning for localizing multiple co-channel transmitters in complex electromagnetic (EM) environment is proposed, which can be applied in scenario with uncertainty about transmitters and propagation model parameters. The proposed method called HMTLNet, formulate the localization of multiple transmitters as a heatmap regression problem based on fully convolutional network. A representative numerical example considering dense urban scenario is discussed to demonstrate that compared to DeepTxFinder, which also leverages deep learning, the proposed method is more simplified, requiring only one network to localize multiple co-channel transmitters, while DeepTxFinder requires at least as many networks as the number of transmitters. And the localization performance is better when the sensor density is high than 0.1%.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Filtering Dielectric Resonator Antenna With High Selectivity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A highly selective filtering dielectric resonator antenna (FDRA) is proposed to fuse the filter and antenna. The microstrip slot structure is used to feed FDRA which excite the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">111</inf> and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">311</inf> modes, and achieve dual-band radiation. Then four radiation nulls are introduced to achieve high selectivity. And two radiation nulls at the edge of the passband are generated by adjusting the length of the microstrip line. In the higher frequency band, the electric field of TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">311</inf> mode is opposite to the electric field of the feed slot to produce an additional radiation null, which further increases the roll-off date. In addition, by introducing a folded V-shaped defect ground structure (DGS), a radiation null is introduced between the two radiation frequency bands to improve the suppression level between them. The simulation results show that the proposed FDRA has good dual-frequency radiation performance and high out-of-band suppression.

articleTitle: RCS prediction of polygonal metal plate based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a method based on machine learning and physical optics (PO) is proposed to accurately predict the monostatic radar cross section (RCS) of a polygonal metal plate. We use the PO method to calculate the RCS of the target, and then use the neural network to correct the result. By comparing the RCS calculated by the method of moments (MOM), our algorithm can accurately obtain the RCS of the target at different frequencies and different angles.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Wideband Gysel Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a novel design method of wideband Gysel power divider (GPD) is presented. The detailed design procedure of this mothed can expand the bandwidth by solving specific equations of frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{m}$</tex>. For verification, a GPD operating at 2 GHz has been designed, fabricated and measured. The measured results exhibit the novel low-insertion-Ioss GPD has 15 dB input and output return loss bandwidth 50%, and the isolation bandwidth 65%, which agreement with simulated results well and indicate the validity of the proposed strategies.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Scattering Distribution Function for Rough Surface in SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the rapid development of high-resolution synthetic aperture radar (SAR) in spaceborne remote sensing and ground-based applications, SAR as a microwave imaging device could easily acquire images of decimeter to centimeter resolution showing the texture features of rough surface, and facilitate the image texture modeling to better interpret the underlying mechanism. Conventional analytical scattering models for rough surface are tailored for non-imaging scatterometers and cannot model the SAR image texture of rough surface. Inspired by the bidirectional reflection distribution function (BRDF) of rough surface in computer graphics which is spatially focused, we propose the coherent spatially varying bidirectional scattering distribution function (CSVBSDF) of finite-size rough surface for SAR images. It is analytically derived based on the integral equation model (IEM) model and resembles the spatially varying bidirectional scattering distribution function (SVBSDF). Given roughness parameters of the rough surface, the CSVBSDF can generate a SAR image quickly. Comparison of the scattering coefficient and the SAR image with numerical simulation method show that the proposed model is in good agreement with numerical method.

Author Keywords: coherent spatially varying bidirectional scattering distribution function (CSVBSDF)

articleTitle: A new Wavelet Prediction method for GPR clutter elimination Based on LSTM network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) wavelet greatly affects the inversion results of underground structures. This paper presents a new wavelet extraction method based on the LSTM neural network. The simulation data with FDTD method and the measured data collected by the self-built unmanned aerial vehicle ground penetrating radar (UAV-GPR) are used for test, and the predicted wavelets are almost all offset by the wavelet components of the original data. The results show that the LSTM neural network can effectively predict the wavelets and their tailing oscillations for different detection scenes.

articleTitle: A higher-order mode air-patch antenna with a T-shape feed
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an air-patch antenna operating at quasi-TM21 mode with a wide impedance bandwidth characteristic is proposed. The proposed antenna has a simple configuration, which mainly composed of a radiating patch and a T-probe. After the analysis of cavity model, the electromagnetic coupling point on the rectangular patch is chosen, which inspires a higher-order mode (quasi-TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> mode). Different from the other feed ways, the T-shape feed can supply a wider impedance bandwidth. The proposed antenna achieves a matching bandwidth of 54.9% (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} < 1.5$</tex>) ranging from 1.61 to 2.83 GHz. A prototype has been fabricated and then measured, and the measurement results are in good agreement with the simulated ones.

articleTitle: Design of Ka band Low Noise Amplifier Based on 65nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, A Ka band low noise amplifier (LNA) using techniques of transformer matching and cross-coupling capacitance is designed using 65nm CMOS technology, the operating band covers 28-40GHz. The measured results show that this LNA consumes 14.2 mW under 1V, and high performances are achieved with the gain of 7.1 dB, noise figure(NF) of 5.9 dB, and the input 1dB compression point(P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1dB</inf>) of −2.3 dBm. The chip occupies a silicon area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$320 \mu \mathrm{m}\times 280\, \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Millimeter-Wave Radome with Variable Thickness for Improvement of Radiation Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a variable thickness radome for application in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) radar at missile warhead, so as to figure out the radiation distortion caused by uniform thickness radome (UTR). By choosing a appropriate condition of wall thickness of radome, the adverse effect of field reflection and phase delay on radiation pattern is minimized. Moreover, the radome thickness is further optimized through simulation, by which the ripple variation of main beam is effectively mitigated and radiation pattern become more symmetric. Simulated results show that the radiation performance of the 24-GHz off-center antenna array with our proposed radome has been improved a lot in terms of beam symmetry and broadside gain level.

articleTitle: Fast Calculation of PCB Electromagnetic Radiation Using 1D Boundary Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a one-dimensional boundary integration approach that can efficiently calculate the edge electromagnetic radiation from a printed circuit board (PCB) with a typical stripline excitation. The effect of shielding vias is also considered. The method takes much less time than the conventional numerical method for computation but obtains a perfect agreement with full-wave simulation results.

articleTitle: Failure Diagnosis of Antenna Array Using Residual Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The failure of antenna array elements will lead to the change of far-field pattern, so the failure diagnosis of antenna array can be carried out according to the far-field pattern data. In this paper, a new deep learning method based on residual convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed for antenna array fault diagnosis. Compared with the support vector machine (SVM), the proposed method has good performance in noise environment with different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). As the failure scenarios become more complex, the accuracy of the proposed method is also discussed.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Experiment for Microwave Thorax Imaging Based on One-Step Gauss Newton Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A preliminary experiment for microwave thorax imaging is conducted. A low-profile symmetrical meandering dipole antenna operating at 915MHz is designed and a rectangular water tank with 16 antennas is built for experiments. A graduated cylinder is placed in water as a target. Each antenna in turn acts as transmitter and the others work as receivers. Transmission coefficients are measured. With One-Step Gauss Newton Method, the size and position of the target can be reconstructed. The experiment results verify the feasibility of microwave thorax imaging.

articleTitle: Design of SIW-Based W-Band Magnetoelectric Dipole Antenna for Active Phased Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel magnetoelectric (ME) dipole antenna in W-band based on SIW has been proposed and demonstrated in this article. This antenna is composed of an H-shaped slot which acts as magneto dipole and four patches with corner cut which act as electric dipoles. It retains broadband characters of the ME dipole antenna while also shows additional low transmission loss features of the SIW feed structure. A broad bandwidth covering 87.5-110 GHz with voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) less than 2 is achieved and a radiation gain of 8.2 dB with a variation less than 0.25 dB is obtained. A low backward radiation is realized and a low cross-polarization is also achieved. What's more, a wide scanning performance in H-plane is also observed. We are convinced that our proposed ME dipole antenna has potential application in areas such as mmW wide angle scanning radar and 5G wireless communication in the future.

articleTitle: Investigate Magnetized Graphene-based FSS with Split Field HIE-FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, we apply our recently developed stability improved HIE-FDTD method to study the characteristics of graphene-based structures. The split field method is used to calculate the anisotropic properties of the graphene. Both the electrostatic and magnetostatic field biased graphene-based frequency selective surface (GFSS) is studied. We find that, for the same biased electrostatic field, the minimum transmission coefficient also remains the same for different biased magnetostatic field. Additionally, the stop band can be adjusted by the different biased electrostatic field.

articleTitle: Efficient Solution of Wideband RCS Using Wideband Characteristic Mode Basis Function Method With Impedance Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient method for wideband radar cross section (RCS) calculation is proposed in this paper. In this method, the characteristic modes (CMs) extracted at the highest frequency are used as wideband basis functions to compute the broadband RCS. During this process, an interpolation method is adopted to accelerate the generation of original impedance matrix. Compared with the convenient method of moment (MoM), the proposed method is more efficient as it reduces the dimension of the impedance matrix at each operation frequency. Numerical results of perfectly electric conducting (PEC) models are demonstrated to validate the accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Compact Coplanar Vivaldi Antenna with L-shaped Slotline
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A compact coplanar Vivaldi antenna with L-shaped slotline is presented. The L-shaped slotline consists of the exponential tapered slot and a linear slotline. The linear slotline is utilized to replace the circular cavity in traditional coplanar Vivaldi antenna and acts as open circuit to provide a good impedance match for low frequencies. The simulated results indicate that the demonstrated compact geometry can achieve the miniaturization of the antenna which is commonly realized by loading high resistance in the past, and the E-plane width of the antenna is just about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.26\lambda_{0}$</tex> at the minimum frequency, without any loading.

articleTitle: Image Reconstruction of Electrical Impedance Tomography Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Image reconstruction is a key step in electrical impedance tomography (EIT). The inverse problem of EIT is a nonlinear, highly morbid and under-qualitative problem, the resolution of EIT image reconstructed by traditional methods is relatively low. In order to apply electrical impedance tomography to practice successfully, it is urgent to find an effective image reconstruction algorithm. After the advantage of deep learning in self-learning nonlinear mapping between input and output was found, it was used in electrical impedance tomography image reconstruction. In this paper, convolution neural network (CNN) is used to solve the problem of image reconstruction. The data set and the 16-electrode EIT model are obtained through the joint simulation of MATLAB and COMSOL. The data set is divided into training set and test set, and the expected result is obtained after training the network.

articleTitle: Design of an X-band TR module based on SICL
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An X-band four-channel T/R module is designed and fabricated based on SICL(Substrate Integrated Coaxial Line). The module's transmitting channel has high gain and high power and the RF signal is transmitted through SICL to reduce signal leakage. Combined with the method of metal frame, it decreases the crosstalk between the input and output ports of transmitting channel, enhances the signal shielding ability, and reduces the risk of self excitation. Test results show that the dimension of the TR module is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$110\text{mm}^{\ast}80\text{mm}^{\ast}10\text{mm}$</tex>, with transmitting power ≥ 35W, receiving gain >35dB, noise figure < 3dB, phase consistency ≤± 15 ° and gain consistency ≤ 1dB.

articleTitle: Application of Ray-Tracing Method in Electromagnetic Numerical Simulation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Several methods are proposed to accelerate the calculation of RCS (radar cross section), and integrate shooting and bouncing rays-physical optics (SBR-PO) methods into graphics processing unit (GPU). The SBR-PO method is used to solve the multiple reflection behavior of electromagnetic waves on the target model, and the scattered field is calculated by PO integral. The ray tracing engine OptiX and the Unified Computing Architecture (CUDA) are used to reduce the calculation time of the SBR-PO method and improve the calculation efficiency of RCS. Compare the results calculated by the SBR-PO method with the results calculated by the commercial software FEKO. The results fully demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of integrating the SBR-PO method into OptiX and GPU.

articleTitle: Wide-band L/X Dual-Band Share-aperture Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a Wide-band L/X dual-band share-aperture phased array antenna is proposed. The L-band element is cavity-backed slot antenna, and for X-band, slot antenna is used. Simulated results show that the operating bandwidth of proposed antenna is 7.5 to 12.5 GHz in X-band and 1.7 to 2.1 GHz in L band, indicating a wide-band performance. In addition, the X-band antenna can scan up to ± 45° in E plane. Meanwhile, two different feeding structures are used to feed the X-band antenna to avoid the cavity of the L-band antenna. The polarization direction of the antennas in two frequency bands can be orthogonal or parallel according to these structures.

articleTitle: A Low-RCS Parabolic Reflector Antenna using Absorptive Frequency-Selective Reflector
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a parabolic reflector antenna using absorptive frequency-selective reflector (AFSR), resulting in both high-gain and low out-of-band radar cross-section (RCS) performance. The AFSR structure consists of two stepped-impedance resonators (SIRs) with lumped resistors, achieving a reflection band from 7.34 GHz to 8.47 GHz with two absorption bands from 2.5 GHz to 5.7 GHz and 9.4 GHz to 13.9 GHz, respectively. Based on the proposed AFSR structure, a parabolic reflector antenna prototype is designed, which exhibits a realized gain of 19.1 dB at 8 GHz, corresponding to an aperture efficiency of 43%. Meanwhile, the proposed structure achieves an out-of-band RCS reduction around 10 dBsm ranging from 2.7 GHz to 5.6 GHz and 9.7 GHz to 13.6 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Joint Inversion of Audio-Magnetotelluric and Seismic Travel Time Data Using Attribute Fusion Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We propose a deep learning scheme to assist joint inversion of audio-magnetotelluric(AMT) and seismic travel time data. A deep convolutional neural network is designed to fuse the separately inverted multi-physics models. An implicit relationship between inverted and true models can be established. During the inversion, the reconstruction resistivity and velocity models are updated with the Gauss-Newton method, based on the references generated by the trained neural network. Compared with separate inversion, this scheme can automatically incorporate interpretation knowledge into inversion with the help of deep learning. Numerical experiments show that it can achieve better inversion accuracy compared with separate inversion.

articleTitle: U-Net Conjugate Gradient Solution of Electromagnetic Scattering From Dielectric Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A deep learning-based method is developed to solve electromagnetic scattering problems, where the U-Net is combined with the conjugate gradient method (U-Net-CG). Numerical results show that the U-Net-CG outperforms the traditional CG in terms of computational speed under the comparable accuracy.

articleTitle: On the Investigation of Triangular Interpolation-based Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The efficiency of the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MFLMA) is improved by using the triangular interpolation instead of the commonly used Lagrange interpolation. For pth-degree interpolation, the data points used for the triangular interpolation are only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(p+2)/(2p + 2)$</tex> of the Lagrange interpolation, while the interpolation accuracy is in the same order. Numerical results of electromagnetic scattering from conducting sphere are shown to illustrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Motion Targets Identification for Bistatic Through-the-wall Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An effective motion targets recognition method for bistatic through-the-wall radar is proposed. First, the dual-threshold detection is performed to the range profile, with a power threshold to find the desired motion target reflection and another width threshold to remove narrow glitches imposed by noise and clutter. Second, the centroid of the range profile data within the time window is calculated to separate multiple motion targets. Finally, a smooth filter is design to obtain the accurate number of targets. Experiments are conducted to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Proposal and Synthesis Design of Multi-band Filtering Power Dividers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A direct synthesis design technique of multi-band filtering power dividers (FPDs) with high frequency selectivity is proposed, which is promising in both industrial and academic field. After a set of complete closed-form analytical equations are established for direct synthesis design, the proposed method is intensively described to reveal its powerful capacity in design of a multi-band FPD with any pre-specified responses, high multiband isolations and matching. To validate this design concept, a demonstrator triple-band microstrip FPD has been designed, fabricated, measured. What's more, a triple-band three-way FPD with 90° port-to-port phase differences as an extended example of the synthesis design technique has also been implemented, which furtherly shows the flexibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Conformal LOD-FDTD Method for Accurate Transisent Electromagnetic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: As we all know, the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method suffers obvious staircase error and courant-friedrich-levy (CFL) condition. We proposed a conformal locally one-dimensional (LOD-FDTD) method which can be applied in three-dimensional simulations and is still unconditionally stable to overcome these two issues in the traditional FDTD method. This method takes the partially filled cells into consideration to accurately model the perfectly electrical conductor (PEC) objects and allows time steps beyond the CFL condition. Unlike the traditional conformal FDTD methods, in which time steps have to be reduced to guarantee the stability, the proposed method still has unconditional stability without compromising the accuracy. Its accuracy is validated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: A Compact Dual-Band Linearly Polarized Shared-Aperture Base Station Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A dual-band linear polarization shared-aperture base station antenna with a compact size is presented, which consists of a lower-band linearly-polarized antenna working in 824-960MHz and an upper-band dual-linearly-polarized antenna working in 1710-2690MHz. The shared-aperture antenna is arranged in a three-dimensional stack distribution, where the low-frequency antenna adopts the microstrip patch and the high-frequency one adopts the planer printed dipole. The simulated results show that the proposed shared-aperture antenna covers the frequency bands from 824 to 960MHz and from 1710 to 2690MHz with a good isolation between its ports(20dB). The simulated gain is above 5.77dBi and 5.87dBi for lower and upper band, respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation of Active Millimeter Wave Imaging in Human Security
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In human security, active millimeter wave imaging system has high sensitivity and is not easily affected by the environment. In this paper, the ray propagation theory of millimeter wave in lossy medium is introduced, the multiple scattering model is established, and the basic idea of active imaging simulation by using shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) method is given. In order to improve the efficiency of computation, GPU parallel technology is used to accelerate. Finally, the two-dimensional image of human body with a metal pistol in typical security scene is given.

articleTitle: Exploiting High-Isolation 2nd-Harmonic Backscatters for Distance-Adaptive Microwave Power Delivery
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Microwave power delivery always suffers unknown distances between transmitting (TX) and receiving (TX) antennas. To smooth away such problem, 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> harmonics generated from a rectifier approaching its voltage compression output (breakdown) are exploited. Meanwhile, with an integration of a modified ring coupler and a dual-linearly-polarized antenna, the fundamental incidences and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> harmonics can be highly isolated by different channels. Theoretical analysis as well as some experiment results has validated this proposed novel technique for distance-adaptive microwave power delivery.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Leaky-Wave Antenna Based on Half-Mode Bent Corrugated SIW Structure with Fixed-Frequency Beam-Scanning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a reconfigurable leaky wave antenna (LWA) that can alter the main beam angle at a fixed frequency. To further realize the miniaturization of the LWA, a half-mode bent corrugated substrate integrated waveguide (HM-BCSIW) is applied in this design. Equivalent circuit parameters of the antenna are adjusted by loading varactor diodes, which enable beam scanning at a fixed frequency of 5.7GHz. The radiation angle of the design varies from +55° to −27° continuously, along with a biasing voltage from 2 V to 18 V.

articleTitle: A Lagrange Interpolation Scheme Combined with Generalized Transition Matrix Method for Periodic Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient impedance matrix interpolation scheme is proposed for frequency sweeping. The cubic Lagrange interpolation method is combined with the generalized transition method (GTM). Due to the advantages of the GTM, this interpolation scheme is suitable for handling wideband problems in periodic array. Numerical examples illustrate the validity and great efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Conformal Ultra-Wideband Tightly Coupled Arrays With Low-Scattering Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A practical implementation of low-scattering and ultra-wideband conformal arrays is presented in this paper, where the proposed array is completely attached to the curved surface of a wing platform. The designed array enables to operate in the band of 0.5 — 2.0 GHz when scanning up to 0° and ±45°. As compared to the reference metal ground, the scattering of the proposed array is significantly reduced covering the band from 6.0 to 18.0 GHz. The profile height of the proposed conformal array is only about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.31\ \lambda_{\text{high}}$</tex>.

articleTitle: High-Gain Magnetic Dipole Antenna by Loading Metalmaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a high-gain magnetic dipole patch antenna with vertical polarization is proposed. The gain enhancement is achieved by loading with a row of vertical I-shaped resonator (VISR) unit in the endfire direction. The effect of VISR on antenna gain enhancement is analyzed by extracting electromagnetic parameters of VISR unit. Finally, the simulation results of loaded VISR antenna and unloaded one are compared to verify analysis. The simulation results show that the gain of the proposed high-gain magnetic dipole antenna is about 2.5-3.5dB higher than unload one across 6.29-6.65GHz.

articleTitle: An Improved SBR-based 3-D Scattering Center Modeling Algorithm for Wideband RCS Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes an improved three-dimensional (3-D) scattering center (SC) modeling algorithm using the shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) technique to achieve high precision with relatively low time consumption and memory footprint. The scattering center model (SCM) efficiently established by the improved algorithm can be applied to realize effective wideband radar cross section (RCS) reconstruction. To demonstrate the RCS reconstruction performance of the proposed algorithm, the numerical simulations of two realistic targets are finally presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Error Control in Method of Moments for Electromagnetic Scattering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We proposed an adaptive error control approach in the method of moment (MOM) for the electromagnetic scattering analysis. In the proposed approach, an adaptive procedure is used to gradually refine meshes until convergent results are obtained. The relative coarse meshes are applied for initial numerical solutions at the beginning of the adaptive procedure. Then, meshes are refined and the normalized standard deviation (STD) between current and previous solutions is used to measure the accuracy. If the STD satisfies the pre-defined threshold, the adaptive procedure stops and convergent results are obtained. Two numerical examples including an airplane and a large ship are carried out to validate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Design of Millimeter Waveband Lens Antenna to Improve Gain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper studied the application of quasi-conformal transformation optics (QCTO) theory to millimeter wave terminal lens antennas, cylindrical Luneburg lens theory and QCTO theory are combined to design an anamorphic lens. The deformed lens meets the antenna's requirement of miniaturization and is easy to install. Coordinate transformation is performed by using COMSOL Multiphysics to calculate the relative permittivity distribution of the lens. In order to simplify the design and facilitate the processing, the lens was effectively approximated and discrete. The ANSYS HFSS simulation software is used to simulate the array antenna loaded with discrete and sparse lenses. The results show that the QCTO anamorphic lens can significantly improve the gain of the millimeter wave array antenna under dual-frequency and dual-polarization.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Velocity MTD Based on Ku-band Circular VideoSAR System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Video synthetic aperture radar (VideoSAR) is extensively utilized profiting from the characterization of ground object via sequential imageries. In this paper, we investigate the machine learning-based moving target detection (MTD) with defocusing component in 360-degree Ku-band VideoSAR proposal, notably for ultra-low velocity circumstances. The low-rank plus sparse decomposition scheme, i.e., three-term decomposition with proximal exchange-based alternating directions method of multipliers, is additionally exploited for acquiring the defocusing component in single-channel single-pass circumstance. Experiments are carried on real airborne Ku-band data to confirm the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence Factors of the Monocone Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to reduce the end reflection of the monocone, the influence of cooper bar radius and resistance value on electric fields were analyzed using genetic algorithm. The waveforms of electric fields were compared before and after optimization both using the Gaussian pulse and HEMP pulse as the excitation pulse source. The results show that when the excitation source is Gaussian pulse, the optimized return loss is less than −30 dB in the full frequency range; when the excitation source is HEMP pulse, within pulse width, the maximum of reflection electric field reduced by a factor of 1 compared with the monocone before optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Bistatic Electromagnetic Scattering of Surge and Sea Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper introduces GFBM (generalized forward and backward iterative method) which is used to calculate the bistatic electromagnetic scattering of surge and the sea surface, and discusses the influence of the polarization, wind speed, incident angle and incident frequency on the bistatic electromagnetic scattering which can be applied to the research of radar guidance and target recognition on the sea surface.

articleTitle: A Novel 3D On-Chip Bandpass Filter for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To further reduce the size of integrated passive devices, a bandpass filter based on three-dimensional integrated passive technology is introduced, which has the characteristics of small size, ultra-wide stopband and high rejection. The proposed filter selects the appropriate topology and cleverly designs three vertical transition structures to complete the three-dimensional transmission of signals, thus realizing the expansion of integrated passive devices from plane to three-dimensional. According to the simulation results, its size is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.273\text{mm}^{\ast}1.033\text{mm}^{\ast}0.28\text{mm}$</tex>. The centre frequency of the proposed filter is 2.8 GHz, and its rejection on both sides of the passband is more than 40 dB. What's more, the upper stopband ranges from 3.25GHz to 31.8GHz below 30dB.

articleTitle: A Time Modulated Antenna Array with Phase Modulation Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new harmonic beam-forming method for time modulated antenna array (TMAA) with phase modulation (PM) waveforms. The design of PM waveforms is optimization-free and can accomplish full range phase and amplitude weighting independently. After theoretical analysis, the time modulator under the control of proposed PM waveform has 100% feeding network efficiency and 94.96% overall efficiency.

articleTitle: A Cassegrain antenna design for terahertz focal plane imaging system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A Cassegrain antenna for terahertz focal plane imaging system is proposed in the article. The antenna is designed according to the actual requirements of the THz detector feeds. The antenna is simulated by using CST. The simulation results show good performance with the gain of 56 dBi and the 3 dB bandwidth of 0.26° at 340 GHz. When the feed offset reached maximum at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\delta=15\text{mm}$</tex>, the antenna gain is 54.3dBi. And when the feed is defocused by 1mm laterally, the beam pointing deflection is about 0.12°.

articleTitle: A Novel In-Band Scattering Cancellation Technique for Vivaldi Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a novel technique based on a chessboard artificial magnetic conductor (AMC) surface with 180° reflection phase difference is developed to reduce the inband scattering level of Vivaldi antenna arrays. Owing to the designed AMC chessboard, an average of 5-10 dB in-band monostatic RCS reduction is realized while the radiation performance of the 6-18 GHz Vivaldi phased array with ±60° scanning range in E-/H-plane is preserved. It demonstrates the effectiveness of the in-band scattering technique for both normal and oblique incident waves with HH/VV polarized scattering.

articleTitle: Five-coil Wireless Charging Structure with Radiated Slots in UAVs for Mutual Inductance Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes an optimized scheme using radiated slots for the coupling structure. The proposed structure can reduce the coupling between the coils and improve charging efficiency in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV). The coupling structure of four transmitting coils and a single receiving coil is designed and simulated by finite element method. The final results verify the correctness and feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: Microwave Inverse Scattering Imaging system: Calibration of Theoretical and Measured Scattered Field Values
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, the microwave inverse scattering imaging system as applied in the medical imaging is studied. Two methods are used to obtain the scattered field data, i.e., the method of MoMents (MoM) is used to solve the theoretical value of the scene, and the finite different time-domain (FDTD) method is used to simulate the whole imaging system, which can be seen as a semi-real measurement data. After calibration, the amplitude and phase of the data obtained by the two methods are in good agreement, which indicates the accuracy of the proposed system. Finally, reconstruction results using both data has shown the effectiveness of the imaging measurement system.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna with Fluid Medium
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to meet the needs of special installation occasions, a liquid antenna is designed. It is constructed by the flexible materials and used the fluid medium as radiator. We consider the antenna with reconstructed and dual-band properties. The water is as main experiment medium for convenience. Designed antenna can be applied to the 5G frequency band of 4.8 GHz - 5 GHz and the WLAN frequency band of 5.8 GHz. Compared to traditional solid antennas, the shape of the designed antenna can be changed in form at any time according to the requirements.

articleTitle: Application of an Improved Nearest Neighbor Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In radar data processing, this paper proposes an improved nearest neighbor method. The plots to be screened that fall into the relevant wave gate should not only meet the minimum statistical distance, but also meet the requirement that their amplitude value is closest to the average value of the target track amplitude. Finally, through practical engineering applications, it is found that the improved algorithm can greatly improve the existing problems of the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of A X-band Miniaturized Power Divider Using the Silicon-based IPD Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A miniaturized power divider is designed using the silicon-based integrated passive device (IPD) process. By replacing the quarter-wavelength transmission line in a conventional Wilkinson power divider with bridged-tee network (BTN), the circuit size can be greatly reduced under the premise of ensuring performance. Specifically, a miniaturized power divider with 12 dB return loss bandwidth from 8 to 12 GHz can be designed at the center frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{o}= 10$</tex> GHz of X-band. The circuit size is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.4 \times 0.8\ mm^{2}$</tex>, which is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.047\lambda_{0}\times 0.027\lambda_{0}$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Dual-Band Co-Aperture Monopole Antenna Based on Cross-Layer Folded Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a dual-band co-aperture monopolar antenna with a very low profile. A novel cross-layer folded structure is first constructed to radiate in the lower band. Meanwhile, it provides enough space for another higher-band section. Then, a via-loaded circular patch is added to the reserved space, and the dual-band co-aperture antenna with independent band performance is obtained. By employing two pairs of similar modes in the two bands, the proposed antenna achieves a relatively large bandwidth of 10.9% in the lower band and 14.6% in the upper band with a thickness of 3.14 mm. Stable conical beam are achieved within both bands and the gains in the lower and upper bands are 5.2-5.8 and 3.7-5 dBi, respectively.

articleTitle: A Broadband Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna with a Novel Feeding Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel feeding mechanism has been proposed to feed the magneto-electric dipole for achieving a broad bandwidth. The antenna consists of an electric dipole, a pair of patches vertically shorted to the ground plane, a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Gamma$</tex>-shaped feeding strip and a ground plane. A rectangular patch is removed from the edge of each arm for the electric dipole and the shorted patches are horizontally folded. The feeding structure is regarded as a CPW by locating the feeding point in a straight line with the edge of the shorted patch. Compared with traditional magneto-electric dipoles, a broader bandwidth has been obtained due to the feeding mechanism. The obtained frequency band (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} \leq 2$</tex>) is from 1.04 to 3.1GHz. Moreover, the antenna has characteristics of stable radiation patterns and low cross-polarization level.

articleTitle: Design of a novel compact microstrip interdigital filter based on aggressive space mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, a compact embedded interdigital filter with six novel resonators and coplanar waveguide feeder is proposed. The novel resonator consists of a through silicon via and a microstrip line embedded in the substrate. The novel embedded interdigital filter is designed on a double-sided polished silicon wafer and optimized using aggressive space mapping. The center frequency of the filer is 5.9 GHz and the fractional 1 dB bandwidth is 33.9% (4.9-6.9 GHz). The insertion loss (IL) of the proposed filter is − 0.7 dB, and the return loss (RL) is −24 dbs. The proposed filter with a size of 4.5 mm X 6.5 mm has been verified in full-wave simulator HFSS, which can be mass-produced using MEMS technology.

articleTitle: An Angularly Stable Broadband Reflective Polarization Conversion Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient reflective cross-polarization-conversion (CPC) metasurface is proposed and investigated in this paper. The unit cell consists of a square spilt-ring-resonator and a small metal cross inside, which designed on a Rogers-5880 dielectric layer and backed by a copper ground plane. The simulation results show that the CPC metasurface can realize a high cross-polarization conversion ratio as high as above 90% within a broadband range from 5.36GHz to 11.12GHz for normal incidence (the relative working frequency bandwidth is 70%). Besides, its broadband polarization conversion performances can also be kept well within a wide oblique incident angle even to 45°. The studies can find a wide application prospect in the field of microwave devices.

articleTitle: Analysis of Numerical Dispersion with Time Step for FDTD(2,2) and FDTD(2,4) Method on Face-Centered Cubic Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the study focus on the FDTD(2,2) and (2,4) methods based on the face-centered cubic (FCC). We analyze the influence of time step on the numerical dispersion of both methods has been analyzed, respectively. For the FCC-FDTD(2,2) method, numerical calculation result shows that the maximum time step defined by the Courant-Friedrichs-Levy (CFL) condition is the optimal time step to minimize the numerical dispersion in the constant spatial steps. On the contrary, with the time step approaches the CFL condition, the numerical dispersion in FCC-FDTD(2,4) method gradually decreases and then improves. The conclusion can be used to select the appropriate time step to improve the calculation accuracy of the FCC-FDTD method.

articleTitle: Feature-based Surrogate-assisted Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm for Microwave Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a feature-based surrogate-assisted Harris hawks optimization (FBSAHHO) algorithm for microwave filters. The method is constructed in three steps. Firstly, the vector fitting technology is used to extract the features (parameters of a transfer function) of the electromagnetic (EM) responses. Secondly, artificial neural networks are trained to establish the relationship between design parameters and the extracted features. Thirdly, a surrogate is generated using the filter frequency responses recovered by substituting obtained features into the transfer function. Lastly, Harris hawks optimization algorithm is adopted to find optimal solutions using the surrogate,. A fourth-order coaxial cavity filter is used to verify the proposed method. Combining Harris hawks optimization with surrogate-assisted modeling algorithm demonstrates faster and better convergence than other surrogate-assisted and direct optimization algorithms for filter design.

articleTitle: Broadband Flat-Gain Transmitarray
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work, an X-band flat-gain transmitarray (FGT) antenna is proposed and investigated. The designed FGT is able to provide reliability, compactness and broadband characteristics with high efficiency. The transmitarray consists of multilayer stacked patch cells, which can transmit electromagnetic waves from one side and then provide proper phase changes controlled by variable lengths of microstrip lines for the outward waves. It owns the feature that the outward wave is of same polarization as the inward wave. The proposed FGT is composed of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10\times 10$</tex> elements covering an area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$150\ \text{mm} \times 150 \text{mm}$</tex> implemented at 10 GHz. The FGT is center-fed by a standard pyramidal horn. Preliminary results show that the proposed FGT provides 61% aperture efficiency at 9.4 GHz with 1-dB gain bandwidth of 9.2–10.9 GHz. An impedance bandwidth is obtained from 8.7 GHz to 12.2 GHz.

articleTitle: Accelerating the Laguerre-Based Finite-Element Method for Transient Thermal Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an efficient approach based on data filtering technique is presented to accelerate the transient thermal simulation with the Laguerre-based finite-element method (LBFEM). Compared with the original method, this approach employs the data filtering technique to achieve the same accuracy with fewer basis functions, thus greatly reducing the computation time. Numerical results demonstrate the accuracy and acceleration effect of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Wireless Synchronized UWB TDoA Positioning System based on IEEE 802.15.4z
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A high-precision TDoA positioning system based on UWB ranging chip of IEEE 802.15.4z protocol is proposed, which could meet demands of autonomous driving. Its performance is tested in underground parking lot, where UWB is widely applicated. This proposed system adopts the method of wireless time synchronization, in which base stations communicate with each other by messages including precise time-of-flight information. Each base station receives, times and sends UWB messages with time stamp information in a tight order. Meanwhile, the mobile stations can calculate their positions using TDoA algorithm by monitoring the messages without interacting to any base station. Experimental result shows that the average root men square error of positioning is less than 10cm, with refresh rate up to 240Hz. Besides, the system capacity is not limited.

articleTitle: A Novel Circular Polarization Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a new design of a carved octagonal star shaped patch antenna is proposed. Compact size, coupling decreasing between antenna elements and wide bandwidth have been taken into consideration. The new design achieves perfect matching to the microstrip feed line impedance which is used to excite the antenna through the control of the reactive loading, achieves size reduction through a via back cavity. The proposed antenna is studied and simulated with HFSS on computer and optimized with carved patch, height of the substrate layer, feed point position, reactive loading, etc.

articleTitle: Design of An Array-fed Multi-beam Reflector Antenna Based On Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to adapt to the development of high integration and multi-function of satellite platform, an array-fed multi-beam reflector antenna is designed in this paper. Based on the radiation pattern feature extraction method, the objective optimization function of genetic algorithm is established. The algorithm can effectively reduce the iteration steps and improve the efficiency of beam optimization. Then, a reflector antenna with 262 feeds and 600 beams is designed and verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Mesh Generation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Deep learning as a core technique in artificial intelligence(AI) has been successfully applied to a variety of fields. Today, deep learning is investigated all possible to be extended to more areas to work efficiently beyond any individual expert with better performance. This communication investigates the possibility to apply deep learning techniques to generate high quality mesh distribution for EM simulations without expert getting involved in the design procedure.

articleTitle: A Non-Radiative Wireless Power Transfer Based on Sparse Quasi-Static Cavity Resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to solve the issue of communication signal blocking in traditional cavity resonance wireless power transfer (CR WPT), a novel sparse quasi-static cavity resonator (QSCR) is proposed in this paper. The sparse QSCR is constructed by metallic strips according to the current path of the CR WPT system and the LC resonance theory. Based on the proposed resonator, a wireless power transfer system is built to simulate the power transfer under sparse metallic cavity environment. The simulation results show that the proposed CR WPT system can deliver power to receiver in nearly any position with the maximum efficiency value of more than 70%. Meanwhile, the proposed cavity resonator makes it possible to communicate with outside world.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband High Power Amplifier Based on Odd Equal Power
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a solid-state powder amplifier with a coverage frequency range of 6∼18GHz is designed. Aiming at the amplifier's high power synthesis design, an odd-equip planar circuit synthesis method is proposed. That is, the power output of 12 GaN ways exceeding 10W is realized by using two-to-one micro-stripe circuit and six to one micro-stripe to achieve continuous wave power output above 70W, of which six odd circuits use multi-stage gradient non-isolated resistance design. The experimental results show that the highest synthesis efficiency is 85% and the maximum output power is over 120W, which meets the design requirements. The design of the power amplifier plays a key role in increasing the effective radiation power of the electromagnetic transmitting system based on multi-beam system.

articleTitle: Design of Beam Forming Network For Satellite-Borne Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, we designed a forward beamforming network for spaceborne phased array, which has the ability of power division and amplification, phase shifting, power adjustment and synthesis of RF signal. Under the control of the wave control unit, the real-time direction adjustment of two beam signals can be realized. The phase-shifting network is controlled by RS422 signal, and the channel phase-shifting accuracy is better than 4.2°, After five digit phase shift compensation, the phase consistency between channels is better than 13°.

articleTitle: 115GHz Low-Cost Oscillator-Integrated Reflectarray
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a low-cost 115 GHz oscillator-integrated folded reflectarray (FRA) for the first time. The oscillator generates a millimeter-wave signal beyond 100 GHz, which is significantly higher than the maximum oscillation frequency (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{\max}\approx 70$</tex> GHz) of the employed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.18\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> CMOS process. Then this oscillator is directly wire-bonded with a wideband antenna to feed the FRA in printed circuit board (PCB). The FRA features high gain to increase the equivalent isotropic radiated power (EIRP) of the transmitter. A quasi-double-arrow-shaped element which is robust for fabrication tolerance, is proposed for polarization rotating and phase compensation. Experimental results show that, the proposed oscillator-integrated FRA has a 9.5 dB EIRP enhancement compared with that of the feed antenna. The proposed oscillator-integrated FRA features low cost, planar structure, and high EIRP without bulky lens.

articleTitle: Forward-Wave 0 dB Directional Coupler Based on Groove Gap Waveguide Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, a broadband forward-wave 0 dB coupler is presented using groove gap waveguide (GWG) technology for high frequency band application. The proposed coupler has a broadband flat 0 dB coupling level and lower return losses around 29GHz. The coupler is designed by two adjacent groove GWG coupled through multi symmetric and uniformly-spaced form of apertures on their common wall. The bandwidth according to 0.8-dB allowance is from 27.1 to 31.5 GHz. In the whole operating band, the maximum coupling level is about 0.2dB. The input return losses and isolation level are more than 10dB within the whole operating frequency band.

articleTitle: A HS-CVX Algorithm for Sparse linear array with low sidelobe pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a harmony search convex optimization algorithm. This algorithm is used to optimize the element positions and element excitation to obtain the pattern of antenna which has low side-lobe. In the case of fixed array aperture, the harmony search algorithm is used to sparse the element spacing, and the convex optimization algorithm is used as the local algorithm to obtain the best excitation. The simulation results show that the proposed method has better peak sidelobe suppression effect.

articleTitle: Research on Boundary Conditions of Near-Far Field Extrapolation Based on FCC-FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper mainly studies the iterative formula of the near field extrapolation of the three-dimensional transient field based on the Huygens' principle under the FCC grid condition. Then, the backward RCS of the metal ball was calculated to verify the correctness of the method based on FCC-FDTD. The calculation accuracy of the method was compared with that of the traditional FDTD method. The results show that the calculation accuracy of the method is higher than that of the traditional FDTD method, which shows the superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Hierarchical LU Direct Solver Based on Higher Order Basis Function
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel Hierarchical (H-) LU decomposition direct solution based on higher order basis function (HOBF) is presented to solve electromagnetic (EM) scattering from electrically large conducting targets. Due to the H-matrix structure, the H-LU fast direct solver can efficiently calculate the inverse of a moment-method matrix. By utilizing a high order geometrical modeling, a HOBF can be defined. Therefore, the number of unknowns can be greatly reduced to further expedite the computation. Numerical results demonstrate that compared with the low order modeling, the proposed method can significantly enhance the computational efficiency of electrically large EM scattering problems.

articleTitle: RCS Recognition Method of Corner Reflectors based on 1D-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: As a device for simulating electromagnetic scattering characteristics, corner reflectors can simulate the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of complex ground and sea targets through the combination of a variety of shapes and sizes of corner reflector structures. This paper proposes a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) model, which can quickly and accurately identify and classify corner reflectors based on the corner reflector RCS. The experimental results show that the 1D-CNN built in this paper can effectively classify the corner reflectors and classify the size between classes on the RCS data sets. The experimental results in this paper provide a theoretical and experimental basis for the subsequent classification and recognition of complex objects composed of multiple corner reflectors based on deep neural networks.

articleTitle: Linear-to-Circular Polarization Converter Based on Transmission Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A broadband transmissive linear-to-circular polarization conversion metamaterial composed of 5-layer “-shaped units was designed, and it was placed directly above the ordinary linear polarization antenna so that the antenna can radiate circular polarization waves. The 3dB axial ratio bandwidth is 11.5GHz-14.5GHz, and the relative axial ratio bandwidth reaches 23%, which proves that the polarization conversion surface has good polarization conversion characteristics.

articleTitle: Millimeter Wave Broadband Microstrip Antenna with Coaxial Feed for Phased Array Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A broadband linearly polarized microstrip is proposed with a coaxial connector feeding. The antenna is fed by slot coupling, through the interaction between the coaxial and the dielectric plate, additional resonance points are introduced, thereby expanding the bandwidth of the antenna. In addition, the use of coaxial feed can easily form an area array and apply it to a large phased array. The simulated antenna −10 dB impedance bandwidth ranges from 24.05 - 32.35 GHz, an antenna is manufactured and tested, and has higher consistency with simulation, which can cover multiple 5G millimeter wave application frequency bands such as n257(26.5 - 29.5 GHz), n258 (24.25 - 27.5 GHz), and n261(27.5 - 28.35 GHz).

articleTitle: Analysis of high power electromagnetic pulse coupling effect of photovoltaic panel by using FDTD method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Photovoltaic energy storage microgrid power generation system is composed of photovoltaic equipment and energy storage equipment. As an important part of photovoltaic storage microgrid power generation system, photovoltaic panels are vulnerable to electromagnetic pulse interference. High power electromagnetic pulse is coupled into the power supply system through photovoltaic panels, which generates induced current and then could cause the serious damage to the photovoltaic energy storage microgrid power generation system. Based on the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method, this paper analyzes the coupling effect of high power electromagnetic pulse to the photovoltaic panel. The damage mechanism of photovoltaic panels are analyzed qualitatively, which could facilitate the study of the electromagnetic protection design of photovoltaic energy storage microgrid power generation system.

articleTitle: A Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna with an Enhanced Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A magneto-electric dipole antenna with an increased bandwidth operating from 1.04 to 3.15GHz has been proposed. The evolved design consists of a couple of r-shaped radiating patches connected to the ground plane, a parasitic patch, a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Gamma$</tex>-shaped feeding strip coupled to the radiating patches and the parasitic patch, and a ground plane. Compared with a typical magneto-electric dipole, the obtained broader bandwidth is mainly caused by the T-shaped patches. The lower operating frequency of the proposed design is significantly shifted downward with the same height, thus leading to a lower profile. Moreover, good impedance match is achieved by adding a parasitic patch above the antenna. The obtained impedance bandwidth (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} \leq 2$</tex>) is from 1.04 to 3.15GHz with a relative bandwidth of 100.7%. Moreover, the antenna presents stable radiation patterns with a cross-polarization level of less than −25dB.

articleTitle: Single-Side Band Space-Time-Modulated Metasurfaces for Doppler Cloak
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a new design of a single side band (SSB) space-time-modulated metasurface is proposed. We apply the SSB model to design the time sequences of the “modulation elements”. Then, 2-bit dynamically controled unit-cells are employed to realize the design. In particular, we show that artificial Doppler frequency shifts can be achieved accurately and effectively, being the amplitude of the first order harmonic 9.54 dB higher than the ones of the other order harmonics. The proposed designs have potential applications in wireless communications, radar camouflaging, and cloaking.

articleTitle: The Study on Near field EM Scattering of Target Located Above a Sea Surface Under Short Wave Band Based on MOM-PO
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The near field EM scattering of a target located above a sea surface under short-wave band is studied by the hybrid method that combining method of moment (MOM) and physical optics (PO) in this paper. The basic idea and related formulation of the hybrid method is presented firstly. The distribution of near field electric field strength of missile located above a sea surface is calculated. The influence of the number of missiles and the location of missiles on the electric field strength is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic RCS of Hypersonic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, based on physical optics method, the dynamic RCS of hypersonic vehicle coated with plasma sheath is studied. Firstly, the RCS of blunt cone covered by plasma sheath is compared with that of metal blunt cone, and it is found that the existence of plasma sheath will attenuate electromagnetic signal and reduce the RCS of target. Then, the dynamic RCS of blunt cone at different reentry heights and incident frequencies is explored. Firstly, the overall change trend of dynamic RCS of blunt cone is obtained, and then it is found that the change of dynamic RCS is related to reentry heights and incident frequencies. The main contribution of this paper is to build a dynamic RCS database to record the dynamic RCS changes of blunt cone at different reentry heights and incident frequencies.

articleTitle: A Frequency and Polarization Reconfigurable Spiral Antenna based on Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this communication, we propose a frequency and polarization reconfigurable spiral antenna tuned by liquid metal. The antenna has a compact size and wide reconfigurable bandwidth. The dual-layer polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) microfluidic attached to the dielectric substrate ensures liquid metal flowing. The left-hand circular polarization (LHCP) and right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) are achieved by adjusting the distribution of liquid metal in microfluidic channels. Changing the lengths of liquid metal arms realizes frequency reconfiguration. The proposed antenna supports continuously reconfigurable operating frequencies of RHCP from 0.6GHz to 13.5GHz and keeps working from 1.5GHz to 2.5GHz of LHCP.

articleTitle: Improvement of Vivaldi Antenna in Microwave Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Vivaldi antenna has been widely used in the microwave imaging system due to its wide frequency range and low cross-polarization character. The directivity and transfer efficiency of the antenna in the system is of great importance to the imaging quality. The Vivaldi antenna is commonly connected to the coaxial line with an SMA connector. However, the SMA connector forms a coplanar waveguide structure on the substrate, which makes the center frequency shift and the return loss increase. Through simulation, it is found that removing the SMA connector pins can improve the efficiency of the system antenna at the working frequency. The simulation results are verified by actual measurements in the imaging system.

articleTitle: 3D Beamforming Method for Near-Field-Focused Active Phased Array: 3D Scanning and 3D Polarization Manipulating
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The near-field-focused (NFF) beam design is a nonlinear 3D problem, which is significantly different with the far-field case. In this paper, a method of 3D beamforming, i.e., 3D polarization manipulating and 3D scanning, of the NFF phased array is proposed.
