The near-field (NF) 3D polarization manipulation is realized through vector synthesis of orthogonal polarization elements. A machine learning method is employed to build the amplitude and phase prediction model of the NFF phased-array antenna, which can solve the focal shift problem and realize the instant and accurate 3D scanning of the focus. The proposed 3D beamforming method is verified with a millimeter-wave NF-focusing active phased array prototype.

articleTitle: Design of a Reconfigurable Linear-to-Linear Polarization Conversion Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A reconfigurable polarization conversion meta-surface (PCM) is proposed, which can reflect the linear polarization (LP) wave into the orthogonal LP wave or LP wave with same polarization. In conversion mode, the proposed Re-PCM can operate over 4.5GHz∼5.5GHz maintaining the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Gamma \text{xx}$</tex> less than - 15dB. In reflection mode, the proposed Re-PCM acts as a metal reflector.

articleTitle: Small-Size Integrated Shielding Diaphragm in Miniaturized High-Power Microwave Cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work, we propose a shielding diaphragm based on periodic metal loops to suppress the radio-frequency interference (RFI) in the microwave cavity. The electrically small size of the developed diaphragm enables its application in the miniaturized circuit/antenna systems. Furthermore, the proposed metallic structure can be integrated into the cavity, which makes it compatible with the high-power devices. This technique can address the RFI problems in the miniaturized and high-power systems, such as tracking, telemetry, and command (TT&C) systems and millimeter-wave terminal devices.

articleTitle: Reconstruct 3D Geometry of Target using Differentiable SAR Renderer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The paper proposes a differentiable SAR renderer. Inspired by the differentiable optical renderer, rasterization and depth buffering become continuous. Different from the optical one, SAR renderer introduces the projection plane to calculate the occlusion between facets, and the mapping plane to image. Taking T72 model as an example, we realize its forward 2D imaging and backward 3D reconstruction from binary masks.

articleTitle: Multifrequency E-Field Measurement by Optical Under-Sampling System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Aiming at the fast measurement of multifrequency E-field distributed in a wide bandwidth range, this paper introduces an optical undersampling measurement method using Remainder Matching(RM) algorithm. The multifrequency e-field signal distributed in the range of 10 GHz is compressed to 110MHz for receiving and measurement, and the measurement speed is greatly improved. The reliability of this method is proved by theoretical analysis and simulation test.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Wideband Miniaturized Dual-polarized Vivaldi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband (UWB) Vivaldi antenna with an impedance bandwidth of 800MHz-18.5GHz (23.1:1) is introduced. The two antennas are placed orthogonal to achieve 0° and 90° polarization. The antenna is fed by a fan-shaped microstrip feeder, several rectangular and triangular gaps and resistors are loaded on the radiation arms of the etched conical slot to effectively reduce the geometric size of the antenna and broaden the bandwidth. The size of the antenna is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$70\text{mm}\times 45\text{mm} (0.187 \lambda_{0}\times 0.12 \lambda_{0},\quad \lambda_{0}$</tex> is the maximum working wavelength). The VSWR parameters are less than 2:1, and the isolation of two ports is better than −23dB.

articleTitle: P-L band Planar Ultra-Wideband Modular Antenna (PUMA) Arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Because of the large physical element size, there is significant difficulty in manufacturing of the planar ultrawideband modular antenna (PUMA) array operating in the P-L band. To solve this problem, a new PUMA element without capacitive coupling patches or capacitive through-vias is presented. The printed dipole in the PUMA element is asymmetric, and is fed through a vertical strip-line balun. Consequently, the designed PUMA element achieves ±45° scanning both in the E and H planes within a bandwidth of 6.5:1 in the P-L band. The sizes of the element are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50 \times 50\text{mm}(0.43 \lambda_{\mathrm{h}}, \lambda_{\mathrm{h}}$</tex> is the free-space wavelength at the highest operating frequency), and the total profile is 76.5mm (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.66 \lambda_{\mathrm{h}}$</tex>). The simulation results of an infinite array show that the proposed element can scan up to ±45° in the E and H planes within 0.4–2.6GHz with orthogonal port isolation better than 10dB. The design is verified by measured results of an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8 \times 7$</tex> array antenna prototype.

articleTitle: Broadband 3D Printed Conformal Dielectric Linear-to-Circular Polarization Metasurface Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A 3D printed conformal metasurface, based on a novel dielectric unit cell, is proposed for linear-to-circular polarization conversion. The designed dielectric unit cell comprises a cuboid-shaped dielectric block and a thin square dielectric substrate layer for ease of fabrication with 3D printing technology. Meanwhile, the unit cell can achieve linear-to-circular polarization conversion performance from 14.2 GHz to 20.1 GHz with 3-dB axial ratios (ARs) of 34% and good angular stability within 40°. Then, the unit cell is applied to design conformal linear-to-circular polarization dielectric metasurface converters on cylindrical and spherical surfaces, respectively.

articleTitle: Application of Improved FDTD Algorithm in Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the fourth-order central difference is adopted to analyze the space domain with the time domain remains being unchanged, to improve the traditional FDTD algorithm, it has also reset the PML absorbing boundary. The improved FDTD algorithm can not only increase the computational accuracy, but also shares the advantages of the original method in easy and simple programming. Finally, the correctness of the improved FDTD algorithm is verified, while simulated analysis of solar panels is conducted, based on which preventive suggestions are proposed.

articleTitle: Learning approach to inverse scattering problems with special boundary conditions and inhomogeneous background
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This article reviews the physics inspired machine learning inverse scattering algorithms developed by the authors for solving mixed boundary condition problem and inhomogeneous background problem, both of which are seldom studied though have found wide applications in practical scenarios such as ground penetrating radar, biomedical imaging and through wall imaging. The difficulty lies in mixed boundary problem is how to choose the parameter representing both PEC and dielectric scatterers as well as how to distinguish them. And the difficulty lies in the inhomogeneous background problem is how to suppress the unwanted artifacts due to the multiple scattering between the scatterers and the background. In this article, a T-matrix based inversion method is proposed to image PEC and dielectric scatterers together, which automatically distinguish the two kinds of scatterers, as the T-matrix naturally contains the information of boundary conditions. The inhomogeneous background problem is solved by generative adversarial neural network (GAN). By introducing the attention scheme into the GAN, the artifacts due to multiple scattering effect between the background and the scatterers are suppressed with a great improvement of resolution. The machine learning part is guided by the physics rather than working as a black box. Therefore, the proposed machine learning approach has a strong generalization ability. Numerical results and experimental results have shown the advantages of the proposed machine learning methods over conventional iterative methods in both image resolution, accuracy and imaging speed.

articleTitle: The Adaptability Analysis of Basic Emission Waveform Theory in the EMC Problem of Automobile CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper sorts out the analysis process and characteristics of Controller Area Network(CAN) bus in the automotive field, then analyzes and summarizes CAN bus test methods and electromagnetic compatibility(EMC) characteristics. EMC analysis is carried out on the test data of the physical link layer in the CAN bus test, and the influence of the corresponding interference source on the bus waveform is studied. The comprehensive applicability of the Basic Emission Waveform Theory in the field of automotive bus EMC is analyzed.

articleTitle: Time-Reversal Sparse Source Reconstruction with the Focal Underdetermined System Solver
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a time-reversal method that effectively reconstructs sparse sources using a focal underdetermined system solver (FOCUSS). The TR process is first formulated into an underdetermined matrix equation with the source amplitudes as the unknowns to be solved. Since the unknowns sources constitute a sparse vector, they are solved by using FOCUSS. A 3D numerical example is presented to verify the effectiveness and advantage of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Patch Antenna with Pins for Breast Tumor Noninvasive Focused Microwave Therapy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a miniaturized patch antenna with pins specifically designed for breast tumor noninvasive focused microwave therapy (FMT). There are 32 antennas utilized to constitute an antenna array focusing electromagnetic energy in tumor location while keeping healthy tissue at a safe temperature. The coupling of antennas causes focusing deviation. The miniaturized antenna can increase the distance between elements in order to decline to couple between antennas. Moreover, the offset distance between the focusing point and tumor location can be reduced. Loading pins achieve a lower resonance frequency with a smaller antenna size. The proposed approach utilizing an antenna was applied for the model treating breast cancer.

articleTitle: Design of Beam Deflection of Artificial Electromagnetic Metasurface based on meta library
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The Artificial electromagnetic structures can achieve functions that natural materials cannot achieve. The phase artificial wave vector can control the surface composition gradient of electromagnetic wave reflection and propagation. In this paper, we obtain the phase gradient distribution of metasurface elements by the following methods: Huygens principle and generalized Snell's law. The simulation results show that the structure has a good beam deflection effect at low frequencies, the structure is thin in thickness and low in quality.

articleTitle: The coupling of lightning electromagnetic pulse on ships with a novel FDTD modeling scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Based on the finite-difference time-domain (FD-TD) method, we propose a new mesh generation algorithm to model the ships and its cabin and then the electromagnetic coupling effect of lightning electromagnetic pulse on them could be obtained, which gives a new way for the analysis of electromagnetic pulse coupling to the ships.

articleTitle: Antenna Array Miniaturization based on Slow Wave HMSIW-SSPP Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the design of antennas has been put forward on the miniaturization, and systemization. For the purpose of achieving array antenna miniaturized, an antenna array fed in the form of series based on hybrid half mode substrate integrated waveguide transmission line (HMSIW TL) and spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP) structure is proposed. The maximum gain of the proposed structure is 11.7 dBi in the band of 14.52 to 14.83 GHz. The miniaturization of the longitudinal size of the array structure is realized.

articleTitle: Calculation of Material Permittivity and Permeability Based on Trust Region Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The permittivity and permeability are important parameters to characterize the electromagnetic characteristics of materials. In order to solve the problem of the limitation of material processing shape and accuracy in the calculation, this paper proposes a method to calculate the complex permittivity and permeability of materials by using CST simulation, trust region algorithm and measured S parameters based on rectangular waveguide method (one of transmission/reflection method). In this paper, the performance of four common CST optimization algorithms in this problem is compared, and the effectiveness of the method is verified by using PTFE material.

articleTitle: High Selectivity Filtering Slot Antenna Builed on Multi-mode Cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A fifth-order filtering slot antenna based on multimode cavity resonator is proposed and analyzed. The proposed antenna includes two single mode rectangular cavity, one triple-mode rectangular cavity and a grid-slotted patch. One singlemode resonator is designed as slot cavity antenna and acts one resonator coupled with the load of the filter. The fifth-order slot antenna is designed according to the theory of filter synthesis. Two transmission zeros are introduced on both sides of the passband to increase the selectivity and one grid-slotted patch is utilized to enhance the gain of the antenna. The simulated results of this fifth-order filtering slot antenna are given, which shows a good filtering function. The antenna has a bandwidth of 9.77-10.25 GHz and the maximum gain of the antenna is 9.35 dBi.

articleTitle: Vector SS-SIE for Electromagnetic Analysis of Complex Scatters Embedded in Multilayers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An accurate and efficient single-source surface integral equation (SS-SIE) is proposed to solve the electromagnetic scattering caused by multilayered structure with transverse electric (TE) excitation in this paper. Through the novel use of the surface equivalence theorem (SET), which is distinct from the classical Love's equivalence theorem, the equivalent model is derived, where only electric current exists at the outermost contour. Therefore, significant less unknowns are required to solve the electromagnetic problems induced by multilayered structure. The results show that the proposed SS-SIE formulation have better performance in the number of unknowns, CPU time and memory consumption compared with the traditional PMCHWT formulation.

articleTitle: Bayesian Compressive Sensing Approach for Phaseless Microwave Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel approach for phaseless data in solving microwave imaging through the Bayesian Compressive Sensing (BCS) formulated within the Born approximation framework is presented in this paper. Some selected numerical simulation are reported to compare and assess the features and potentialities of the proposed methodology with available state-of-the-art technique formulated in Born approximation.

articleTitle: The Lagrange Interpolation Method for the Cavity Eigenvalue Problem with Electric Field Integral Equation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Calculating the eigenmodes and eigenfrequencies of a perfect electric conductor cavity is one of the classical problems in electromagnetics. When we use the electric field integral equation (EFIE) to solve the problem, we will get a nonlinear eigenvalue problem because the frequency is the argument of the exponential function of the free space Green's function. A nonlinear eigenvalue problem is usually not easy to solve. In this work, a simple and iterative method is proposed for the EFIE eigenvalue problem. By using the Lagrange interpolation of the Green's function, the nonlinear eigenvalue problem can be transformed to a polynomial eigenvalue problem, which is then rearranged to the generalized eigenvalue problem. By solving the generalized eigenvalue problem iteratively, the resonance frequencies and modes of a cavity can be obtained. The method is applicable to arbitrarily shaped cavities and the numerical computation is easy to carry out. For demonstrating the accuracy and the feasibility of the method, several numerical results are presented.

articleTitle: An Adjoint-based Shape Optimization Design System for the Radar Cross Section Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient shape optimization design system for the Radar Cross Section (RCS) reduction using the adjoint approach is discussed. The Method of Moments (MoM) and the Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm (MLFMA) are applied to solve the Combined Field Integral Equation (CFIE) or the Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai (PMCHWT) equation to calculate the RCS. As for the high-frequency scattering problem, the Physical Optics (PO) method is selected to calculate the RCS due to its efficiency. The gradient of the RCS is obtained by solving the adjoint equations. The code that calculates the derivatives is developed with the help of the Automatic Differentiation (AD) technique. The Free-Form Deformation (FFD) approach is used to parameterize the shape and the Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) is chosen as the optimization algorithm. Without a large number of function evaluations, this design system could efficiently obtain the shape that meets the stealth requirements.

articleTitle: An S-band PA Module Suitable for Spaceborne Measurement and Control Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents an S-band power amplifier (PA) module suitable for spaceborne measurement and control terminal. It adopts automatic level control (ALC) to ensure the stability of output power, and supports continuous and pulse operation modes. The measured and experimental results show that the output power of the PA module varies from 40.2dBm to 40.8dBm when the input power changes in the range of 0-15dBm. Long-term power consumption can also be greatly reduced by using the power supply modulation circuit. In addition, considering autonomous control, the components in the PA module are 100 percentage of home-made parts.

articleTitle: Analysis on low-frequency scattered fields from underwater target
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The characteristic frequency from the low-frequency scattered fields was discussed when a pulse source is adopted to irradiate an underwater target. The total-field scattered-field source finite-difference time-domain (TSS-FDTD) method is used to analyze the scattered fields from the underwater target. Numerical results illustrate the characteristic frequency from an underwater metallic spheroid.

articleTitle: Application of Spherical Near-far-field Transformational Algorithm based on Scattering Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To obtain the far-filed performance of the antenna from the near-field data, a spherical near-far-field transformation algorithm based on the scattering matrix is used and verified in the paper. Firstly, the tested antenna and the probe are considered as an open two-port network. Then, the transmission coefficient of the antenna can be deduced by the transmission formula in near-field between the measured antenna and the probe. Finally, the far-filed of the measured antenna can be obtained by taking the transmission coefficient into the far-field transmission formula. The difficulty and field requirement are reduced in antenna measurement by the method. The method extends the scope for antenna measurement.

articleTitle: Conformal Array Element Failure Correction Based on PSO-CS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Conformal array has a shape that highly matches the physical structure of the ship superstructure. However, during the long-term operation of the antenna, array element failure will seriously affect the radiation pattern. In order to correct the pattern of the failure element, a method of correcting the pattern of the conformal array based on particle swarm optimization(PSO) and cuckoo search(CS) hybrid algorithm is proposed in this paper. First, with the help of Euler rotation, the ideal and failure far-field pattern of the conformal array are synthesized. Second, the initial parameters of the PSO-CS algorithm are established, the amplitude and phase of the element excitation of the conformal array is adjusted to get the optimization model of the algorithm. Last, the simulation results are analyzed and compared which show that the algorithm can effectively optimize the radiation pattern of the failed array element and improve the overall similarity of the pattern and the first sidelobes.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Fitting Method for the Efficient Evaluation of Green's Functions in Planar Layered Media
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient and accurate fitting approach for computing spatial-domain Green's functions (SDGFs) in planar layered media is presented in this paper. The proposed approximation scheme uses two independent rational fitting models, and adaptively selects spatial-domain samples in each consecutive iteration. The iteration stops until the error between two rational models lower than the preset accuracy. Numerical results show the proposed method enables a robust and accuracy-controllable closed-form evaluation of the SDGFs for the electromagnetic field quantities with a minimized number of samples.

articleTitle: Unconditionally stable FDTD method based on Chebyshev polynomials—Chebyshev(CS)FDTD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An unconditionally stable solution using Chebyshev polynomials is proposed for the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. The orthogonality and recurrence of Chebyshev polynomials are used to reconstruct the signal, and Chebyshev polynomials differential matrix is established to realize the transformation of time-domain Maxwell's equations to the Chebyshev domain. The examples show that error is below −50dB when compared with the conventional FDTD method.

articleTitle: Investigation of Deep Learning Backbone Influence on 2D Permittivity Reconstruction Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper investigates the influence of the deep learning (DL) backbone on the reconstruction performance of scatterers in two-dimensional inverse scattering problems (ISPs). To avoid using DL as a purely data-driven black-box solver, it would be profitable to combine DL with the understanding of the physics in ISPs. The modified contrast scheme (MCS) is selected to generate the input of the deep learning algorithm, which enables DL to reconstruct scatterers with higher contrast. As for the backbone of the deep learning algorithm, the U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Net is selected to capture more global information in the shallow layer, which helps DL comprehensively learn the global scattering phenomenon in ISPs. Numerical results show that with the same input, the reconstruction performance of the U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Net is better than the U-Net.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Frequency-Domain Channel Emulation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper analyzes the performance of a channel emulation method based on the frequency-domain. The main idea is to compute the input channel coefficients and signal sequence in frequency-domain, which aims to save hardware resource during the channel emulation. Meanwhile, simulation verifies the feasibility of the algorithm above. Results show that the channel emulation method based on frequency-domain greatly reduces the resource consumption and improves the speed of channel emulation.

articleTitle: Local Time-Stepping Scheme for Arbitrary High-Order DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an arbitrary high-order (ADER)-DGTD method with a local time-stepping (LTS) scheme for electromagnetic modeling is proposed. The stability condition of the proposed LTS-ADER-DGTD method is not limited by the smallest time step size, which allows elements to update themselves with individual time step sizes in accordance with the local stability condition. Moreover, the accuracy of the LTS-ADER-DGTD method will not be reduced, which is the biggest advantage over LTS-leap-frog (LF) time discretization schemes. The superiority of the LTS-ADER-DGTD method is demonstrated by analyzing the resonant frequency of cavity and FSS structures.

articleTitle: Wideband transmission/absorption active metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Here a novel active ABA metasurface with wideband transmission/absorption is proposed, which consists of a metallic mesh layer (B layer) sandwiched by two layers of metallic layer (A layer). PIN diodes were embedded in the top and bottom A layers to manipulate the transmission/absorption states of the metasurface. Wide-band transmission upper than 80% in the frequency of 5.5 GHz-7.3 GHz and wide-band absorption upper than 80% in the frequency of 5.2 GHz-7.4 GHz have been achieved. The proposed active ABA metasurface have promising applications for the intelligent radome.

articleTitle: Near-field Time-Reversal Imaging Combined with Numerical Mode Matching method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A new method of combining the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm with the Numerical Matching Method (NMM) is proposed to realize the time reversal (TR) imaging with near-field scattering of multi-object scene. The NMM is used to compute the bistatic forward scattering of multiple objects to get the UWB scattering field. Then the TR-MUSIC algorithm utilizes the NMM calculation result as the input to achieve multi-object imaging. Experiments illustrate that the algorithm has efficient performance.

articleTitle: A Duplexing Quasi-Yagi antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A duplexing quasi-Yagi antenna is proposed in this letter. It consists of two half-wavelength dipoles operating at 3.5/5 GHz. Two half-wavelength resonators are utilized to feed the dipoles and form a second-order filtering response at each passband. Two arms of each dipole are printed on two layers of the substrate, and one arm is a 90° bended half-wavelength resonator in fact, while the other is connected to the ground plane. To improve the directivity, two pairs of striplines are utilized as the director, and the ground plane acts as a reflector. The simulated results show that the antenna can operate at two passbands from 3.29 to 3.64 GHz and 4.7 to 5.2 GHz, with a flat gain in each band. An isolation of over 18 dB is achieved between two channels.

articleTitle: A Novel Blind Source Separation Algorithm for Electromagnetic Interference Sources Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel blind source separation (BSS) algorithm for electromagnetic interference (EMI) sources identification based on data mining is proposed in this paper. Differing from normal analysis, the new algorithm is conducted by mining the internal correlations of radiated emission (RE) data which is obtained by taking standard tests in the far field around the equipment under test (EUT). The results of full wave electromagnetic simulation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Correlation Property of Broadened Microwave Short-Pulse Combined in Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A method to analyze the distortion of the broadened microwave short-pulse combined in time-domain is presented. The simulated results indicate that the correlation property of the combined pulse would decrease as the delay of array elements increases. The maximum allowable value of delay can be inferred from it, and the value is linear positively related to the array element pulse width. The study provides an exercisable and flexible measure to evaluate the combined pulse waveform quantitatively, and could contribute to utilizing the ability of broadening the combined pulse optimally.

articleTitle: A spectrum allocation algorithm with fast response to interference
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Because spectrum resources are scarce and not shareable, a large number of working electronic devices in the same area are prone to interference. When electronic device is interfered, how to quickly eliminate the interference is important. To solve the problem of spectrum resource allocation and interference elimination between electronic devices, this paper proposes a spectrum allocation algorithm that can quickly respond to interference. The algorithm comprehensively considers electromagnetic environment restrictions, priority of electronic devices, potential interference between electronic devices, the number of frequency points required by devices and other restrictions. When interference occurs, the algorithm can respond quickly and provide a frequency-using strategy to eliminate the interference, which provides guarantee and support for the normal operation of the device.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Interference between Multiple Quantum Mechanical Domains in Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We study the electromagnetic interference between active components in complicated electronic structures. In our simulations, dynamic behaviors of these active components with detailed atom configurations are described by the first-principles methods, while the entire system is modeled by a novel coupled quantum mechanics and electromagnetics (QM/EM) in the real time domain. We demonstrate that electronic devices could be treated independently in the sense of classical electromagnetics below a particular operational frequency (e.g. 10 THz). Our time-domain QM/EM simulations could also quantitatively describe the dependency of electromagnetic interference on the separating distance between devices. The relationships between induction current and separating distance are compared at different operational frequencies.

articleTitle: Wideband Three-Way Cavity Filtering Crossover Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order cavity filtering crossover with three intersecting channels is presented. Three fundamental modes in one cavity resonator, namely TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">011</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</inf>, and TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">110</inf>, are adopted to control three frequency channels, respectively. Each channel of proposed crossover resonates at 3 GHz with the fractional bandwidth of 24%. Due to the modal orthogonality of three fundamental modes, good isolation among channels can be easily achieved with the level of 50 dB. Finally, the proposed design can be extended into <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\times 3\times 3$</tex> crossover array.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Space-Mapping-Based Multiphysics Optimization for Microwave Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Multiphysics-based optimization is a useful technique for high performance microwave design. An overview for recent advancements in multiphysics design using space mapping (SM) techniques is provided in this paper. We develop a surrogate model including two mapping modules and an EM coarse model using SM. This technique provide a effective and larger update for every iteration by utilizing the information of the coarse model represented using inexpensive EM domain samples, resulting in optimal solutions being obtained more efficient than the existing methods. A high power microwave filter is used to illustrate this technique.

articleTitle: Radiated Fields of $f=8\text{Hz}$ Underwater Electric Dipole With SNIM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The Sommerfeld numerical integral method (SNIM) is used to study the electromagnetic fields of an electric dipole under sea surface in this paper. The spatial distribution of electromagnetic field amplitude on the 1km plane away from the sea surface is discussed with a horizontal electric dipole of 100m below sea surface. Numerical results shows that the accuracy and validity of the approach are verified by comparing with the results of the Finite Difference-Time Domain (FDTD) method.

articleTitle: Study on Extraction of Capacitance Parameters of Three Dimensional Interconnect Structures Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of industry makes the proportion of interconnect in chip increase rapidly. In order to ensure the stability and reliability of the circuit, accurate 3D modeling and high efficiency parasitic parameter extraction are needed for the chip interconnect. This paper has carried out the research on the extraction of capacitance parameters of the 3D finite element interconnection line. Starting from the principle of multi-conductor capacitance calculation, the problem is reduced to solving the Laplace equation for point boundary conditions. By using the finite element method (FEM), the solving process is analyzed and deduced. In addition, based on the high-efficiency parallel support software framework JAUMIN, this paper realizes the parallel calculation of the three-dimensional finite element capacitance parameter extraction, which greatly improves the calculation efficiency. Finally, the algorithm is applied to a representative interconnect structure. The calculation results are compared with the multi-physics commercial simulation software COMSOL. The results show that the potential distribution diagram is consistent.

articleTitle: Design of a Switch Type Phase Shifter Using Lumped Components
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel design of switch type phase shifter using lumped components is proposed. Compared to the conventional topologies which have been developed with multi-functions, a new structure with lowpass/all-pass topology which can be used to design phase shifters range from 10° to 50° is presented. Finally, a prototype of 20° phase shifter with center frequency of 1GHz is presented and simulated. The results are consistent with the design method.

articleTitle: Design of A Low-profile Broadband Circularly Polarized Metasurface Antenna Based on Characteristic Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A circularly polarized (CP) metasurface (MS) antenna with wide operating band and low-profile is proposed. To reveals the working mechanism of the broadband MS CP antenna, characteristic mode analysis (CMA) which can provide physical insight is introduced. The desired modes are selected to construct CP radiation and then excited by a L-shaped slot while the undesired modes are shifted towards higher frequencies. After modulating the higher order mode, the in-band boresight gain is improved. After full-wave simulation, the results show the impedance matching bandwidth and the axial ratio (AR) bandwidth are 24% and 32.1% respectively. Besides, the radiation patterns are greatly improved comparing with the reference antennas.

articleTitle: Underground Space Detection System Based On WOLA Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Weak signal detection capability and real-time signal processing capability is significant for the underground space detection system. In this paper, an underground space detection system based on the channelization algorithm is designed. Through the channelization algorithm based on the weighted-overlap-add (WOLA) structure, the system can detect four weak signal energy values of different frequencies at one time. Simulation and experimental results show that compared with traditional detection methods, the system has a breakneck processing speed, and the weak signal detection ability can be improved.

articleTitle: Enhanced Directional Fluorescence Spontaneous emission via Multipolar Interference in Metal-Dielectric Hybrid Nanoantenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel type of metal-dielectric hybrid nanoantenna that leverages the advantages of high electric field enhancement from metal and low loss from dielectric, is proposed for fluorescence enhancement. Enhanced directional fluorescence radiation is achieved via coherent coupling between the metal plasmonic-resonance and dielectric magnetic dipole mode. The average enhancement factor of a randomly oriented fluorescence emitter cluster can reach ∼1500 and the maximum directivity enhancement can reach ∼3000.

articleTitle: Conceptual Design of High Gain Circularly Polarized Dual-Resonant Patch Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A high gain wideband circularly polarized (CP) antenna array under dual resonant is conceptually designed. The antenna array is composed by four rotational, dual-resonant microstrip patch antennas with square parasitic elements. The four elements are sequentially-fed with uniform amplitude and 90° phase shift. It is seen that the designed antenna array can finally exhibit an available bandwidth of 7.4% for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AR} < 3\ \text{dB}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathrm{S}11\vert < - 10\ \text{dB}$</tex>. Besides, the boresight gain is even high up to 15.7 dBi and in-band gain variation is less than 1 dB, while the profile of the whole configuration is as low as 0.03-wavelength.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance of the Implicit Hybridizable Discontinuous Galerkin time-domain method with different grids for Maxwell's equations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Some local areas are potentially to be divided into very small size grids so as to improve the simulation precision during the inhomogeneous microwave system. The implicit time scheme is very appropriate for small grids due to its unconditional stability. In this work, based on the previous research on the implicit hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (imHDGTD) method, we mainly study the effect of different grids on this method for Maxwell's equation. According to the comparative consequences with the classical discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) method, numerical simulations validate the better effectiveness of imHDGTD when using some refined grids. As a consequence, the proposed imHDGTD way has a superior property towards intricate grid models.

Author Keywords: implicit hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin time-domain method

articleTitle: Tunable Topological Photonic Crystal Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Edge states in topological photonic systems have the robust unidirectional propagation feature which originates from the topological nature of the bulk band dispersion. In this work, we propose a topological photonic crystal (PC) waveguide that is formed by introducing an air gap in an all-dielectric PC with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$C_{6v}$</tex> symmetry. The dispersion of the line defect states is tunable by varying the width of the air gap. Based on their field distributions, the states can be classified into even- and odd-symmetric states. The even-symmetric states are found to be the nontrivial topological edge states and exhibit pseudospin-locking unidirectional propagation property. By introducing disorders to the waveguide, these states are proven to be robust with well suppressed backscattering.

articleTitle: Design of Harmonic-Suppressed Coupler With Integrated Filtering Blocks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this conference paper, a microstrip branch-line coupler with quasi-arbitrary phase difference and second harmonic suppression presented. By replacing the transmission lines with two filtering blocks, the proposed coupler could have harmonic suppression function. As an example, a symmetrical T-shaped structure which introduces transmission zero is analyzed. To verify the validity of the proposed configuration, an example operating at 2.4 GHz is designed and simulated. The circuit exhibits good second harmonic suppressed response with 60°/120° phase differences.

articleTitle: The Design of Dual-Polarization Slotted Waveguide Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This article introduces a dual-polarization waveguide slot antenna design. The horizontally polarized waveguide antenna designed in this paper uses narrow-side oblique slits, and two adjacent pairs of slits are reversed to suppress cross-polarization. The vertically polarized waveguide antenna is designed with a wide edge and a longitudinal slit on both sides of the center line. The antenna has dual-polarization common-aperture low sidelobe and wide-angle scanning performance.

articleTitle: FDTD Analysis of Magnetized Plasma Based on Precise-Integration Time-Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A method based on precise-integration time-domain (PITD) is proposed to calculate and analyze the numerical problems in anisotropic magnetized plasma media. The recursive formula of each vector field quantity is obtained by using the principle of the auxiliary differential equation, and the precise-integration (PI) technique and the Gauss integration technique are used to treat the coefficient matrix and integral term. This method solves the complex discrete problem in the current density vector while reducing redundant calculations. Through the numerical experimentations of the typical anisotropic plasma, problems verify and validate the reliability of the proposed formulation.

articleTitle: Investigation on Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics of Near Sea Surface With Breaking Waves
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of near sea breaking waves. Monte Carlo method is used to generate nonlinear sea surface. Near Sea spectral function is used to simulate actual sea surface of near sea. Based on the theory of the curved wedge model, introduces a shallower coefficient, the normalized radar cross section plots of sea surface under backscattering configuration are calculated, the influence of different sea depths on the normalized radar cross section of near sea are analyzed. The simulation results show that the backscattering coefficients of near sea surface with breaking waves have a great impact on HH polarization, and the backscattering coefficients of the near sea surface with breaking waves gradually becomes larger as the water depth becomes shallower, indicating that the mechanism of the near sea breaking waves mainly depends on the nonlinear action of the wave in the process of gradually shallower water depth.

articleTitle: Broadband, Wide-Scanning and Low-Profile Antenna Array Based on Tightly Coupled Dipoles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile broadband dual-polarized planar phased array with a wide scanning range is presented at 12 GHz — 26 GHz. The antenna element is made up of superstrings, patches and metal columns, and the total thickness is 4.094 mm. The dielectric layer and metal columns not only promote the scanning angle, but also provide a solution to improve the matching response. The VSWR is lower than 2.15 and 3.61, severally, with scanning to 50° and 60°. At the same time, the simulation results of a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4\times 4$</tex> planar array show that active VSWR is lower than 1.78 at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\theta=0^{\circ}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varphi=0^{\circ}$</tex> in the entire design frequency band.

articleTitle: A Reflective Metasurface Generates OAM Beams
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile, broadband reflective metasurface is proposed to generate orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams. The design method of generating is introduced, and the effectiveness of this method is verified by simulation. It can be seen that broadband OAM beam with the mode number <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l=1$</tex> was successfully realized by simulation and showed good quality in the phase profile. The maximum gain of simulation reaches 17.61dB at 10GHz.

articleTitle: Tunable Radar Absorber Using Resistive Frequency-Selective Surface and Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a wideband and tunable absorber structure by using resistive frequency-selective surface (FSS) and plasma. The resistive FSS layer located on the top side is constructed by low-conductivity square loops. The solid metal ground is located on the bottom side. The plasma layer is between the FSS and metal ground and its dispersive characteristics are represented by the Drude model. Numerical results show that the absorber can absorb 90% of the incident energy at normal incidence in a bandwidth of nearly 10 GHz, and the absorbing band is tunable by changing the plasma frequency.

articleTitle: Caculation of Diffraction Field of Creeping Waves on Arbitrary Convex Surface Based on Non-uniform FOCK Currents
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper researched the non-uniform diffraction currents (NU currents) on a cylinder and calculated its radiation field using the theory of incremental length diffraction coefficients (ILDCs). Afterwards, we extended this method to arbitrary convex surface, for calculation of complex integral contain high-oscillation characteristic of the phase, this oscillation can be eliminated by introducing the phase-unwrap technique. At last, an example of an arbitrary convex surface scatterer illustrated the universality and accuracy of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable PRS Loaded Antenna with Gain Enhancement and Beam Steering Property
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: By loading a reconfigurable partially reflecting surface (PRS), gain enhancement and beam steering are achieved for a Fabry-Perot (FP) antenna. The PRS is formed by elements containing double-C metallic structures on a dielectric substrate and located above a designed patch antenna. The design can steer the wave beam with angle of 18° and realizes a gain over 10.9 dBi at 5.5 GHz. At the same time, the gain is increased by 5.7 dBi and 4.7 dBi higher than original patch antenna and the FP antenna.

articleTitle: A Novel 5.8GHz Harmonic-suppressed Rectenna for Wireless Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper introduces a new 5.8GHz rectenna for wireless power transmission. A circular polarized slot antenna with simple structure is proposed. The harmonic suppression function is realized by loading slots on the floor of microstrip antenna. The RF energy is matched by the microstrip single branch short transversal impedance circuit. The voltage doubling rectifier circuit composed of Schottky diodes is converted into direct current signal, and the direct filter is used to filter the fundamental frequency and high order of the signal harmonics, to produce a stable DC voltage. The simulation results show that when the input power is 11 dBm and the load resistance is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1400\Omega$</tex>, the rectification efficiency can reach 73.3%

articleTitle: Wide-Beam Rectenna Design Using Multi-port Metasurface-Based Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The design of a wide beamwidth rectenna utilizing a multi-port metasurface (MTS) antenna for energy harvesting (EH) is described in this paper. In order to extend the narrow beam of a conventional rectenna to successfully convert enough low power in the circuit stage of harvesters, a three-port wide-beamwidth nonuniform MTS antenna is presented. In this antenna, two modes are excited through the middle and the side apertures. The first one is the fundamental MTS mode, with inphase current distribution and a directional radiation pattern. The second one is the higher MTS mode, with opposite current distributions and a directional tilted-angle radiation pattern. The key advantage of this MTS antenna is that the effective MTS area is reused by the three ports for three different radiation modes with different radiation patterns simultaneously. Incident radio frequency waves from different directions can be collected by the metasurface and fed to one of the three ports depending on the incident angle. Then, the direct current (DC) power after rectification at the three ports is combined to achieve a wide beam effectively. The measured main beamwidth of the combined rectenna is 114°. The main beam angles of the three ports are −35°, 0° and +35° respectively. An RF-to-DC conversion efficiency of 6%–67% was achieved at 2.45 GHz when the input power ranged from −30 to 0 dBm.

articleTitle: Research on Undersampling Application on Narrowband Antenna in Planner Near-field Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Based on Planer near-field translation theory and Nyquisty sampling theory, this paper studies the influence of sampling spacing on the result in planar near-field measurement by means of theoretical analysis and simulation, and acquires some laws and useful results, and proves the applicability and correctness of Nyquisty undersampling method in narrowband antenna measurement. The test efficiency can be effectively improved by increasing sampling spacing.

articleTitle: A Fast Echo Evaluation Method of Chaff Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Echo estimation of chaff cloud before they are put into use is a crucial issue in anti-electromagnetic interference. It is quite difficult to calculate the echo of the chaff cloud that contains millions of chaff elements. Comparing with the general numerical method in time-domain, a more efficient method to calculate the echo of the chaff cloud is proposed in this paper. A superposition strategy is introduced to calculate the echo by summarizing the echo of a single chaff element that is pre-stored in the database. This strategy is available when the interval length between any two elements in cloud is larger than two wavelengths. Then, we give the echo of the chaff cloud illustrated by two modulated incident signals.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Odd Power Synthesis Based on Hybrid Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Power synthesis has always been one of the key technologies in power amplifier design, for the unused frequency bands and power requirements, the circuit form and synthesis method of power synthesis can be realized are obviously different, this paper designs a wideband power synthesizer covering the frequency range of 6-18GHz, using the mixed integration of odd bond line circuit and even waveguide to achieve multi-channel power planar synthesis, in which even waveguide synthesis uses improved side feed-time HT mode transmission, reduce the volume, while guaranteeing transmission performance. The simulation and physical tests show that its input standing wave is better than 1.8 and the average insertion loss is less than 2.0dB, to meet the design requirements. The synthesizer is designed to support higher-power UWB power amplifiers.

articleTitle: Design and Moisture Influence Analysis of a High Temperature Resistance FSS Radome
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a Ku-band frequency selective surface (FSS) radome design with a bandwidth of 1GHz, and the correctness of the design is verified through experiments. The microwave transmission performance of FSS radome decreases because of the moisture absorption of silicon dioxide-based materials. The test results show that the microwave transmission performance can be restored by drying for a long time.

articleTitle: Design of a Multilayered Frequency Selective Surface Absorber for the Suppression of Grating Lobes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a multilayered frequency selective surface (FSS) absorber with a great suppression effect of the grating lobes has been designed. The proposed absorber consists of four layers, two layers in the middle of the absorber act as an electromagnetic (EM) filter, which is transparent at lower frequency (L and S band) and totally reflective at higher frequency. Moreover, the transmitted EM wave is absorbed in the bottom layer while the reflected wave is absorbed in the upper layer. Specifically, reflectivity below −10 dB is obtained in 1.04-2.5 GHz, 3.5-4.2 GHz and 8.1-16 GHz at normal incidence. Plate sample has been fabricated, and great agreement between simulation and measurement has been observed.

articleTitle: SMT: A Space-Mapping-Based Tuning Software System for a Post-fabrication Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient space-mapping-based tuning software system is implemented with a user-friendly GUI in Matlab for the automated filter tuning process. The proposed software system is integrated into a tuning system for achieving fast and reliable filter tuning. In this paper, a postfabrication bandpass filter is given to validate the tuning performance of the SMT software system.

articleTitle: Simulation and Measurement of EM Radiation for Moving Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In recent years, the safety of electromagnetic radiation to the exterior circumstance during the normal operation of maglev train has been paid more and more attention. In this paper, the electromagnetic radiation field of maglev train is modeled and simulated by using the multiconductor transmission line (MTL) method. Based on IEC standards, the EM radiation field measurement of the moving maglev train under different operating conditions are conducted. The results show that the radiation magnetic field from the maglev train is distributed periodically at 12 meters from 50kHz to 110 kHz, the maximum value of simulation is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$69.4\ \text{dB}\ \mu\ \mathrm{A}/\mathrm{m}$</tex>, the measured value of the radiated magnetic field from the maglev train is less than 31 mA/m(<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$90.6\ \text{dB}\ \mu$</tex> A/m) in 1 Hz to 120 kHz. Our work can lay a foundation for the research of electromagnetic safety of new-type high-speed maglev train in China.

articleTitle: Research on Performance of Plasma Covered Antenna Window Using Sandwich Structure with Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Plasma sheath generated by fierce friction between hypersonic aircraft and air causes severe interference on communication between ground and aircraft once the frequency of electromagnetic wave is lower than the frequency of plasma. However, effects that plasma sheath exerts on antenna window can be mitigated via application of a sandwich structure which consists of alternant medium layers with positive and negative relative permittivity, where meta-material and plasma sheath serve as negative relative permittivity layer. Transmission performance of antenna window covered by plasma sheath will increase harshly within certain frequency range of wave propagation, which is known as window frequency. The typical effect of metamaterial surface on the transmission performance of antenna window in window frequency is discussed in the paper, and simulation results are included as validation of the effect.

articleTitle: A Wideband Bandpass Power Divider with Improved Isolation Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With improved isolation performance, a wideband bandpass power divider is newly reported. Four transmission zeros of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{22}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{23}$</tex> can be got, and the amplitude of both <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{22}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{23}$</tex> can be controlled below −20 dB by adding an extra isolation resistor. The mathematical conditions are presented, the several design examples are listed, and the S-parameters of different cases are compared. For verification, a wideband power divider is shown with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{FBW} =78\%$</tex> at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{0}=2.5\ \text{GHz}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Validation of the Simulated HIRF Effects in Computational Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a hierarchical validation procedure for validation of the simulated high-intensity radiated field (HIRF) effects in electromagnetic (EM) models are established. A three-stage process of EM model hierarchical validation (from the bottom up) is proposed: unit stage, benchmark stage, and system stage. A rectangular enclosure benchmark model, a metallic case model with multiple slots and apertures, and a real aircraft model have been used in this paper. For each stage, numerical results have been compared to measurements with the implementation of the uncertainty quantification (UQ) and validation metric. The proposed hierarchical validation methodology has been applied in the validation of the real aircraft model under HIRF conditions. The framework presented here is also appropriate for the other real structures, which can offer valuable insight for both protection design as well as optimization and electromagnetic compatibility.

articleTitle: Design of a Resistively Loaded Frequency Selective Surface with Low Reflection in Transition Band
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Design of a hybrid frequency selective surface with loading resistance which can reduce the reflection within transition and stop band is presented in this paper. The loaded-resistance can consume part of the energy irradiating on the surface, which leads to reduction of radar-cross section in both monostatic and bi-static ways. Unlike the traditional practice of chasing sharp-roll off sideband performance characteristics by cascading more function layers, the use of resistor does not increase the total thickness of radome or other surface equipment, that is beneficial to engineering realization. A simple full-wave simulation example demonstrates that resistance-loaded indeed reduce reflection of transition and stop band.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Method for SAR Imaging in Sparse Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Motivated by the successes of data driven approaches in various fields, a great number of deep learning methods have been applied to SAR images. In this work, we propose a deep neural network named RG-Net, which can generate SAR images from raw echo data in the sparse target domain. Experiments are carried out on a simulation dataset, and the results show the superiority of the proposed method on imaging quality and computational efficiency. The source code is at https://github.com/zhangyingerjelly/RG-Net

articleTitle: Error Analysis of Isosceles Triangular Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The interpolation accuracy of isosceles triangular interpolation for the linear and quadratic interpolations are analyzed. The isosceles triangular grids are generated by shifting every other row of pre-calculation points by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h/2$</tex>, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex> is sampling interval. Compared with the two-dimensional Lagrange interpolation, the isosceles triangular interpolation has higher interpolation accuracy and does not need additional precalculation points.

articleTitle: Transient analysis of propagation characteristics in layered lossy medium
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a new method for calculating the time-domain reflection and transmission coefficients of the layered lossy medium is presented. The global time-domain reflection and transmission coefficients of layered lossy medium are obtained by the time-domain recursive formulas. We deduced the formulas of time-domain interfacial reflection and transmission coefficients according to the time-domain propagating mode method. The numerical results show the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Portable Design of Image Timing Acquisition System Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: China has a vast territory and beautiful scenery. In order to realize real-time image acquisition and transmission, a portable real-time image transmission system based on Raspberry Pi is proposed in this paper. Compared with traditional image transmission system, this designed system has advantage such as low power consumption and portability. Based on Linux operating system, Raspberry Pi open source hardware platform is developed as the image acquisition server. The designed device is equipped with large-capacity batteries as well as solar charging panels which can supply uninterrupted electric energy for the portal system. Landscape photos can be taken and sent to the user terminal by email by using GPS positioning and 4G communication module. By contrast, the remote control of the device can be also realized by sending instructions from the user terminal. The experiment proves that the system can be stable and normal operation, high reliability, the system for different scenes, DIY design different functions. Remote image acquisition system can be widely used in unattended, home security, personal protection and other remote monitoring fields.

articleTitle: Pattern Reconfigurable MIMO Antenna Based on Characteristic Mode Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A pattern reconfigurable dual-port multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna system utilizing Characteristic mode theory is proposed at 2.45GHz. By using the selective incentives of four characteristic modes, six pairs of balanced inductive exciter (BIEs) and the antenna are integrated to realize the selective incentives of the four patterns. In the feeder network, by changing the state of the PIN diode, the two ports realize selective incentive to obtain four working states. The test results show that the pattern reconfiguration technique is reliable and can be used in other types of structures.

articleTitle: Low Probability of Interception Beamforming in Single-Sideband Time-Modulated Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Low probability of interception (LPI) beamforming is investigated in a single-sideband (SSB) time-modulated antenna array (TMA). A novel LPI time modulation sequence (LPI-TMS) is proposed to simultaneously improve the LPI and continuous beam scanning capabilities of electronic systems. Based on an 8-element SSB TMA, linear frequency modulation continuous wave (LFMCW) signal transmission is performed. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed LPI-TMS can increase the signal uncertainty at undesired scanning angles, and thus reduce the possibility of exposure of signal characteristics. It indicates that the proposed technique is attractive for future LPI applications.

articleTitle: An Efficient Butterfly Algorithm-Based Method for Electromagnetic Near-Field Calculations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work we propose an efficient method to calculate the electromagnetic near-fields after the equivalent surface currents have been already obtained by method of moments (MoM). We apply the butterfly algorithm to compress the matrix and accelerate the calculation. With this approach, the near-fields calculation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> observation points can be turned into one fast matrix-vector multiplication that has computational complexity scaling as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$O(N\log^{2}N)$</tex>. Numerical examples are performed to illustrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robustness of Approximated Stratton-Chu Formulation in Solving Low Frequency Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The Stratton-Chu (SC) formulation has been applied to model the low frequency problems. With quasi-static limit, the low frequency approximation is made to the Stratton-Chu formulation which results in the decrease of the dimensions for the discretized impedance matrix. In this paper, the robustness of the approximation is well studied and analyzed with a practical nondestructive evaluation testing case. For the common conductor, we show that the approximated SC formulation works up to 50 MHz.

articleTitle: A Mode Matching Method for Efficient Evaluation of Short Backfire Antennas Loaded with Anisotropic Impedance Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a semi-analytical mode matching method (MMM) for short backfire antennas (SBFAs) loaded with anisotropic impedance surfaces (AISs) is presented. To validate our method, the electromagnetic characteristics of a SBFA loaded with AISs obtained using the MMM is compared to those calculated by a commercial full-wave solver, showing a strong agreement. The proposed method requires computational resources a few orders of magnitude smaller than commercial solvers. The superior performance demonstrates the method can be used in forward design and optimization of AIS-loaded SBFAs.

articleTitle: Low-Profile Microstrip Patch Antenna with Improved-Bandwidth by Exciting Multi-Mode of The MPA and Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A single broadband microstrip patch antenna (MPA) under small thickness is proposed by using multi-resonant modes. Initially, the linear slots in the same direction is cut on the rectangular radiator with four shorting pins. It aims to make use of TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</inf>, TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>, and TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> modes of the MPA. After that, the wideband split-ring resonator (SRR) network is applied to generate two additional resonant modes. Finally, the simulated results has formed that the relative working bandwidth of our selected antenna is obviously broadened to about 25.9% with a small thickness advantage of about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.042\ \lambda_{0}$</tex>. Moreover, it holds the almost constant beam for its normal radiation patterns.

articleTitle: Controllability Analysis of Polarization Characteristics of Scattering Elements for Reproduction Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Polarization characteristic is an important characteristic of radar target. Based on the electromagnetic modeling and calculation of foreign typical moving platform, the typical polarization characteristics of the coexistence of in-phase and orthogonal component in the return are obtained. And then combined with scattering matrix theory, it is proposed that the conventional generic scattering elements cannot reproduce the two components at the same time, and the necessity of the research on controllable polarization characteristics of scattering elements is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Test and Analysis of Electromagnetic Sensitivity Mechanism Characteristics of Motor Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the wide application of motor control systems, the performance of the motor has become more stable. However, in the face of increasingly complex electromagnetic environment, the electromagnetic compatibility problems of motor control systems become more and more severe. This article takes the motor control system composed of the stepping motor as the research object. With experimental demonstration, the electromagnetic sensitivity mechanism of the stepper motor control system under typical interference signals is studied, and the electromagnetic sensitivity threshold law and sensitivity model of the stepper motor control system are proposed. This sensitive model is related to the length of the interference time and the power of the interference signal.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Propagation Characteristics of THz Waves in The BGK Collision Model: Case of Oblique Incidence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: One-dimensional Bhatnagar–Gross–Krook (BGK) collision model for weakly electrically separated dusty plasma is established, and the attenuation (ATT) coefficient was calculated by Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) method. The results show that the larger the incident angle, the easier it is for the dust plasma to suppress the absorption of THz wave. Moreover, changing some plasma parameters has different effects on the propagation characteristics of THz wave.

articleTitle: Multiple-Resonator-Based Wideband and Multiband Microstrip Patch Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work, the multimode concept and technique for designing a class of microstrip patch antennas (MPAs) under wideband and multiband performances concluded. Firstly, the wideband linearly-polarized (LP) of the MPA could be acquired by reallocating two radiative modes with same polarization closely to each other. After that, as these radiative modes maintain orthogonal radiated fields with the sequential rotation, the bandwidth of the circularly-polarized (CP) MPA could be enhanced effectively. Additionally, when these modes maintain orthogonal radiated fields without the sequential rotation, the dual-polarized CP MPA could be consequently acquired. Most importantly, it keeps a small frequency-ratio. All of these results demonstrate that the multimode design concept of the MPAs could be well employed and applied in the low-profile and single-layer devices.

articleTitle: A Novel Pseudospectral Time Domain Method for Complex EM Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel pseudospectral time-domain algorithm, combined with the discontinuous Galerkin method, is presented to simulate electromagnetic wave propagation in large-scale complex media. Compared with the edge-/curl-conforming-based finite element method, arbitrary high-order basis function is easily achieved by utilizing the nodal basis functions; compared with the conventional pseudospectral time-domain algorithm, this new algorithm is strictly long-time stable (>300 central periods) for non-orthogonal elements, in terms of both mathematical analysis and numerical experiments. In addition, both h- and p-adaptivity are supported by using the nonconformal-mesh-based domain decomposition method. Numerical examples include 3D full-waveform modeling of 5G electromagnetic pulse propagation in a bedroom (hundreds of wavelengths in each direction) and fully anisotropic heterogenous head-electromagnetics interaction.

articleTitle: A Shared-Aperture Dielectric Resonator Antenna with Linear and Circular Polarization Diversity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a novel shared-aperture cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna (DRA) with linear and circular polarization diversity.
