A modified orthogonal coupler is designed to excite the DRA with the linear-polarization <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TM}_{01\delta}$</tex> mode at 4.6GHz by feeding Port 1, and higher modes at 5.0 and 5.7 GHz by feeding Port 2. These modes operate at dual frequencies but sharing the same aperture. Meanwhile, the circular-polarization is obtained by feeding Port 3 or Port 4 with orthogonal circular ring microstrip coupler, which provides equal amplitude and ±90° phase difference. The proposed shared-aperture DRA is verified by fabrication and measurement for its diversities on frequency and polarization. It could be a promising candidate for sub-6G indoor base station antenna.

articleTitle: An Effencient ESM Technique for Three-Dimension Radiation Source Localization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a spatial scanning method based on emission source microscopy (ESM), which extends the scanning point distribution from two-dimension (2D) plane to three-dimension (3D) volume space. A commonly used method is the planar scanning, which can determine the radiation source in the industrial field, but the increasing number of electronic devices, uneven shapes and other reasons make plane scanning difficult or require a higher price. Based on the characteristics of linear operation of ESM algorithm and Fourier transform, the three-dimensional scanning method obtained can better solve the shortcomings of planar 2D scanning. The simulation results show that under the same sampling point, the electric field data collected in three planes can also accurately locate the position of the radiation source.

articleTitle: A Numerically Stable Formulation of the Spherically Layered Media Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The spherically layered media theory is widely used in electromagnetic wave scattering problems. In the theory, the numerical computations of Bessel functions are unstable when the argument is small, the media is lossy, or the function's order is large. This paper addresses problem. We first define the renormalized reflection and transmission coefficients which have more clear physical meanings and ordinary magnitude of values. Then, logarithmic derivative of Racatti-Bessel funtions is used to calculate the renormalized single-interface reflection and transmission coefficients. Finally, recursive formulas of the renormalized multi-interface reflection and transmission coefficients are derived. In the proposed method, the stable computations of the layered media theory are simply reduced to iteratively calculate the ratio of Bessel functions of adjacent orders. The validity and stability of this method have been verified by numerical tests.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Scattering Based on Spherical Near-Far Field Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Near field antenna measurement has been widely used in many test scenarios. This provide a way to obtain the far field scattering properties of a target by using the near field data and conducting near field (NF) to far field (FF) transformation. This can avoid large measurement range requirement. In this paper, the tangential electric scattering field of the target is sampled in the simulation software on a spherical surface. Then, the scatted far field is accessed by taking the NF to FF transformation. Simulation results show that the presented method can obtain accurate scattering far field efficiently.

articleTitle: A Decoupling Method for Collinear Dipoles Based on Differential and Common Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a decoupling method that utilizes capacitive loads and an impedance transformer is proposed to suppress common mode (CM) current and hence reduce mutual coupling of collinear dipole antennas. In order to verify this method, two identical dipole antennas placed in a close proximity are analyzed and measured, and mutual coupling between them is reduced by 6–10 dB in a wide frequency range. In addition, distorted radiation patterns are also solved owing to the reduced coupling levels. This new method is suitable for the case where the space between collinear dipole antennas is very limited.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Sunny and Rainy Days on the Radiation Emission Test of Rail Transit Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The radiation emission of rail transit vehicles in operation is usually affected by environmental factors such as weather. In this paper, the radiation emission of the vehicle is tested under sunny and rainy environmental conditions, and the impact of the vehicle's radiation emission under the rainy environment is obtained by comparison. This not only helps to avoid some unfavorable factors in the test process, but also has certain reference significance for the electromagnetic protection of rail transit vehicles.

articleTitle: Dielectric Sensors With Multiple Complementary Meta-material Resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this letter, two dielectric sensors which are loaded microstrip line with multiple resonators are present, where, the first topology consists of complementary electric-LC (CELC) structure, the second topology consists of CELC and complementary split ring resonators (CSRRs). Because the interresonator coupling could improve the sensing performance to detect dielectric materials, and the second topology is preferred for sensor design. Finally, a dielectric sensor of the second topology is fabricated, and measured results meet simulation results very well.

articleTitle: Application of Eigenmode Theory to the Analysis of Low-frequency Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In a previous paper, eigenmode theory was presented for the numerical analysis of electromagnetic radiation and scattering from perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) objects. In this method, the model currents solved from surface differential equations (SDEs) are considered as complete domain basis functions of moment method (MoM). Therefore, it can greatly reduce the computational cost of the analysis of electrically large objects. In this paper, we show that eigenmode theory is also available for the analysis of low-frequency problems. Numerical results demonstrate its effectiveness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Sidelobe and Multi-beam Rotman Lens Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the design and simulation of a low sidelobe multi-beam antenna are described. Slot-coupled microstrip antennas are used as array antenna elements. The feeding circuit consists of a T-type unequal power divider and a Rotman lens. The low sidelobe characteristic (≤−23dB) of non-scanning beam is realized by using the design of T-type unequal power divider. Combining the principle of linear phased array with the principle of Rotman lens design, the miniaturization of lens network is realized, and the antenna array can generate three beams in the 5.3-5.9 GHz band.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband Low-profile Tightly Coupled Dipole Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A design of ultra-wideband, low-profile tightly coupled dipole array (TCDA) with wide-scan capability is introduced in this paper. The basic element is a planar tightly coupled dipole, and the wide-angle impedance matching (WAIM) is composed of a passive tightly coupled dipole and a split-ring resonators. The proposed TCDA achieves performance of 5.8:1 (2-11.76GHz) bandwidth with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} < 3$</tex> when scanning to ±60° in E-plane and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} < 3.4$</tex> when scanning ±45° in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex>-plane. The total profile of the antenna array is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.095\lambda$</tex> at 2GHz.

articleTitle: An efficient method in quantum radar cross section predictions of 3D complex targets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, to further promote the theory of quantum radar cross section (QRCS) to realistic complex objects, an efficient analysis method for QRCS is proposed. GPU acceleration is applied to prominently improve the efficiency of the proposed method. QRCSs of the three-dimensional (3D) complex targets are simulated, which shows great efficiency improvement.

articleTitle: The Absorbing Characteristics of plasma-filled double-layer Jaumann screen
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Jaumann screen, developed from Salisbury screen, is a typical absorbing structure, but its absorbing characteristics are fixed. In this paper, a double-layer Jaumann screen filled with plasma is proposed, and its absorbing characteristics are simulated and analyzed. Through simulation and analysis, the absorbing frequency of double-layer Jaumann screen filled with plasma can be adjusted by adjusting the parameters of plasma, and its absorbing frequency bandwidth is wider than that of traditional double-layer Jaumann screen.

articleTitle: Dual-Reject Band FSS Design Using Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a design method of dual-reject band frequency selective surface (FSS) using equivalent circuit model is proposed. Firstly, the dual-reject band filter circuit is constructed according to the requirement of resonant frequency, and then according to the known corresponding relationship between the equivalent circuit model and the FSS structure, the composition of the FSS is preliminarily determined. Finally, the original structure is optimized by optimization algorithm to achieve the goal. In this paper, two design schemes of dual-reject band FSS are given. It can be known by simulation verification that the design method proposed in this paper is very effective in the design of FSS.

articleTitle: An Efficient Stochastic HIE-FDTD Algorithm for Uncertainty Quantification of Electromagnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The stochastic hybrid implicit-explicit FDTD (S-HIE-FDTD) is proposed to quantificationally calculate the statistical variations of the electromagnetic fields. To come up with the update equations of the S-HIE-FDTD, we re-formulate the update equations of the deterministic HIE-FDTD to take the mean and the variance of the conductivity and the permittivity as inputs. The CFL condition of the proposed method only depends on the space sizes along two directions, and it uses a time step size that is larger than that of fully explicit schemes for computation domains with fine structures only in the rest of direction.

articleTitle: Hysteresis Modeling of Perovskite Solar Cells by an Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A comprehensive equivalent circuit model is developed to investigate the surface recombination, bulk recombination, shunt resistance, series resistance and the abnormal hysteresis effect for perovskite solar cells. By comparing the introduced model and the ionic drift-diffusion model, two typical capacitance expressions are summarized to characterize the hysteresis. The proposed equivalent circuit model together with typical capacitance expressions reveals the hidden device physics of solar cells, being a valuable synthesis tool for device simulation and analysis.

articleTitle: FDTD Simulations of Modulated Metasurface by Surface Impedance Boundary Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We propose an effective finite difference time domain (FDTD) simulations of two-dimensional metasurface with an effective surface impedance boundary condition (SIBC) model. The physical structures of the modulated metasurface are substituted by homogeneous surface impedances in the simulation. The number of unknowns both in transverse and longitudinal directions is reduced significantly with respect to the standard FDTD. Numerical simulations of the metasurface for electromagnetic fields manipulations with realistic meta-atoms demonstrate the validity of the proposed FDTD-SIBC method.

articleTitle: Suppressing Fake Targets On Focusing Azimuth Periodically Gapped SAR Data With SLIM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Novel requirements of radar missions, sensor geometries or interference create challenges in processing azimuth periodically gapped SAR echo. To cope with this challenge, a novel approach is presented to suppress fake targets on focusing azimuth periodically gapped Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) echo using Sparse Learning via Iterative Minimization (SLIM). The proposed approach contains phase multiplication of range Doppler domain, recovering gapped raw data via SLIM method and final focusing recovered SAR data with the Omega-K approach. The effectiveness of the presented approach is evaluated by real SAR data experiments.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional Multi-beam Conformal Antenna Based on Surface Periodic Metallic Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The corrugated metallic structure can realize effective propagation of spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) on the metal surface. In this paper, we design a helical conformal periodic metallic SSPPs waveguide based on cylindrical metal surface to realize an omnidirectional multi-beam antenna. The metallic periodic units are utilized as SSPPs along the curved metal surface to couple signal from dual waveguide ports. The omnidirectional multi-beam radiation can be realized by the guided wave and radiation characteristics of SSPPs. According to the simulation results, the proposed antenna works effectively around 9.58 GHz. The radiation pattern shows a uniform omnidirectional multi beam, in which the maximum gain reaches 3.75 dB. This proposed antenna can be mounted on metal cylindrical structure and is easy to fabricate, so it has a good potential in wireless sensing and communication fields.

articleTitle: The Scattering Characteristics of Chaff Clouds with different distribution by VRT Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the Monte Carlo method is used to calculate the RCS of chaff clouds by taking advantage of the vector radiative transport theory. Three different distributions, namely an uniform distribution and two kinds of non-uniform distributions, are introduced in terms of their free path sampling. Both the forward and backward RCS for three distributions are respectively compared in the numerical examples. It can be seen that higher RCS of uniform distribution can be obtained when compared with the non-uniform distributions.

articleTitle: Fast Simulations of Electromagnetic Scattering from Rough Surface Based on Integral Equation Domain Decomposition Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The electromagnetic scattering from rough surface is quickly simulated through the integral equation domain decomposition method (IE-DDM) in this paper. And to prevent the edge truncation effect of the rough surface, the Gaussian wave beam with the energy concentrated in the center is selected as the incident wave. Moreover, the rough surface is divided into three regions. And these three regions are separated with different intervals for the tapered plane wave. The accuracy and efficiency of the IE-DDM are demonstrated by comparing with simulations of the traditional method of moments (MoM).

articleTitle: Design of Sub-6G 150W High Efficiency Doherty Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A 150W high power amplifier (PA) with an operating frequency range of 2.3 — 2.55GHz and high efficiency feature is proposed in this paper. The load pull and source pull technology is used to determine the best input and output impedance at maximum power output point, and the broadband matching of input and output impedance is completed by the method of parallel capacitance and microstrip line. When the PA design is completed, the structural parts are designed to ensure that the PA works in a good heat dissipation state. The drain efficiency of the PA is up to 53%, and the output power is 52 dBm, what's more, the in-band gain fluctuation is less than 2dB. Within the range of 6 dB of power back-off, the PA efficiency always stays in the range of 50%∼53%. This Doherty PA can be a good candidate for sub-6 5G applications.

articleTitle: Sparse array synthesis based on Schlottmann aperiodic tiling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Antenna arrays based on aperiodic tilings have been shown to have low side lobe levels and modest bandwidths that suppress grating lobes. A perturbation technique based on Schlottmann tilings is proposed. This technique combines global optimization algorithms such as PSO, GA, and element merging methods in order to achieve a broadband low side lobe aperiodic array with minimum spacing constraints. The method merges elements to control the minimum element spacing to achieve an achievable design. This paper will take the design of an aperiodic array of Schlottmann tilings as an example, which can produce arrays with no grating lobes and low side lobe levels over wide bandwidths.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Antenna Optimization by Means of Gradient Search and Principal Components
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The paper discusses low-cost design closure of antenna structures. Our approach exploits trust-region (TR) gradient search with antenna response gradients updated by a sparse application of finite differentiation, limited to the principal components of the Jacobian matrix. Numerical results demonstrate superiority of the method over benchmark procedures: sixty percent savings are achieved compared to the reference algorithm without compromising the design quality.

articleTitle: A Single-Layered Hook-Shaped Unit Cell Design for Wideband Reflectarrays
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A single-layered hook-shaped unit cell design is presented for wideband reflectarrays. A gentle reflected phase curve is realized by varying the hook-shaped structure's length. A reflectarray containing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$23\times 23$</tex> elements and offset fed is designed and simulated. The gain and aperture efficiency at 10 GHz are 25.3 dBi and 62.8%, respectively. A 30.8% bandwidth for 1-dB gain drop is also obtained.

articleTitle: A Wideband and Wide-Scanning Irregularly Conformal Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a conformal tightly coupled dipole array with broadband is proposed. Utilization of a three-layer superstrate for better wide-scan performance and a plate-via structure for increasing coupling. In order to adapt to the irregular carrier, the conformal array is composed of antenna elements rotated by different angles. The simulation results show that the conformal array has good broadband scanning performance, with active <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} < 4.96$</tex> for working in 2.94-18GHz when scanning down to 50° from broadside.

articleTitle: A high order DGTD method for open domain problems with plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Plasma is a nearly charge neutralized ionized gas phase substance. It could either absorb the electromagnetic energy of radar wave or interrupt the communication and navigation signals. Therefore, it is crucial for plasma stealth technology and plasma sheath. A high order DGTD method is presented for modeling the complex reactions between plasma and electromagnetic wave. In this work, Drude model and an anisotropic PML is applied for expressing the dispersive characteristic of Plasma and truncate the open domain, respectively. Finally, numerical results are presented to validate the modeling capability of this method.

articleTitle: Scattering Properties for Typical Satellite in the Lower Terahertz Region
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of terahertz radar for space target detection, the radar cross sections (RCS) of typical satellite targets in the lower terahertz region is studied. A typical satellite target with rough body is established by using half edge data structure. The RCS distributions at different heights, root-mean-square, correlation lengths and different frequencies are calculated by using the hybrid method of Physical Optics method (PO), Shooting and Bouncing Ray method (SBR) and Truncated-wedge Incremental-length Diffraction Coefficients (TWILDCs). The results show that RCS is more sensitive to the fluctuation of the target surface, the frequency and incident angle in terahertz band.

articleTitle: A Novel Laser Design Based on All-dielectric Metasurface Using a Multi-scale Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A new concept of vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser(VCSEL) based on all-dielectric metasurface was presented. We adopted two layers of silicon square with subwavelength thicknesses to replace the traditional Bragg reflectors. It has smaller size, lower light threshold and higher light efficiency. This new type of compact laser is of great significance for the development of high efficiency and ultra-compact directional laser.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-Profile Wide-Angle Scanning Array Antenna Based on Artificial Magnetic Conductor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A dipole array antenna loaded with Artificial magnetic conductor is proposed in this paper. The dipole antenna is selected as the unit of the array antenna due to its small size and simple structure. The AMC is loaded below the dipole array and coaxial feed is used. Through optimization, the proposed array can achieve active <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR}< 2.8$</tex> in the required band of 398 - 402 MHz. Compared to the dipole array antenna with PEC, the unidirectional linearly polarized radiation patterns and wide-angle scanning are obtained by loading a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3 \times 8$</tex> AMC array. The total height is 7.58 mm, roughly is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.01\lambda_{0}$</tex> at 400 MHz, which achieves the characteristic of low-profile.

articleTitle: Simulating Nonlinear Terahertz Generation using Finite-Difference Time-Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Metamaterials' electromagnetic characteristics are typically local linear responses in the realm of optics. This work examines the FDTD solution of the hydrodynamic model of the free electron gas. By employing a hydrodynamic model, it is possible to study the interaction between electromagnetic waves and metal metamaterials that is nonlocal and nonlinear.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Log-Periodic Antenna For SKA LFAA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The Square Kilometer Array (SKA) is the largest international program in radio astronomy, and the main technical indexes of the Low-frequency Aperture Array (LFAA) are ultra-wideband, dual-polarization, sparse array, low cost, easy processing, low loss. A miniaturized log-periodic antenna is designed and manufactured for SKA LFAA. By bending the ordinary dipole to form a closed rectangular ring structure, the lateral size of the antenna is reduced to 80% of the ordinary log-periodic antenna. The structure, simulation method and results, engineering design of the antenna are introduced in detail. the improved design direction is proposed based on the test results of the antenna element samples, which has a strong engineering application value.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Subarrayed Linear Arrays via K-means Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a new array synthesis method for large linear arrays. Traditional large arrays usually have some challenges, such as high cost and complex feeding networks. Partitioning the large array into disjoint subarrays can effectively reduce these problems. In this paper, the K-means method and the convex optimization method are combined to effectively solve the above problems. Compared to other methods, the proposed method can obtain lower sidelobe level.

articleTitle: Graphene-based narrow band-pass frequency selective surface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel graphene-based narrow band-pass frequency selective surface is proposed. This unit mainly includes two layers of square patches and a layer of complementary cross structure. The full wave simulations show that the unit attains a high transmission amplitude with the bandwidth of 100MHz in X-band, resulting in an extremely narrow passband. In addition, the performance is verified by the equivalent circuit theory. The narrow-band characteristics of this unit is advantageous for RF filtering applications.

articleTitle: Saddle-Shaped Pattern Synthesis by Element Rotation and Phase Optimization for Linear Dipole Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The element rotation and phase optimization technique is utilized for synthesizing saddle-shaped pattern in this paper. As is known, the rotation of a dipole changes the co- and cross-polarized patterns in a given cut of the array pattern. Together with suitable phase control, it is feasible to synthesize shaped power patterns. An example of synthesizing a saddle-shaped pattern with reduced sidelobe level (SLL) and restrained cross-polarization level (XPL) is provided. The synthesized result validates the effectiveness of the proposed element rotation based technique.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Transient Thermal Simulation of Integrated Circuits and Packages
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, in order to analyze the transient thermal simulation of integrated circuits and packages, we proposed an efficient method which is based on layered finite element method (LFEM). In the process of this method, the stiffness matrix of original three-dimensional integrated circuits is reduced to that of two-dimensional layers, and can be further compressed into a single layer stiffness matrix. The results of numerical example are given to verify the efficiency and accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: A Wideband Millimeter-wave Bidirectional OAM Antenna using sequential rotation feeding
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A wideband bidirectional circularly polarized (CP) orbital angular momentum (OAM) antenna array is proposed for millimeter-wave frequency. The designed antenna array is composed of four bidirectional radiating dual-CP antenna units that rotate 90 degrees sequentially to each other in the clockwise direction. Results indicate that the left-hand circular polarization (LHCP) with a mode <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{OAM}=-1$</tex> in +z direction and right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) with a mode <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{OAM}=+1$</tex> in −z direction, over a wide impedance and 3-dB axial ratio (AR) relative bandwidth of 32.3% from 26 to 36 GHz.

articleTitle: Radio Wave Propagation Prediction for Forests in Rainy Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient parabolic equation solver is proposed to predict the radio wave propagation in forest during the rainy seasons. The method starts with considering the forest model as a mixture of plants and rain particles. Then the equivalent dielectric constant model can be used to simplify the calculation process. At last, the Split-step Fourier transform (SSFT) is used to calculate the loss of radio wave propagation in the forest. Numerical results show that this model can calculate the propagation loss of forests in rainy environment.

articleTitle: Single-beam Realization Method Based on 1-bit Reconfigurable Reflectarray
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a novel single-beam design method based on 1-bit reconfigurable reflectarray is presented. Two units with a phase difference of 180° are designed here, and arrange these two units according to a new rule. Calculate the compensation phase of the required main beam, encode the compensation phase to get the encoded matrix. According to the matrix, the PIN tube of the metal radiation unit at each position of the reflection array is controlled on and off, reconfigurable beam. The ideal single beam can be obtained without increasing the cost, and the antenna performance is optimized.

articleTitle: Research on the Electromagnetic Sensitivity Mechanism of Laser Ranging System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Laser ranging systems will be affected by electromagnetic sensitivity effects in complex electromagnetic environments, and it is difficult to determine which interference signals have the greatest impact on the system in complex electromagnetic environments. Moreover, it proves difficult to simulate a complex electromagnetic environment in an electromagnetic compatibility experiment. In view of the above problems, this paper takes the laser ranging system composed of VL53L0X laser ranging sensor module as the research object, and designs a sensitive experimental platform based on the laser ranging system. Using the experimental platform of this system, different interference signals are injected into the laser ranging system to simulate the complex electromagnetic environment. By analyzing and researching the data of experiments, the sensitivity threshold curve of the laser ranging system under different interference signals is obtained, and the sensitivity model of the laser ranging system is determined to be peak-sensitive, which means it is more sensitive to the amplitude modulation signal of the modulation depth.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-interference Radio Frequency Coding Method Based on Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the large-scale use of vehicle-mounted millimeter-wave radars, the problem of mutual interference between radars has been unavoidable. According to the working characteristics of vehicle-mounted millimeter wave radar, this paper proposes a radio frequency encoding method to solve the problem of mutual interference between radars. The encoding method is based on the two-phase modulation function of the millimeter wave radio frequency chip. When transmitting the radar signal, the phase of each signal cycle is encoded, and the signal is decoded according to the set encoding rules during reception to achieve the purpose of suppressing interference.

articleTitle: A New Downhole EWR Measurement and Communication System Based On DPSD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A new downhole electromagnetic wave resistivity (EWR) measurement and communication system based on digital phase sensitive detection (DPSD) is presented in this paper. The purpose is to solve the problem of EWR raw data measurement and wireless transmission of measurement data in the process of downhole petroleum exploration. The implementation of this system depends on the transmission of electromagnetic waves. The System uses digital system control (DSC) as the main control of the system, and combines field programmable gate array (FPGA) to realize the function of electromagnetic signal transmission, acquisition and detection.

articleTitle: Single Patch Antenna Design for Angle of Arrival Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a patch antenna is proposed to achieve Angle of Arrival (AOA) in a relatively small size. It is composed of four arms which have two states to switch from. Traditional AOA estimation system requires multiple antennas to form antenna arrays, which causes problems of mutual coupling and matching among the antennas. In this antenna design, the phase difference of tag's signal can be obtained by switching states of different arms, and further the AOA can be calculated. This antenna has the potential to be used in a variety of mobile devices and human-computer interactions.

articleTitle: A Wideband High-frequency Circularly Polarized Cross-Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel wideband circularly polarized (CP) dipole antenna operated at high-frequency band is proposed in this paper. In contrast to the traditional cross-dipole antennas which are operated at low frequency with coaxial feed and reflective cavity, the proposed cross dipole is designed on a double layered dielectric substrate and fed by the centered via on the substrate. This design contributes to the improvement of radiation performance of the dipole at high-frequency. For a more effective excitation of CP radiation pattern, a curved-delay line is attached at the corners of the sequentially rotated elements to provide an orthogonal phase difference. Through proper selection of the radius of curved-delay line and optimization of the structural parameters, impedance matching over wide-band range can be realized. The simulation results prove that the proposed antenna shows a good CP characteristics and wide bandwidth. The impedance bandwidth and the 3dB AR bandwidth are 31.58% (16∼22 GHz) and 7.14% (18.9∼20.3 GHz), respectively.

articleTitle: Design of Conical Equiangular Spiral Antenna with Wide Bandwidth and High Gain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband conical equiangular spiral antenna has been designed. The presented antenna covers an operating bandwidth of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{0}-10f_{0}$</tex>. In the design, by loading absorbing materials, the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of the antenna in the low frequency is improved, and the addition of metal cone structure increases the gain of high frequency, which makes the antenna performance improved in the whole band.

articleTitle: The Diagnosis of Planar Array Antenna Based on Pattern-Coupled Sparse Bayesian Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the increasing requirement of array antenna performance, the failure rate of array antenna is also increasing. In this paper, a pattern-coupled hierarchical Gaussian prior model is constructed by exploiting the block-sparse structure of the array under test (AUT). The model shares hyperparameters by capturing the pattern dependencies among neighboring coefficients. Thus, under the Bayesian framework, Pattern-coupled sparse Bayesian learning (PCSBL) is proposed. Besides, generalized approximate message passing (GAMP) is used to reduce the computation time. Experimental results show that this method has high precision and low computational complexity in the array fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Integrated Waveguide-to-Microstrip Transition with Power Divider at W-band
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An integrated design of waveguide-to-microstrip transition with a power divider at W-band is presented in the article. The transition and power divider is designed on the upper and lower surfaces of a quartz glass substrate. It consists of a matching patch, a resonant patch and a short plane. A microstrip power divider is integrated with the matching patch in the short plane. This makes the proposed design very compact for W-band antenna array applications. The proposed structure is investigated through full-wave simulations. Simulation results show that the integrated transition achieves an impedance bandwidth of greater than 9 GHz when the return loss below −10 dB. In addition, the total transmission loss is less than 0.4 dB in the central frequency.

articleTitle: Research on radar echo beamforming based on periodic structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, by designing the unit parameter and arrangement of the periodic structure, the control of the phase of the radar wave reflected on the surface is realized. By controlling the phase of the radar echo signal, the echo signal can obtain the required constructive or destructive interference mode, and then the control of the radar echo spatial pattern is realized, so that the echo energy points to the required direction.

articleTitle: A decoupling structure for array antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A decoupling structure of MIMO antenna system is designed. The crossed dipole structure is used in the antenna, which has better radiation characteristics while reducing the array aperture through miniaturization and artificial dielectric layer (ADL) decoupling structure. The simulation software Ansoft HFSS is used to optimize the array. The results show that the array has good isolation in the working frequency band, and the gain of the two - in - one unit is 8.5dbi.

articleTitle: W-band Slot Array Antenna with Low Sidelobe Levels Based on Gap Waveguide for Vehicle Radars and Detections
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The document was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: A Novel Higher-Order Probe Correction Algorithm for Spherical Near Field Scanning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel higher-order probe correction algorithm is introduced for the spherical near field antenna measurements. The measured signal is processed by the Fast Fourier Transform along <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varphi$</tex> direction, and then are integrated by Gaussian quadrature along <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\theta$</tex> direction, thus converting the transmission formula into a series of small matrix equations. In a virtual example simulated by FEKO, a Yagi antenna is used as a higherorder probe to measure a Taylor array. And the receiving signal is transformed by the proposed algorithm to achieve a pattern with high accuracy.

articleTitle: High Sensitivity Stress Sensor Based on Chipless RFID Tag
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a stress sensor based on chipless RFID tags is proposed. The pressure sensor is a resonant type chipless tag based on the RCS and consists of several half-wavelength C-shaped resonators etched on the dielectric support layer of varying lengths. Through stretching or compression, the identity resonant unit and the sensor resonant unit change, the sensor resonant unit according to the generated resonance frequency to obtain the size of the stretching force or compression force. Identity resonant unit generates resonant frequency, and its position on the spectrum is used as the identity information of the corresponding label, thus being recognized. Simulation results show that the stress sensor has the sensitivity of 0.316GHz/mm, and has the advantages of simple structure, independent control of sensing information and identity coding information, high sensitivity and high stability of identity information in the sensing process.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Element-Rotated Linear, Planar, and Conformal Arrays Radiating Shaped Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Radar Communication Integrated Broadband Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Radar communication integration makes radar have communication function by sharing some subsystems of radar, usually sharing RF subsystem of radar. Transceiver module is one of the main components of RF front-end of phased array radar. It uses the transmit branch of radar T / R module to transmit communication waveform. The linear characteristic of transmit branch directly determines the feasibility of its application in communication. This paper describes the working principle of the radar communication integrated common module, focuses on the influence of the performance of the transmitting channel of the module on the communication waveform, analyzes the EVM index of the transmitting channel, and gives the EVM test results of the S-band transmitting module.

articleTitle: Transition Method for Creeping Ray Tracing on NURBS Patches
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In the paper, a transition method is developed for calculation of creeping ray tracing on NURBS patches. This transition method is presented in the paper for the transitions of creeping rays between adjacent parametric surface patches when creeping rays propagate on several patches. The precision of the transition method can be proved by the calculated results.

articleTitle: An improved TDS-PO with the closed-form formulation of integrals for EM scattering problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To further improve the efficiency of the iterative hybridization of thin dielectric sheet (TDS) approximation and physical optics (PO), the closed-form formulations of integrals involved in the calculation of disturbance to TDS zone caused by the PO zone are discussed. Numerical experiments for an electromagnetic scattering problem present the capability of the improved method to reduce the computation cost.

articleTitle: A Compact Omnidirectional UHF Antenna Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work, a compact omnidirectional UHF antenna on the strength of spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) is suggested. The measured −10dB impedance bandwidths is about 10.3% which is from 832 to 922 MHz. The simulated total efficiency is greater than 80% over the operating band. Good omnidirectional pattern is observed in the measured results on the H-plane, which is in accordance with the simulated results, and a dipole like pattern is observed on the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex>-plane. It also shows that, at the resonance frequency of the antenna of 860 MHz, a compact size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$112.6\ \text{mm} \times 62\ \text{mm} \times 1 \text{mm}\, (0.323\lambda_{0}\times 0.178\lambda_{0}\times 0.002\lambda_{0})$</tex> was achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Algorithm of Explicit Newmark-FDTD and Traditional FDTD Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The Newmark method is used to discretize the subgridding numerical system, and explicit Newmark-FDTD method is obtained by employing the Neumann series to expand the inverse of the coefficient matrix. Furthermore, the hybrid algorithm of explicit Newmark-FDTD and traditional FDTD methods is employed to further improve the computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A Kalman Filter Approach to Airborne SAR Motion Compensation Integrated with the Chirp Scaling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, we consider a motion compensation scheme using Kalman filtering to airborne Synthetic Aperture Radars (SAR). The parameters to be estimated include sensor positions and sensor attitudes. We will show that Kalman filtering is superior to extract motion parameters compared with traditional methods. In addition, the particle filter may further take advantages to nonlinear Gaussian issues. Based on the parameters by a tracking filter, the Chirp Scaling algorithm integrated with motion compensation was implemented to generate target impulse response. It may provide good results to motion errors in both cross track and along track. Computer simulations demonstrate that Kalman filtering is computationally efficient and numerically accurate to airborne SAR motion compensation.

articleTitle: Study on Low-Frequency Data Learning for Inverse Scattering Problems with High Nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We study the application of low-frequency data learning method in solving inverse scattering problems (ISPs) with high nonlinearity. ISPs are usually modeled as an optimization problem, where the high nonlinearity of ISP may cause the optimization to fall into false solutions. Since the degree of nonlinearity decreases as the operating frequency decreases, a convolutional neural network (CNN) named U-net is applied to learn low-frequency (LF) data from measured high-frequency (HF) data to alleviate the nonlinearity of the inversion. The learned LF data is then used to invert an initial model for HF data inversion. As the LF model provides a rough estimate of the target, HF data inversion can largely avoid falling into local minima. Besides, the inverted model of HF data in each iteration is employed to further update the CNN, thus the accuracy of learned LF data can be improved iteratively. The effectiveness of the presented method is validated by both numerical and experimental data inversions.

articleTitle: Electron Density Inversion for Plasma Medium Based on Antenna Performance Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Plasma around an antenna will change the impedance of the antenna, which will lead to the change of antenna resonance frequency, antenna pattern, and antenna voltage standing wave ratio. In this paper, the plasma electron density was estimated by analyzing the variation of antenna performance parameters. Results indicate that the complex nonlinear relationship between plasma electron density and antenna performance parameters can be estimated by neural network method, which provide a convenient method to estimate plasma electron density.

articleTitle: Design of Metasurface with Near Couplings Based on Deep Learning Driven Space Mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Near couplings will lead to low efficiency electromagnetic waves manipulation of the metasurface. In this paper, a space mapping design framework driven by deep learning is proposed for the optimization of metasurafce with near couplings meta-atoms. The deep learning neural network is training to predict the phase of the atom accurately, in which process the near couplings of the designed meta-atoms are considered. The deep learning and the full wave simulation are employed as the coarse and fine models of the spacing mapping algorithm. Numerical results verify the effectiveness of the optimization framework.

articleTitle: Application of Multibranch Rao-Wilton-Glisson Basis Functions in Electromagetic Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The application of multibranch Rao-Wilton-Glisson (MB-RWG) basis function in analyzing electromagnetic scatterings from perfect electrically conducting (PEC) targets is presented in this paper. MB-RWG functions have the properties of RWG functions to expand surface currents. Moreover, MB-RWG functions can be defined on the boundary between two surfaces with different mesh resolutions. The branch number varies according to the mesh element sizes of two adjacent surfaces. Hence, MB-RWG functions can be flexibly used in analyzing electromagnetic targets with surface integral equations. Numerical results verified the versality of the MB-RWG basis functions.

articleTitle: Design of a Point Frequency Source Based on SRD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the increasing demand for frequency synthesizers in wireless communication, the frequency multiplier has gradually become a general solution due to its characteristics. In this paper, a point frequency source based on the step recovery diode (SRD) is designed. Firstly, the parameter characteristics of the step recovery diode are analyzed, and the component values of frequency multiplier circuit are optimized by harmonic balance method. Then, according to the output spectrum of frequency multiplier circuit, the band pass filter is designed by using the Generalized Chebyshev function. Finally, the miniaturization design is realized through the hybrid assembly process of electronic assembly and micro assembly with a small physical size, only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$40\text{mm}\times40\text{mm}\times 12.8\text{mm}$</tex>. The output frequency is 8.5 GHz, the output power is 12.01dbm, the phase noise is −115.13 dBc/Hz@1kHz and the spurious suppression is less than −85dBc, which achieve the advanced level in country and meet the technical requirements of the frequency synthesizer for the point frequency source. By the way, by changing the pass band of the band pass filter and selecting the appropriate MMIC frequency multiplier, the output band can be covered to 0.2- 40 GHz, which has a very broad application prospect.

articleTitle: Wide-Angle and Wideband 1-D Dual-Polarized Linear Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the proposed array can feature an operating frequency bandwidth of 1.7 octaves (3-5GHz), as well as a scan range up to ±60° along the array longitudinal direction for the two polarizations. The proposed design is verified by reasonable agreements between simulated and measured results of a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1 \times 20$</tex> prototype, which provides a potential solution to the dual-polarized linear array under strict requirements on large scanning range for the two polarizations, operating bandwidth, low array profile and small aperture occupation.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Substrate Gap Waveguide 3-dB Rectangular-Junction Couplers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A 3-dB rectangular-junction directional coupler is designed using integrated substrate gap waveguide (ISGW) technology. The coupler uses the odd mode and even mode of Q-TEM to phase difference of 90°. The proposed coupler has a coupling ratio of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.8\pm 0.5\text{dB}$</tex>, a phase deviation within 2.5° around 90°, above 20dB isolation and return loss from 27.8GHz to 33.2GHz centered at 30GHz.

articleTitle: A Switchable Polarization Convertor based on Active Metasurface using Varactor Diode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a switchable polarization convertor based on active frequency selective surface (AFSS) has been designed. The AFSS is composed of two rotated back-to-back C-shaped patches with two varactors loaded in the gap. The varactor diode is fed by coplanar parallel connection. The patches and metallic ground are separated by a 4 mm height air layer. The linear incident wave can be converted into cross-polarization under high voltage excitation from 5.3 GHz to 17.9 GHz. The linear incident wave can be converted into circular polarization from 4.9 GHz to 13.6 GHz without voltage biasing.

articleTitle: A Local Enhanced Sampling Strategy for Surrogate-Based Microwave Component Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel local enhanced sampling strategy is proposed for microwave component optimization in this paper. A greedy-like method is employed to increase the samples near potential optimal solutions to facilitate optimization-oriented modeling. The Ackley test function and a microwave filter are used to verify the ability of the local enhanced sampling strategy in surrogate-based optimization. It is shown that our proposed sampling method promotes the ANN model to obtain better optimization results. We also investigate the effect of numbers of layers and nodes of the ANN model on the modeling accuracy.

articleTitle: Precise design and loss analysis of millimeter wave antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a dual polarized millimeter wave antenna with double-layer grounding structure is designed. Through accurate modeling design, Accurate modeling design helps to ensure the consistency of measurement and simulation. Finally, the loss source of the proposed antenna structure is analyzed, and the method to reduce the loss is given.

articleTitle: Characteristic Mode Analysis of Neutralization Line for MIMO Antenna Designs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a novel method using characteristic modes theory (TCM) to design the neutralization line (NL) for a dual-band multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna to achieve decoupling. A properly designed arc metal NL introduces new characteristic currents which in the opposite direction to the original characteristic currents thus achieving the effect of decoupling greater than 30 dB at resonance point. Simulated results show that the impedance bandwidths of the antenna are 0.42 GHz (2.27–2.69 GHz) and 0.83 GHz (5.01–5.84 GHz) when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{11}\leq-10\ \text{dB}$</tex>, and the relative bandwidths reach 16.1% and 19.3%, respectively, which is suitable in WLAN wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Ka-Band Circularly Polarized Wideband Planar Antenna Array Element With Low Profile
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A Ka-band planar circularly polarized (CP) antenna array element with matching branches is presented in this paper. The impedance matching of the antenna is improved by a short pin and the matching branches. By adding a small disc at the feed probe, the capacitive coupling feed is obtained, and a wide bandwidth of impedance matching is achieved. The proposed CP antenna element obtains a 21.4% bandwidth for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} < 2$</tex> and a bandwidth of 21% for axial ratio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{AR}) < 3\text{dB}$</tex>. All of the above performance of this antenna is achieved with a low profile of 0.117 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda_{0} (1.2\ \text{mm},\ \lambda_{0}$</tex> is the free-space wavelength at the central operating frequency). By the simulation and measurement of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$23 \times 23$</tex> array prototype, the effectiveness of the design is verified.

articleTitle: Fast Eddy-Current Testing Model Using $\mathcal{H}$ Matrix and ACA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a method combining the adaptive cross approximation (ACA) algorithm and hierarchical (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathcal{H}$</tex>) matrix method, which further accelerates the BEM model for solving the eddy current testing problems. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathcal{H}$</tex> matrix method provides a new framework in the process, ACA algorithm makes use of its pure mathematical properties to solve the problem faster and more convenient compared with BEM. Requirement of the storage and the CPU time in each iteration, the proposed method is analyzed in details by taking the eddy current testing case as an example. We show the efficiency of the proposed fast eddy current testing model using the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathcal{H}$</tex> matrix method and the ACA algorithm.

articleTitle: Directive Shaping of Propagating Plane-Wave Fast Multipole Translation Operators
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Two methods for the directive shaping of propagating plane-wave fast multipole method (FMM) translation operators (TLOPs) are discussed and compared. In the first approach, a real windowing function as often found in signal processing is considered within the truncated Legendre-polynomial series representation of the standard FMM TLOPs. The second approach utilizes Gaussian-beam (GB) TLOPs, which are obtained from complex-source theory. Both methods achieve considerable directive shaping and side-lobe suppression of the TLOPs and allow, thus, to drop a certain amount of plane-wave samples in the numerical integration of the corresponding planewave spectra in the FMM-based evaluation of time-harmonic electromagnetic integral operators. It is found that the GB TLOPs exhibit considerably better performance than TLOPs with standard real windowing functions. This is explained based on the observation that GB TLOPs can be interpreted as windowed TLOPs with a more appropriate complex windowing function, whose magnitude can even be larger than one. In order to achieve an accurate and efficient evaluation of the relevant integral operators, both approaches for directive shaping should work with an oversampled spectral representation as compared to the standard case together with a very careful choice of all relevant parameters.

articleTitle: Design of the 2.92mm Coaxial Calibration Kit
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: It is well known that the vector network analyzer (VNA) needs to be calibrated before it can be used for testing. The calibration accuracy of the VNA mainly relies on calibration methods as well as calibration kit. In this paper, we design a 2.92mm interface standard calibration kit. The calibration kit designed in this paper can be used for the single-port OSM calibration as well as the two-pot SOLT calibration of the VNA with 2.92mm interface. Both simulations and experiments effectively verify the performance of the designed calibration kit. Meanwhile, by comparing the calibration results with R&S ZV Z229 2.92mm calibration kits, the correctness of our design is further explained.

articleTitle: On the Exact and Asymptotic Expressions for Dyadic Green's function above Impedance Surface: Vertical Dipole Case
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An exact and asymptotic expression for dyadic Green function of a vertical dipole above impedance surface is studied in this paper. Based on the single image expression for Sommerfeld integral, the vector field quantities caused by a vertical dipole placed above impedance surface are derived. In addition, the far-field asymptotic expression is presented in terms of series expansion, which provides new physical insights of the vertical dipole radiation above impedance surface.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Input Scheme for Deep-Learning Based Quantitative Microwave Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid input scheme to train U-net convolutional neural networks (CNN). This scheme combines a qualitative inversion algorithm with a non-iterative quantitative inversion algorithm. The former is used to obtain spatial information of unknown targets, and the latter is used to obtain characteristic information about the dielectric constant of the targets. Here, the direct sampling method (DSM) and Backpropagation (BP) algorithm that can realize real-time imaging are selected, and numerical simulations prove that the U-net CNN by hybrid scheme can obtain better imaging quality than the one by single BP scheme.

articleTitle: A Wide-angle Scan Terahertz Band Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a wide-angle scan phased array architecture operated at terahertz band is proposed. The proposed design has features of grate lobe free, low mutual coupling, easy thermal management and engineering realization. Full wave analysis is carried out to verify the proposed architecture.

articleTitle: An Easy-to-Integrate SUB-7G Dual-Polarized Broadband Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the working characteristics of dual-polarized broadband antenna is briefly introduced, and a dual-polarized broadband patch microstrip antenna that works in the SUB-7G frequency band by coupling feed is simulated. The measurement results of S-parameters, directivity and gain of the two polarized ports are very ideal. Finally, a bandwidth of about 1GHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Parallel magnetotelluric modeling with Spectral Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Improving the accuracy and speed of forward performance is of great significance to the effective application of numerical simulation. This paper studies the magnetotelluric forward based on spectral element method (Spectral Element Method, SEM). The second order partial differential equation satisfied by electromagnetic field is used as governing equation, and the electromagnetic field is interpolated by high order basis function. The distribution of electromagnetic field and apparent resistivity is obtained by solving linear equations with bicgstab. In order to further improve the calculation speed, the parallel calculation of multiple frequency points is realized by OpenMP programming mode.

articleTitle: Far-field calculation of NEMP simulator near ground by transfer function
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The paper discusses how to predict the field far away from simulator near the ground only by measured near field and calculation without re-measurement. An inverse derivation method is adopted. Firstly, the near-field waveform without ground, the far-field and its mirror point waveform can be obtained through numerical simulation, and the transfer function between near-field and far-field without ground is established. Then, the plane wave obliquely incident on the ground is decomposed into a wave perpendicular to the incident plane and a wave parallel to the incident plane. After taking into account the ground reflection coefficient, the scattered waves of the two kinds of polarized waves can be obtained, and the estimated field value at the specified point can be obtained by superposition with the direct wave.

articleTitle: A Single-Layer Dual-Band Shorted-Patch Antenna with Same Circularly Polarization Based on Multi-Resonant Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A shorted-patch antenna (SPA) towards dual-band and circularly-polarization (CP) is proposed. Initially, several modes are selected to require the orthogonal electric-field components for CP generation. Next, the short pins are inserted below the rectangular patch to turn up TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,1/2</inf> mode closely to TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,1/2</inf> mode. Besides, a narrow rectangular slot is properly etched on the top-layer of the SPA to move down TM3,3/2 mode in proximity to TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,3/2</inf> mode. In addition, an annular slot is properly etched around the feeding port for good impedance matching. Finally, the results illustrate that its effective bandwidth <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\vert S_{11}\vert <-10\text{dB}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AR} < 3 \text{dB}$</tex>) is held around 1.19% (2.684-2.716 GHz) in low frequency band and 1.05% (5.683-5.743 GHz) in high frequency band. Additionally, the proposed SPA achieves CP radiation performances in dual bands, while keeping low-profile, single feeding and single-element properties.

articleTitle: A facet method for EM backscattering from high-state sea surface with foam
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To obtain the electromagnetic (EM) backscattering from high sea state and super electrically large sea surface, facet method based on integral equation method (IEM) is proposed in this paper. Aiming at the phenomenon of sea surface foam under high sea state, this paper adopts the idea of surface facet and determines the dielectric constant of sea surface facet according to the foam distribution. For the non foam area, IEM is directly used. For foam area, foam is regarded as a layered medium. The EM scattering echo of sea surface in foam area is calculated by using IEM based on multilayer medium calculation method. Finally, the EM backscattering echo of the whole high sea area is obtained by facet method. Through simulation, it is found that the EM scattering coefficient of sea surface in foam area is larger than that in non foam area, and the echo of the whole area increases with the increase of wind speed.

articleTitle: An Asynchronous Parallel Implementation of Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm on GPU Cluster for 3D Electromagnetic Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a CPU/GPU asynchronous computing pattern based improved parallel multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) for 3D electromagnetic scattering problems on GPU Cluster. In the presented parallel implementation, the matrix assembly process of the MLFMA is decomposed into CPU execution and GPU execution two parts. The former is performed on CPU using OpenMP multi-threading programming model, while the latter is performed on GPU with CUDA programming model. The execution time between the two parts is overlapped by using the feature of asynchronous execution between CPU and GPU. The performance of the proposed parallel implementation is investigated in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Numerical results show that, with the proposed parallel approach, over 10% speed-up can be attained, compared with the original parallel implementation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and analysis of SAR image for lunar surface based on DEM data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Based on Digital Elevation Model (DEM) of lunar surface, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging is performed by using electromagnetic calculation method of Advanced Integral Equation Model (AIEM). The SAR image quality was evaluated by using the no-reference mode, and the imaging indexes (u, std and E) of the AIEM are verified to be of high performance. These indicators shows that performance of the average brightness, gray dispersion and information richness significantly better than the Improved Integral Equation Model (IIEM). Considering various indicators, the AIEM method has considerable advantages in the study of random rough terrain.

articleTitle: A Fast Algorithm for Computing Fields of a Vertical Magnetic Dipole in a Dissipative Half-Space
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm of computing the fields generated by a vertical magnetic dipole in a dissipative half space. The specific wave called the lateral wave along the interface of two half spaces is discussed. The expressions of field components are obtained with the spectral domain method. One term is extracted from the original solution and the remaining terms can be evaluated analytically. In the far region, the extracted term has small contribution to the field solution and can be ignored. The extracted term has fast convergence rate when calculated numerically in the near region. Some numerical results of the fields of a vertical magnetic dipole in the sea are given to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Flexible Multiplexing of High-order Poincaré Sphere Beams with Reflective Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a new methodology to realize flexible multiplexing of high-order Poincaré sphere beams by a reflective spin-decoupled metasurface is proposed. By integrating geometric phase and propagation phase, the proposed metasurface can offer more potential in controlling the vector vortices, addressing the problem of topological charge correlation that exists in metasurface with only geometric phase. As the design example, we present that two off-axis high-order Poincaré sphere beams can be achieved by a single metasurface in microwave region. The results pave a way for generating versatile vector vortices using spin-decoupled metasurface.

articleTitle: A Dual-Model-Base Adaptive Sampling Method for Fast Computation of Broadband Scattering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A dual-model based adaptive sampling method is proposed for calculating the broadband electromagnetic scattering fast and accurately. An adaptive scheme is used for generate sampling frequency points adaptively. Both the rational function and the cubic-spline (CS) models are applied in the scheme for interpolating the frequency sweep curve. The induced current at frequency samples is computed by the method of moment (MoM) and accelerated by multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA). The induce current at other frequency points is evaluated by the proposed dual-model adaptive sampling strategy. The final numerical results demonstrate that the adaptive algorithm enable to obtain the broadband radar cross section (RCS) curve with high-precision and reduce the computation time significantly.

articleTitle: A High-Voltage Power Supply Design and Electromagnetic Compatibility analysis of THz Power Module
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: As a crucial part of the Terahertz microwave power module (TPM), electronic power conditioner (EPC) needs to operate with high switching frequency and provide high-voltage output. This paper proposes a power supply design to meet the needs of EPC, featuring series-resonant full-bridge converter, realizing about 22 kV voltage output. The feasibility of the design was verified by simulation. From the perspective of ripple voltage and voltage spikes, the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) issues inside the module have also been analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Periodic Medium Structure on Shielding Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the ground surface is equivalent to a multi-layer structure of two lossy media (such as dry soil and wet soil). Four different periodic dielectric layers are investigated, and their radio wave shielding effectiveness is analyzed and evaluated by the propagation matrix method. In view of the main structure factors such as the thickness of different dielectric layers and the arrangement of different dielectric layers, the shielding effectiveness of different dielectric layer structures in the frequency band of 300MHz is explored. The results show that the layered structure represented by structure c exhibits better shielding effectiveness in different situations, indicating that the more layers and thickness of the strong lossy medium, the better the shielding effectiveness. At the same time, this arrangement of the strong lossy dielectric layer and the weak lossy dielectric layer has the best increase effect on the shielding effectiveness compared to structures a, b, and d.

articleTitle: Parallel SDIE Method Based on CFIE and IBC for Electromagnetic Scattering Analysis of Large-Scale and Nonuniform Coated Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Partly and nonuniform coated objects are one type of important targets in electromagnetic (EM) engineering, and their EM scattering characteristics are an aspect of great concern. To efficiently formulate the EM scattering problem of objects with partial nonuniform coating, we propose a new self-dual integral equation (SDIE) by combining the impedance boundary condition (IBC) and the combined field integral equation (CFIE) in a special way. Besides, the discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method is employed to discretize the new SDIE, which can effectively and flexibly deal with the problem of discontinuous surface impedances from nonuniform cases. Numerical experiments have proved the proposed DG-C-SDIE has much more stable convergence than existing integral equation methods for partly IBC objects while ensures high accuracy. To apply DG-C-SDIE method to analyze electrically large coated objects, we hereby further introduce a high-efficiency parallel algorithm of multilevel fast multipole based on MPI and OpenMP schemes to fast solve the matrix equation. With the aid of advanced computers, the parallel DG-C-SDIE method has the ability of dealing with large-scale objects with hundreds of wavelengths.

articleTitle: Study on SAR Imaging of The Targets Coated with Plasma Sheath
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the far-field echo from plasma coated targets is calculated with SO-FDTD (Shift operator finite difference time domain) method when irradiated by a modulated Gauss impulse waveform. And based on the echo data, the synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging of the plasma coated targets were studied with various plasma characteristics and radar incident waveform. The effect of electron density and collision frequency on imaging quality have been summarized in this paper.
