And other parameters, such as radar angle width, view width and center frequency will be reported in the following papers.

articleTitle: Conceptual Study of Tri-beam Spacebrone SAR
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Multi-temporal synthetic aperture radar interferometry (MT-InSAR) is used for many application in earth observations. Conventional SAR missions with single beam only detect deformation along the line of sight and relative elevation due to the undetermined model of phase wrapping. In this paper, a tri-beam spaceborne SAR mission is introduced to overcome the limitation of the relative measurements. Using multi-view measurements, it is possible to detect 3-D deformation and derive 3-D surface model from a single satellite platform. A multi-dimensional coherent scattering model is used to simulate the multi-temporal SAR data with different viewing angles. The results of this study indicate that the tri-beam SAR is able to measure 3-D deformation and reconstruct 3-D surface model without ground control point.

articleTitle: 3D Printed Wideband Coaxial Wilkinson Divider
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper combines 3D printing technology (3DPT) with microwave components to obtain better performance than traditional fabrication. Here presents a single-layer and a multi-layer coaxial wideband Wilkinson power divider working at 1 GHz with a third-octave bandwidth. The size of the single-layer structure is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$75 \times 88\times 15\ \text{mm}^{3}$</tex> as a reference. Then, the multi-layer one is introduced to achieve miniaturized characteristic under folding topology, whose size is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$45\times 76\times 23\ \text{mm}^{3}$</tex>. The isolations between the outputs are better than 20 dB and the insertion loss of each port is around 0.2 dB over the operating band. The performance hardly deteriorates with almost half size reduction via 3DPT.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of radiation performance of IR coating at high temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The IR coating was designed based on one-dimensional photonic crystal technology, and the coating samples were prepared on polyimide film. The radiation characteristics of the samples were tested, and the effects of temperature and material lattice constant on the infrared spectral properties were discussed. The thermal stability of the samples was preliminarily verified by microscopic phase analysis.

articleTitle: An Optimized Method of Low RCS Carrier Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Due to the strong scattering intensity of the apex of the carrier, a scheme of rounding the apex of the carrier is proposed. In this design, it is embodied in face fillet and line fillet. Based on the above designs, this paper compares the smooth transition with the sharp transition carrier, and draws a general conclusion about the low scattering carrier design method.

articleTitle: Design of Frequency Selective Radome based on Pyramid Lattice Sandwich Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The organic combination of sandwich structure and frequency selective surface technology can provide strong support for the design of lightweight and high-strength radome. This paper optimizes the structural media parameters on the basis of the existing pyramid lattice structure, and designs a frequency selective surface, which is combined with the lattice structure to form a lattice structure frequency selective radome, which forms a pass-band at 2.41GHz–3.17GHz, 8GHz–12GHz forms a stop band, and the pass-band transmission rate is over 90%, and the stop-band attenuation is less than −10dB. In this paper, the patch antenna and frequency selective radome are jointly simulated to verify that the frequency-selective radome designed in this paper meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Undulating terrain modeling for magnetotelluric based on COMSOL
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Undulating terrains distort the magnetotelluric(MT) response, and cause misinterpretation for field data. Topographic correction aims to reduce this effect and is important for improvement the quality of MT data. In this paper, we used the second-order Maxwell's equation as the governing equations, digitized the topography into a parameterized surfaces, and then solved the linear system to attain the distribution of electromagnetic reponses. The simulation results of models with and without undulating terrains were compared. We analyzed the topography influences on 3D magnetotelluric response, and implemented topographic corrections using “ratio method”. The method was shown to be available for eliminating effects of topography.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Mechanical Beam-Scanning Reflectarray With Fixed Feed Position
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This work presents a design of dual-band reflectarray antenna with beam-scanning capabilities. First, the scanning mechanism is analyzed using theoretical formulations. Then a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$25 \times 25$</tex>-element reflectarray antenna operating at 1.575 GHz and 2.4 GHz are designed and simulated. The simulated results demonstrate that scan angle as wide as 60° can be achieved, which validates the introduced beam-scanning method.

articleTitle: Design of A Dielectric Dome Lens Antenna With 80° Scanning Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an axis-symmetrical dielectric dome lens (DDL) with a phased array antenna (PAA) feed operating in 28GHz is proposed based on the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. After careful optimization, the 80° scanning ability which is difficult to come true by using traditional PAA is obtained. During the optimization, the Vivaldi PAA (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 8$</tex>) which can scan down to 60° in both E-plane and H-plane is designed to illuminate the DDL.

articleTitle: Accuracies of Channel Emulation Methods for Sectored Multi-probe Anechoic Chamber
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The three-dimensional (3D) sectored multi-probe anechoic chamber (MPAC) configuration has been seen as a promising solution of over-the-air (OTA) testing of large array systems. The prefaded signal synthesis (PFS) channel emulation method emerged to be better than the plane wave synthesis (PWS) channel emulation method for 3D sectored MPAC system. Yet, the PWS has been proven to be more accurate than the PFS for 2D MPAC. To explain these seemingly contradicting findings, these two channel emulation methods are investigated in this paper. It is found that the PWS method exhibits better performance than PFS method only when the number of active probes becomes sufficiently large, whereas the PFS is more robust to the undersampling due to limited active probes in practical 3D sectored MPAC system.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Boundary Scheme For Reducing Rectangular Waveguide Cutoff Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a perfect electric conductor-perfect magnetic conductor (PEC-PMC) hybrid boundary scheme is proposed to reduce the cutoff frequency of the certain rectangular waveguide. An analytical formula of the cutoff frequency of the PEC-PMC rectangular waveguide is derived and the simulation results indicate the accuracy of the formula. The cutoff frequency is greatly reduced by adding the PMC on its bottom surface.

articleTitle: Introducing Incident Plane Wave into DGTD Grid by 1D-DGTD Propagator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The Discontinuous Galerkin Time Domain (DGTD) method has been extensively studied in the calculation of radar cross-section (RCS) of objects, where introducing plane waves into computational domain plays a vital role. In this paper, we use the one-dimensional DGTD propagator instead of one-dimensional FDTD propagator to produce the plane wave, so that the leakage of incident wave into the scattered field region is greatly suppressed.

articleTitle: A 9:1 Bandwidth Low-Profile Tightly Coupled Dipole Array with Compact Matching Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An ultra-wideband low-profile tightly coupled dipole array is proposed in this paper. The antenna element is fed through a folded divider to achieve a low-profile characteristic. A Marchand balun is employed to accomplish the transformation of unbalanced feeding ports and unmatched impedance, simultaneously. A resistive sheet (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$200\Omega$</tex> /square) is utilized to widen the operation bandwidth. Besides, the element contains a wide angle impedance matching layer (WAIM) for a broader scan angle. Simulation results show that this antenna can operate within a 9:1 bandwidth (2-18GHz) with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{VSWR} < 3.3$</tex>, and ±45° scan in E- and H-plane with a relatively high radiation efficiency. The overall profile is 12.4mm (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.74\lambda_{\text{high}}$</tex>), which makes the antenna suitable for the application of special radar platforms.

articleTitle: Numerical Studies of Dielectric Breakdown during High-Power Operation Based on SETD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Under the high-power microwave (HPM) field irradiation, bound charges can break free and a part of an insulator becomes electrically conductive, which may lead to dielectric breakdown. In this paper, a dielectric breakdown process is controlled by three-dimensional (3D) full-wave Maxwell's equations. The conductivity model of the nonlinear change caused by HPM irradiation is embedded into the Maxwell' equations, which makes its nonlinear. The SETD method with fixed-point and leapfrog iteration is hired to solve nonlinear equation. The numerical results show that physical mechanism of dielectric breakdown and nonlinear effect can be captured accurately during HPM propagation. Our research is beneficial for the HPM devices protection.

articleTitle: A Nonlinear Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering Method Based on Hierarchical Bayesian Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Nonlinear electromagnetic inverse scattering problem requires the simultaneous calculation of two mutually coupled field integral equations, which makes it difficult to effectively reconstruct the target. In this paper, a hierarchical Bayesian model containing the contrast current density is constructed, and the variational Bayesian inference (VBI) method is introduced to calculate the posterior probability function. Experimental results show that this algorithm has reliable performance in a two-dimensional complex scene, and meanwhile it has strong robustness to noise.

articleTitle: A Research on 3-D point clouds reconstruction of SAR images driven by electromagnetic scattering mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: 3-D reconstruction of the ground target has great significance in automatic target monitoring, urban safety and other fields. Besides, it is a hot research topic in computer vision, photogrammetry and remote sensing. Unlike optical imaging, SAR imaging mechanisms are of great complexity, which brings many challenges for information extraction and interpretation of SAR images. Thus, the current 3-D reconstruction methods are not precious enough to recover the detailed outlines of the ground target and new precious methods need to be developed. In recent decades, the research on scattering modeling of targets has developed from attribute scattering center models to geometric scatterer parametric models, which greatly improves the target scattering feature extraction and provides a new idea for the 3-D target reconstruction. Combining the geometric scatterer parametric models with convolutional neural networks, this paper proposes a 3-D target reconstruction network of SAR images based on 3-D point clouds. Through a reconstruction experiment, the effectiveness of the algorithm is validated. The method to construct this network shows a new research exploration for target 3-D target reconstruction of SAR images, and provides a reference for 3-D target reconstruction.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband RCS Reduction Based on Chessboard Surface and Active FSS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An ultra-wideband radar cross section (RCS) reduction technique based on phase interference cancellation and tunable absorption is proposed. The specific structure consists of a chessboard surface and an active frequency selective surface (AFSS) absorber. The chessboard on the top layer is constructed of square loop and circular patch unit cells, which can realize a destructive phase interference performance in higher frequency, while the bottom AFSS absorber achieves a tunable absorption in lower frequency range. Full-wave simulation results indicate that the designed combined structure can obtain a controllable ultrawideband RCS reduction more than 10 dB from 4.4 to 36.5 GHz, compared to metallic plate with the same dimension.

articleTitle: A Physics-Informed Neural Network for RRAM modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Modeling of RRAM devices has been challenging due to the existence of the flux-dependent internal variables. Extra differential equations or capacitive circuits are often needed to model the evolution of the internal state variable and its impacts on the device responses, rendering the RRAM model difficult to develop and slow to evaluate. In this work, we propose a simple yet viable alternative to build steady-state RRAM compact models using physics-informed neural networks that do not involve internal state components. The central idea is to utilize a sequence of currents that are generated before as inputs, to account for the effect of the flux history that affects the current under the present voltage. The accuracy of the proposed model is applied to and verified by experimentally measured data.

articleTitle: Non-linear Heat Conduction Inversion Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning (DL) framework is proposed to predict the heat flux based on temperature, solving inverse heat conduction problems (IHCPs) without limitations to the models and physical boundaries. Inverse heat conduction models can be either regular geometries, such as cuboids, or irregular structures which may contain curved surfaces. Besides, the physical boundaries and thermophysical parameters can be non-linear. To achieve precise approximation, medium-scale data sets are sufficient in training the neural network. We believe this work offers great potential for applications pertaining in inverse heat conduction problems.

articleTitle: Fast Wideband RCS Analysis of Large-Scale Finite Periodic Structures Using MB-CBF Method and Rational Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An efficient wideband scattering analysis method for the large-scale finite periodic structures is proposed by combining the macro block-characteristic basis function (MB-CBF) method with the rational interpolation. A reduced matrix equation can be obtained using the MB-CBF method. The matrix elements have to be recalculated if used for broadband response analysis. Generation of the matrix elements is accelerated by introducing the rational interpolation. Numerical simulation results demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Treble-Linear Basis Functions for Solving the Volume Integral Equation on Inhomogeneous Anisotropic Bodies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To reduce the error of method of moments for solving volume integral equation (VIE), in this paper, the treble-linear (TL) basis function is put forward. In the analyzing of scattering problems on three-dimensional bodies, TL basis functions' performance is more excellent than SWG basis functions because it describes the current properly. The numerical experiments show that TL basis functions can maintain accuracy with coarser mesh.

articleTitle: Enabling Efficient Unidirectional Forward Scattering via Metal-dielectric Heterodimer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Highly efficient unidirectional forward scattering is achieved via metal-dielectric heterodimer configuring, exhibiting a high forward-to-backward scattering ratio (≈ 48 dB) and a remarkable enhancement on the forward scattering intensity. Such a superior scattering performance is achieved via satisfying the first Kerker condition around the resonance peak of dimer. Based on our previous developed generalized dipole-dipole interaction model, the underlying mechanism is attributed to the coherent interference between the metal surface plasmon resonance and dielectric Mie resonances.

articleTitle: Pattern-Reconfigurable Antenna With Three Switchable Beams Based on Graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, a beam switchable pattern-reconfigurable antenna (PRA) using the adjustable impedance property of graphene is presented. The PRA consists of two dipoles and a Vivaldi antenna with the feed line on the other side of the substrate. To realize dynamical manipulation of radiation beam, three graphene pads are set on the feed line. By electrically controlling the graphene nanoplates, the beam can be switched to three directions: −90°, 0° and +90°. The results show that the PRA antenna operates at 5.8GHz with gain of 2.15dB, 5.73dB and 1.37 dB in three directions respectively. Moreover, the state at the 0° covers a wide band of 5.1-9.3GHz.

articleTitle: A Multilayer Microstrip Printed UWB LPDA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A multilayer microstrip design of ultra-wideband (UWB) log-periodic dipole antenna (LPDA) printed on dielectric plate is presented. The proposed design consists of array of printed dipoles fed by a dual-wire transmission line. Then the dual-wire transmission line is fed with a SMP connector. The dimensions of the dipoles and the spacing between each element are optimized by parametric simulations using full wave simulator. The size of the fabricated LPDA is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$61\times 62\text{mm}^{2}$</tex>. The LPDA has 9 octave bandwidth which covers the band from 2 GHz to 18 GHz. This LPDA has excellent radiation pattern performance from 2GHz to18GHz.

articleTitle: 3-D Wide-band Global Scattering Center Modeling Based on SBR and Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a method of 3-D wide-band global scattering center (SC) modeling has been proposed based on shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) and clustering techniques. Firstly, the whole 2-D angle domain is divided into small cells, in each of which a wide-band 3-D SC model has been created by combining Bhalla's method and Geometrical Theory of Diffraction (GTD) model where the frequency-dependence factor is calculated forward. Moreover, in order to promote the ability of frequency extrapolation, a SC location correction algorithm is used. Secondly, a spectral multiple manifold clustering algorithm is used to correlate the SCs from different angles to establish the global SC model. This method can give a more sparse representation than the method of narrow-band and non-global modeling.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo method for studying the transmission properties of electromagnetic waves in dusty plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, the Mie theory and dyadic Green method are used to calculate the Mie scattering cross section and Debye scattering cross section. the Mie-Debye coherence cross section formed by the two scattering fields. Using the scattering cross section of a single particle model combined with Monte Carlo method to calculate and analyze the propagation characteristics of electromagnetic waves in dusty plasma.

articleTitle: An improved optical convolution process in spiral phase contrast imaging based on FrFT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Spiral phase contrast (SPC) imaging proves to be an important and convenient approach for edge enhancement in image processing. Due to the limited size of the spiral phase filter and other optical elements, convolution kernel involved may be about the same size as the object image, which leads to serious degradation in resolution especially when the object is small in size. In this letter, a fractional Fourier transform (FrFT) optical setup is proposed to allow a kernel with arbitrarily small size, and hence to an enormous degree improves the brightness, contrast and resolution of the SPC imaging method.

articleTitle: Research on Radio Wave Propagation Prediction Model using 3-D Parabolic Equation over Rough Sea Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The parabolic equation is the main method to predict the propagation of radio waves in the marine environment. The rough sea surface model based on a two-scale roughness method is built in the paper. At the same time, the path losses of this rough sea surface under different propagation conditions are calculated using the three-dimensional parabolic equation (3DPE) method. The results show that the path loss using the 3DPE method changes under different wind directions. When the wind speed over the sea surface is high, the radio waves of propagation direction are greatly interfered by the surrounding electromagnetic fields. Therefore, the effect of sea breeze on radio wave propagation can be accurately reflected using this 3DPE method.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Reconfigurable Rasorber for Intelligent Electromagnetic Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A miniaturized reconfigurable rasorber which is applied for intelligent electromagnetic protection is presented. The structure consists of a upper resistive layer, an air layer and a reconfigurable bandpass layer. In order to realize the miniaturization design of the unit-cell, the four arms of the resistive metal ring on the upper layer are folded as a composite S-shape. The unit-cell dimension of the FSR is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.066\lambda_{0} (\lambda_{0}$</tex> is the wavelength of the minimum frequency of the absorption band in free space). PIN diodes are symmetrically mounted on the lower band-pass structure to achieve the reconfigurability of shield and band-pass mode from 3.22 to 4.5 GHz. The insertion loss in 3.67-4.15 GHz is less than 3 dB in band-pass mode and the minimum insertion loss reaches 0.41 dB at 3.88 GHz. The proposed structure can maintain wave absorption at both the two modes in 1-2.6 GHz, with reflection coefficient S11 of less than −10 dB and transmission coefficient S21 of less than −15dB. At the meanwhile, the FSR with a symmetrical design has the characteristic of polarization insensitivity. The proposed structure can be applied for intelligent electromagnetic protection of modern electronic systems.

articleTitle: Progress and prospective of electromagnetic periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Periodic structures have attracted interests of researches for decades, and they were discovered more and more useful properties, and have been applied to many fields. Furthermore, more and more novel concept and phenomena based on periodic structures were proposed and found, such as tunable electromagnetic properties of some structures. In this paper, recent progress on two of the periodic structures, i.e., FSS and metamaterials and their variations, were revie, and the physical nature of these structures analog to materials were also suggested.

articleTitle: Characteristic Mode Inspired Circular Polarization Antenna Using Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This article designs a circular polarization antenna using metasurface by characteristic mode analysis. By solving the metasurface structure's characteristic modes and exciting two orthogonal characteristic modes, circularly polarized antenna can be achieved. The dimension of the metamaterial antenna is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$35\ \text{mm} \times\ 35\ \text{mm} \times\ 4\ \text{mm}$</tex>. The simulation S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>bandwidth of 10 dB return loss is 5.7-6.7 GHz. And axial ratio bandwidth of 3 dB is 5.8-6.7 GHz, with left-hand circular polarization.

articleTitle: Fast Prediction of Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics of Targets Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to solve the problem that traditional numerical method can not meet the requirement of high dynamic multi-target RCS prediction in a short time, this paper introduces the deep learning method, and proposes a novel idea of “generate ahead of time, call on site”. By constructing the deep learning model, the RCS simulation results of the target under different influence factors are taken as the training set of the deep learning model. Finally, the target RCS is predicted by the test set. Through analysis, the mean absolute error (MAE) of the proposed method for single and two triangular pyramid models is less than 1dB and 6dB respectively, and the prediction time is within 0.6s. The results show that the proposed method is effective for fast prediction and analysis of multi-target electromagnetic scattering characteristics.

articleTitle: TPC Members
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members and society officers.

articleTitle: Welcome Message
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Presents the introductory welcome message from the conference proceedings. May include the conference officers' congratulations to all involved with the conference event and publication of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Solving Electromagnetic Scattering From Dielectric Problems by PMCHWT-SASF
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a fast direct solver based on strong admissibility skeletonization factorization (SASF) and Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai (PMCHWT) is proposed for electromagnetic scattering from conducting objects. Different from weak admissibility skeletonization scheme, the proposed method constructs the sparse-data representation, in which interactions of well-separated groups are compressed by low-rank algorithm. As a result, the approximation rank is relatively small, and the computational efficiency will have significant improvement. Subsequently, SASF is applied to the compressed system matrix. The system matrix can be factorized into products of a series of block unit triangular matrices and a block diagonal matrix. The arising fill-in blocks corresponding to far-field interactions are compressed and eliminated by a novel and efficient method to maintain the high efficiency and accuracy of the factorization procedure. The computational complexity and storage requirement of proposed factorization scale as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$O(N^{1.5})$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$O(N\log N)$</tex>, respectively. Several numerical results are presented to demonstrate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of A Self-Diplexing Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A design of self-diplexing cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is presented in this paper. The DRA is based on ceramic material. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{HEM}_{11\delta}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TM}_{02\delta}$</tex> modes of the cylindrical DRA are excited by differential feeding and a metal probe respectively. A stub is adopted to suppress spurious modes of HEM and improve the isolation of the two input ports. The results show that, within two frequency bands 2.73-3.05 GHz and 6.19-6.52 GHz, the proposed antenna achieves good impedance matching (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert S_{11}\vert < 10\ \text{dB}$</tex>), and isolation (>26 dB). The proposed self-diplexing DRA could be appllied in modern wireless communication.

articleTitle: Wideband Conformal Antenna Integrated with Lens for Implantable Capsule System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a conformal antenna integrated with lens for wireless capsule endoscopy applications. Flexible and biocompatible material polyimide is used as capsule wall for human safety issues. To save the inner space of capsule, the proposed antenna is placed inside the capsule, with its radiation patch attached to the capsule cap in conformal form. Besides, the radiation patch is designed in bowtie shape, with one arm shorted to the ground and the other arm fed by coaxial cable. In this way, quarter wavelength resonance is realized with wide bandwidth. Additionally, to meet the application requirement, a hemispherical lens is taken into consideration and placed in capsule cap below the antenna patch. Finally, the simulation result shows that a wide bandwidth of 97.9% can be obtained of this integrated design.

articleTitle: A Ka-Band Power Amplifier With 14.2-dBm Power in 65-nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper introduces a Ka-band power amplifier with 14.2-dBm Power. Multiple transformer-based matching networks are introduced to realize broadband matching and high power output. A 26–35GHz power amplifier is realized in a standard 65 nm CMOS process. The amplifier achieves 16.8 dB small signal gain, 14.2-dBm output 3-dB compression point (P3dB), and 11.8-dBm output 1-dB compression point (P1dB). The simulated input and output return losses within the operation band are −6dB and −9dB in the worst case, respectively.

articleTitle: A Method for Modeling Electromagnetic Coupling to Randomly Wiring Multiconductors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The random wiring factors of complicated multiconductors makes the electromagnetic compatibility(EMC) analysis of the entire vehicle very intractability. Therefore, this paper presents a reduced modeling method to evaluate the electromagnetic(EM) coupling to the vehicle multidonctors. A model of 9-transmission lines with random wiring in the vehicle is constructed to validate the proposed technique by full wave simulation. The proposed method reduces the complexity of modeling the whole multiconductors significantly with a good accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of a miniaturized and broadband embedded communication antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized and broadband embedded communication antenna has been designed. In the design, miniaturization was achieved by top-loading metal disc and short-circuit columns. The bandwidth of the design is more than 25%. The H-plane gain is more than −2dBi, and the horizontal gain roundness is less than 3dB.

articleTitle: Iterative Solution for SIE Based on Domain Decomposition Method for Scattering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an iterative approach based on the domain decomposition method is proposed to accurately and efficiently solve the electromagnetic scattering problems, which is based on the fact that the electromagnetic coupling effects are results of the countless scattering and radiation of electromagnetic waves among multiple objects. It is found that the proposed formulation is equivalent to the Jacobi iteration of the original problem, which can mathematically guarantee its convergence. Then, two numerical examples are carried out to validate the effectiveness of this formulation.

articleTitle: Design of An Axial Mode Helical Antenna Using Ferrite and Dielectric Loading
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An axial mode helical antenna loaded with magneto-dielectric ferrite and dielectric polyethylene terephthalate (PET) is presented. The helical antenna radiation is circular polarization over a wide frequency range and the volume reduction of helical antenna is 37.5% in contrast with air-core antenna. Moreover, by adjusting the proportion between ferrite and PET, the helical antenna obtains impedance bandwidth of 86.8% from 1.76 to 4 GHz, 3 dB axial ratio bandwidth of 50% from 2.4 to 4 GHz, and a maximum realized gain of about 8.8 dBi.

articleTitle: Simulation for the Electromagnetic Scattering from the 3D Advancing Breaking Waves
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Based on the hydromechanics model, a simulation for the electromagnetic scattering from the 3D advancing breaking waves is proposed in this paper. The geometry of the breaking waves at various times is collected by a two-step computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation. The multiple scattering from the wave crest is calculated by the forward-backward iterated physical optics (FBIPO) methods. The simulation results show the diversity of the structure and electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the breaking waves.

articleTitle: Dual-Polarized Stacked Patch Phased Array Antenna With Cavity-Backed Configuration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: As a commom form of phased array elements, microstrip patch antennas have received much attention. In this paper, a wide-band dual-polarized stacked patch phased array antenna with cavity-backed configuration is proposed. The bandwidth of the proposed anatenna element is over 24% for ±45° scan in both E and H planes while the bandwidth for ±60° scan is a bit narrower (15%) because of scan blindness. A <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7\times 7$</tex> prototype is manufactured and measured to verify the correctness of this design.

articleTitle: The Exploration of 3D Lattice Structure as the Outer Dielectric Bonding for Angularly Stabilizing the FSS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To reduce the thickness of the outer dielectric bonding of frequency selective surface(FSS) while maintaining good angular stability, a 3D lattice structure for additive manufacturing is investigated in this work. A continuous gradual changing of the equivalent permittivity can be realized by reasonably arranging the space filling ratio of material. It is assumed that, when the waves propagate in it, continuous refraction can effectively reduce the equivalent incident angle within a shorter distance. The structure was applied upon the outer dielectric bonding of a former 2nd-order MFSS design and simulation investigations were carried out. Results show that it can obtains good angular stability based on a considerably shortened outer dielectric bonding under TE polarization. But the transmission characteristics show obvious defection when the incident angle rises above 60deg under TM polarization. Although the expectations were not perfectly fulfilled, the results still provide a more profound explanation of the working mechanism of outer dielectric bonding.

articleTitle: Design of millimeter wave array antenna decoupling construction based on metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The proposed structure is a metamaterial-based coating to reduce the coupling of the array antenna operating in the millimeter-wave band. The metasurface structure is composed of rectangular ring slotted elements in a periodic arrangement. By suppressing the space and surface waves between the array antennas, the isolation degree in the working frequency band (23.8GHz–25.2GHz) can be kept below −25dB.

articleTitle: Low Scattering X-band Phased Vivaldi Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 8$</tex> low scattering X-band phased Vivaldi array antenna is designed. The array is composed of two types of elements, while the scattering phase difference between the two elements is approximate 180°. Moreover, the shielding metal layer is used to reduce the cross-polarization level of the antenna, and consequently the orthogonal polarization component of the monostatic scattering cross-section (SCS) is reduced. Simulated results show that the designed low scattering Vivaldi array antenna can scan up to ±60° in the E and H planes, and the array antenna achieves a notable in-band co-polarized monostatic SCS reduction under normal incident plane waves.

articleTitle: High Gain $2\times 4$ Rectangular Patch Antenna Array at 3500MHz for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents the design of a 2x4 rectangular patch antenna array for 5G Applications. The antenna array is designed using Rogers RT/Duroid 5880 as substrate with height 1.575mm, dielectric constant of 2.2 and loss tangent of 0.0009. A prototype of the single patch element and the eight-elements array are manufactured to validate simulated results. The single inset-fed patch antenna attained a gain of 7.6 dB while the antenna array exhibited a peak gain of 16.2 dB. The 10 dB bandwidth of the array covers from 3400 MHz to 3520 MHz, making it suitable for Band n78 5G access points application.

articleTitle: Low-Profile and Broadband Ferrite-Loaded Antenna for VHF/UHF Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A ferrite-loaded dipole antenna with wideband and low profile is proposed for VHF/UHF applications. The ferrite used in this paper is a kind of novel magneto-dielectric material with high and matched permittivity and permeability. Through the material loading, the interference of ground plane is effectively suppressed, and thus the antenna profile is reduced significantly. Furthermore, the antenna bandwidth is expanded to lower frequency band due to the high magneto-dielectric property of the ferrite. The optimized antenna obtains a profile of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.08 \lambda_{0}$</tex>, a −10 dB impedance bandwidth of 107.7% (150–500 MHz), and a peak gain of 6.2 dBi.

articleTitle: Research on the Scattering Characteristics of Motion Modulated Ultra-long Chaff
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to develop a new kind low-dimensional and efficient chaff interference mode, a discontinuous super-long chaff made of S-type glass fiber is proposed. In this paper, its kinematics and scattering characteristics in the thin atmosphere are emphatically studied. Simulation results show that long chaffs have stronger shape-maintaining ability and better interference effect than the traditional dipole chaffs under different polarization conditions.

articleTitle: The Computation of Quantum RCS for the Regular Hexagonal Prism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The quantum RCS is an impersonal measurement of ‘quantum radar visibleness’ of the given object. Obviously, it is extraordinarily momentous for the R&D of stealth objects. In this paper, we have shown the simulation of quantum RCS (QRCS) and classical radar cross section (CRCS) for the regular hexagonal prism. Finally, we make a discussion about the sidelobe quantum effect between QRCS and CRCS.

articleTitle: An Efficient Scheme for Multiple Fine Structures in Hybrid FETD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, an efficient scheme is proposed to apply the hybrid finite-element time-domain method for electromagnetic model of multiple fine structures. The unconditionally stable finite-element time-domain (US-FETD) method is used in every subdomain separately. Since the matrices constructed in every fine structure subdomain are small, the unstable modes can be obtained by the generalized eigenvalue problem in every fine structure subdomain. If the fine structures are the same, obtaining unstable modes in one subdomain will further improve the efficiency. Compared to the eigenvalue problem containing all fine structures, the proposed scheme costs less memory and time for eigenvalue analysis. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Coaxial Lumped Port Model for the Nodal DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a coaxial lumped port model for nodal discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (NDGTD) method has been presented. Different from the wave port widely used to terminate the coaxial line, the field-circuit coupling method is introduced at the lumped port to implement the transverse electromagnetic wave in the coaxial cable. The numerical example including dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) fed by the coaxial antenna is given to demonstrate good performance of the coaxial lumped port model.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Array for Achieving Orbital Angular Momentum Vortex Wave and RCS Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a novel multifunctional antenna that can simultaneously generate orbital angular momentum (OAM) vortex electromagnetic wave and antenna RCS reduction is designed. By switching the ON/OFF state of the PIN diodes, reconfigurable antenna array for generating different OAM modes is achieved. Furthermore, the integration of the reconfigurable OAM antenna array and the microstrip antenna can reduce the in-band RCS of the microstrip antenna by more than 10dB without affecting the antenna performance.

articleTitle: Matching Design of Wedge-Shaped Structure Radome and Dual linear Polarized SNA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper first introduces a design scheme of dual polarized Vivaldi antenna with cross array, which is suitable for internal in wedged-shaped structure radome. The cross-array scheme can improve the influence of radome on the electrical performance of dual linear polarized antenna and have low cross-polarization in E-plane and H-plane, but have high cross-polarization in the non-principal planes. The Sliced Notch Antenna (SNA) have good cross-polarization radio (CPR) in all planes, this paper gives the simulation results and shed light on the method for matching design of Wedge-Shaped Structure radome and Dual linear Polarized SNA.

articleTitle: The Echo characteristics of Electromagnetic Waves in Nonuniform Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We used the Z transform finite-difference time-domain (Z-FDTD) method to investigate the influence of the plasma-coated target on the echo characteristics of electromagnetic wave. We simulated and analyzed how the time-varying characteristic and variable parameters of plasma affect electromagnetic wave echo. This study provides a theoretical reference for the early warning.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband high precision positioning system based on SDS-TWR algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the measurement accuracy of traditional methods in time-of-flight (TOF) technology is limited by clock and frequency drift, improve the precision of measuring further, the symmetric double sided two-way ranging (SDS-TWR) algorithm is adopted. The relevant comparative test are carried out through the positioning system. The test results show that the positioning accuracy of UWB positioning system based on SDS-TWR algorithm is 90.83% higher than that of the traditional two-way ranging (TWR) system, which verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in the positioning system.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Cancellation Based on the Equivalence Principle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Electromagnetic cancellation is one of the methods to realize electromagnetic stealth. In this paper, according to the equivalence principle, we eliminate the scattering field of the object by superimposing magnetic and electric current densities outside the boundary of the object. This idea is similar to sound cancellation in acoustics. However, in most cases, we only care about the scattered field in a specific direction. Therefore, we simplify the equivalent magnetic and electric current of the closed surface. Finally, we analyze it through simulation.

articleTitle: Influence of Rough Surface Slope on AIEM Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the advanced integral equation model (AIEM) is solved by two schemes. In the first scheme, the rough surface slope is eliminated for complementary field when the incident angle equals to the scattering angle. In the second scheme, the rough surface slope is modified with zero. Then the backscattering coefficients can be calculated by using the proposed AIEM. It can be concluded that better agreement can be obtained by the second scheme when compared with the measured data.

articleTitle: Radar Cross Section Measurement Method of Inhomogeneous Plasma with Electrically Large Scale Based on Near-field Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the vacuum and low electromagnetic scattering experiment device with spatial scales <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Phi 4000 \times 8000 mm$</tex> was introduced. The electromagnetic scattering characteristics experiment of non-uniform argon plasma was studied by using the far field extrapolation scattering center near field imaging method. The experimental results are shown that the difference of the test results is less than 2dB for the non-uniform distribution of argon plasma.

articleTitle: An SIC-Based Broadband High-gain Array Antenna Applicable for 5G FR1 Band
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An SIC-based broadband high-gain array antenna applicable for 5G FR1 band is proposed. The substrate integrated cavity (SIC) features the advantages of high power capacity, low loss and ease of integration. Therefore, the SIC structure is used to form the feeding network of the proposed array antenna. The array antenna is fabricated and measured. The measurement results which agree with the simulations. The measured −10 dB bandwidth is from 5.02 GHz to 6.53 GHz with an enhanced high gain over 12 dBi within the impedance bandwidth. The array antenna is suitable for 5G FR1 band application. The whole design manifests that the SIC structure shows a great potential to be applied as the feeding network of array antennas.

articleTitle: Analysis on The FCC-FDTD Method of Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics for Metal Ball Coated with Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this article, the backward monostatic radar cross section (RCS) of magnetized plasma coated with three dimensional metal sphere and single metal sphere model is calculated by using face centered cubic (FCC) grid technology. The FCC-FDTD iterative formulas for anisotropic plasma medium are derived, and the results are compared with those of JE convolution (JEC) FDTD method. Research shows that FCC grid adopts a spatial distribution structure similar to crystal structure, it has higher accuracy and better stability than other FDTD methods in dealing with dispersion error. This method also provides a new way to reduce the dispersion error caused by large gradient and inhomogeneous medium.

articleTitle: Design of Fabry-Perot Resonator Antenna Using Non-uniform Superstrate
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Combined with the analysis of the ray model, a design method of Fabry-Perot resonant antenna constructed with a non-uniform superstrate using simple structural elements is proposed. The designed unit structure has suitable reflection phase frequency characteristics in the working frequency band and constitutes a phase gradient cladding structure, which satisfies the broadband resonance condition of the resonant cavity antenna. The correctness and effectiveness of the method are verified by the calculations results.

articleTitle: Design of Two-Layer $4\times 4$ Butler Matrix With Wideband Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a 2.4GHz two-layer <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4\times 4$</tex> Butler matrix in microstrip technology. By integrating several wideband building blocks, i.e., slot-coupled quadrature hybrids, window-shape based crossovers, and Schiffman differential phase shifters, working bandwidth of the proposed Butler matrix achieves for 40%. To validate the overall performance, a prototype of the proposed circuit is implemented and fabricated. The measured results have a good agreement with those obtained from the simulation.

articleTitle: Novel radome design for RF integration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: RF integration is widely needed by modern shipborne radars. A novel dual-band FSS radome with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}+\mathrm{X}$</tex> passband is designed and simulated with angular stability. The passband are 1.55∼3.4GHz and 9.2∼9.7GHz. This radome achieves good performance in the finite large FSS simulation and cylindrical radome simulation.

articleTitle: Design of a Miniature X-Band Broadband Unequal Power Divider MMIC Using Bridged-T Coils
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A two-section unequal power divider with a center frequency of 10 GHz and an output power ratio of 2:1 was designed and simulated by using integrated passive device (IPD) technology on GaAs substrate. Moreover, the use of bridged-T coils instead of all 1/4 wavelength transmission lines in the unequal power divider can significantly reduce the circuit size without reducing the bandwidth. The simulation results show that in the bandwidth of 7–13 GHz, the input and output return loss and isolation are less than −20dB. The size of the unequal power divider is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.8 mm\times 1.2 mm$</tex>.

articleTitle: Wideband and Wide-Angle FSS Based on Quarter-Mode Substrate Integrated Waveguide Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity-based frequency selective surface (FSS) shows several advantages of flat passband, high selectivity etc. over a conventional FSS. However, the existing full-mode SIW-based FSS has a low oblique incidence stability due to a large element spacing. In this paper, a quarter-mode SIW (QMSIW) cavity has been used to design a wide-angle FSS. The proposed FSS remains stable under a 60° incidence while the element size is reduced by over 60% compared to that of the full-mode SIW-based FSS. Thanks to the QMSIW cavity, a square loop slot has been added around the miniaturized cavity in this work to simultaneously achieve wideband and wide-angle characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel Temperature Sensor and Its Anti-electromagnetic Interference Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel resonant temperature sensor with good anti-electromagnetic interference ability is proposed in this paper. Differing from traditional resistive temperature sensors, this new temperature sensor uses the characteristics of sensor output signal in frequency domain instead of that in time domain. An equivalent electromagnetic susceptibility model is set up to analyze and compare the anti-electromagnetic interference characteristics of the traditional and the proposed temperature sensors. Results of the field-circuit co-simulation show that the proposed temperature sensor has better anti-electromagnetic interference ability.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Influence of Shielding Layer on Radiation Characteristics of Shielded Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Various connecting cables in the electric multiple unit (EMU) are one of main radiation sources in the whole vehicle EMC test. So it is of great significance to research the factors affecting the electromagnetic radiation of cables. A comparative test in the lab was designed. The magnetic and electric field emission data was gathered when the shielding layer of the shielded cable was stripped off or not. Through these tests, some valuable conclusions were obtained. Then some suggestions on cable maintenance and construction were put forward.

articleTitle: A two-element 24 GHz planar end-fire dipole antenna array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The paper gives a 24 GHz two-element end-fire dipole antenna array in rogers 4350 technology. The antenna has gain of 8.8 dBi, a bandwidth of 1.3 GHz for S11, half power width of 56° in X-Y plane and 65° in X-Z plane. This antenna array is characterized by high gain and simplicity in design. It is also very compact in size with an area of only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.9\times 1.7\ \text{cm}^{2}$</tex>. This end-fire antenna array topology can as well be adopted in antenna design for other frequency bands in planar PCB technology, and also for on-chip mm-wave and THz antenna design.

articleTitle: Optimization of Photonic BandGap Structure Based on Genetic Algorithm and AH FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the Associated Hermite finite-difference time-domain (AH FDTD) method and Genetic algorithm (GA) are combined to optimize photonic bandgap structure by selecting the proper positions and types of material for four infinitely long dielectric rods to find the desire transmission coefficient with photonic bandgap. Compared with the traditional FDTD method, the AH FDTD method could improve the computational efficiency and speed up the optimization efficiency of the GA. It shows that when the total number of iterations is 2500 for a whole calculation, it will take 21 days for the conventional FDTD method, while 20 hours for the proposed method to get the final optimization results.

articleTitle: Research on High Precision Simulation Technology of Specific Absorption Rate of Human Head Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The effect of electromagnetic radiation from mobile phones onto human head tissue is mainly investigated. Two types of millimeter wave antennas have been used as the radiation source for the specific absorption rate (SAR) test, and been the electromagnetic model of mobile phone on the human head model as well. The grid precision of the established model reaches below <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda/10$</tex> at the millimeter wave frequency of 28GHz. Furthermore, the modeling by using FDTD method and simulation process of high-precision human head model are also introduced, and the results are verified in line with the current international criteria.

articleTitle: Doppler Spectrum Analysis of Hypersonic Vehicle Based on Dynamic RCS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the parallel physical optics (PO) method is used to calculate the dynamic radar cross section (RCS) of the hypersonic vehicle covered with plasma sheath, and the Doppler spectra of the hypersonic vehicle at different reentry altitudes are calculated in the same time domain. The results show that: The relative motion between hypersonic vehicle and Space-borne Radar results in small frequency shift of Doppler spectrum; In addition, the backscattering echo intensity of different frequency electromagnetic (EM) waves at different positions of the vehicle covered with plasma sheath is different with time, which leads to the Doppler spectrum broadening of hypersonic target. The research results provide technical means and data support for hypersonic targets echo detection and feature recognition.

articleTitle: Design of a Ultra-wideband Conformal Circuit Analog Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: An ultra-wideband(UWB) conformal circuit analog absorber (CAA) using resistive ink is presented. According to the equivalent circuit model, a two-segment transmission line cascade structure are designed in ADS, which obtained a reflection coefficient bandwidth from 1.9 GHz to 16.9 GHz with fractional bandwidth (FBW) of 159.6%, and then the srtucture are designed in HFSS by using the conversion formula between the equivalent circuit model and the actual srtucture, simulation results and the ADS results made a good fit. The overall dimensions of the unitcell is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.089\ \lambda_{L}\times 0.089\ \lambda_{L}\times 0.092\ \lambda_{L}$</tex>. Finally a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10 \times 10$</tex> planar array and two conformal arrays are simulated. A 10-dB RCS reduction is achieved from 2.1 GHz to 16.5 GHz with FBW of 154.8% at the central angle of 90°, and the absorber exhibits the stable response for both TE and TM polarizations.

articleTitle: Real-Time Imaging Processor for Highly Squinted Airborne SAR Based on Multicore DSPs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In consideration of highly squinted well-focused synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery at a faster speed, a high-performance SAR real-time processing system based on multicore digital signal processor (DSP) is established in this paper. First, the polar format algorithm (PFA) using the principle of chirp scaling (PCS) is implemented for higher algorithm efficiency. Then, autofocus technique is employed for compensating the azimuth phase error. Next, architecture of parallel processing between two DSPs is designed, which not only reduces the time consumption, but also makes enormous SAR data processing possible. Finally, four DSPs in pairs are applied to achieve Ping-Pong nested pipeline processing for meeting the requirements of real-time imaging. Experimental results utilizing the measured highly squinted airborne SAR data are performed to validate the formulated DSP system.

articleTitle: Calculation of Orthogonal Decomposition of Scattered Far Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Orthogonal mode decomposition is a useful tool in the analysis of electromagnetic field, such as representation of Green's function, microwave device analysis and etc. In recent research on quantum electromagnetics, the normal mode approach needs the orthogonal mode decomposition as well. To study the quantum scattered field, a method to calculate the orthogonal decomposition of scattering far field is proposed in this paper. The scattering far field can be calculated from the surface current on the target and expanded under the spherical harmonic function basis. Then a fast method based on orthogonal decomposition of exponential function is applied to get the coefficients under such basis. Numerical examples verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Compact Rotman Lens with Wide-angle Scanning Using High Permittivity Substrate
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a compact Rotman lens with wideband wide-angle scanning capability based on a Taconic RF-10 high dielectric constant substrate and different array port sizes. Thirteen different beam ports were carefully designed to enable broadband and wide-angle scanning. The total insertion loss of the proposed solution is better than 5.5dB from the simulation results, and it has the wide-angle scanning capability of −45°∼ 45° in the bandwidth range of 0.8GHz∼2GHz.

articleTitle: The RK-Sinc Method for Schrödinger equation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work, the time-dependent Schrödinger equations were implemented by the RK-Sinc method. It offers a high quality in spatial approximations with the Sinc function and a high-efficiency procedure to close to the time advance with the strong stability and low storage Runge-Kutta method. Both the theoretical analysis and the simulation results demonstrate that the RK-Sinc method performs better than the traditional FDTD method.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Different Conformal Surfaces on Antenna Bandwidth and Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, in order to study the changes of reflection coefficient and radiation performance before and after different curved surfaces are conformal, a central embedded rectangular microstrip patch antenna is designed, which achieves good impedance matching in Ku band and cascaded one-minute four-T power divider to form a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2 \times 2$</tex> small planar array. Then, conformal with single and hyperboloid carriers, the variation rules of central frequency, bandwidth and maximum gain of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2 \times 2$</tex> array antennas with cylindrical radius 50mm, 60mm and 70mm, and convex paraboloid and concave paraboloid radius of 500mm 600mm and 700mm are discussed, and the variation rules of reflection coefficient and far-field two-dimensional pattern before and after different surface conformal are summarized.

articleTitle: Fast Analysis of Scattering from Chaff Clouds by EPA-BoR Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a domain decomposition algorithm based on equivalence principle for multiple bodies of multiple bodies of revolutions (EPA-BoR) is used to analyze the scattering characteristics of chaff clouds. It can be tested that the coupling effect of any two chaffs can be ignored when their distance is equal or greater than two wavelengths. Therefore, both memory and calculation time can be significantly reduced. Numerical results can prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Antenna and Feeder Systems of P-band Meteorological Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A new approach for designing antenna and feeder systems of meteorological radar which is inexpensive, fast scanning, dual polarization and phased array is proposed. This goal has been accomplished by a new technique, based on a special series and parallel feed network, to realize the scanning pattern with high gain and low side-lobe level. In this technique, the number of antenna elements, which can satisfy performances of radar, is significantly decreased to 2/3 of original scope. As a proof, a P-band tropospheric wind profiler radar, which has a 169¬element array and 13 feed networks with 30dB gain and - 30dB low side-lobe level, is presented. The simulation and measured results are presented, and performances are excellent.

articleTitle: Dual-linear polarized array with 9.3:1 Bandwidth and 50° scanning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A dual-linear polarized tightly coupled dipole array (TCDA) is presented with a 9.3:1 bandwidth for voltage standing wave ratio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{VSWR}) < 3$</tex>. The unit cell of this TCDA is made up of two crossly placed dipole radiators, each fed by a wideband Marchand balun. Each dipole element has a gradient increase of width from the center to edge, and a rectangular patch is placed between two adjacent arms to enhance the capacitive coupling. Therefore, a wider impedance bandwidth is obtained. Besides, a resistive FSS is introduced in loop shape to suppress common-mode resonances, further expending the impedance bandwidth. Finally, the simulation result of infinite array shows a superior wideband performance with a scanning angle down to 50°.

articleTitle: Adaptive FDTD Mesh Generation Technique Based on Cuboid Ray Column Intersection Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Adaptive FDTD mesh generation technique based on cuboid ray column intersection method in three-dimensional FDTD simulation is proposed in this paper. According to the vertex coordinates of the triangular patches on the object's surface, non-uniform structured mesh lines are placed. Since the placement of these mesh lines is constrained by the object geometry and wavelength, this grid lines setting method is more accurate and efficient. Then by marking the meshes determined by the intersections of cuboid ray columns and triangular patches, the discretization of complex target can be realize. The parabolic antenna is modeled to prove the validity of this novel technique.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Technology of RF Microsystem Based on Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: RF microsystems are the development trend of the miniaturization of electronic devices in the future. As an important means to realize the efficient development of RF microsystems, high precision simulation technology is currently receiving extensive attention. Aiming at the RF microsystem in the Ku frequency band, this paper adopts the hardware-in-the-loop simulation method combining three-dimensional electromagnetic field modeling technology and MMICs cascaded circuit parameter extraction technology to realize the research and verification of the simulation method of the RF microsystem. After physical verification and testing, the simulation results are highly consistent with the test results. In the 6 ∼ 18 GHz frequency band, the simulation accuracy is better than 90%, which can meet the application requirements of high precision simulation of RF microsystems.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Parallel Automated Neural-Based Modeling of Microwave Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Automated model generation (AMG) of neural network models has been proved to be an effective method for improving neural modeling efficiency. In this paper, an advanced parallel AMG method incorporating interpolation approaches and parallel computation formulation for multi-processor environment is presented to further speedup the neural model development. Modeling of a microwave filter is presented as an example to demonstrate the advantages of the method.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis and Multiphysics Simulation of Aircraft Deposition Electrostatic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Most researches on aircraft deposition electrostatic nowadays remain at a macroscopic level of potential distribution on the surface. From the perspective of microscopic particles friction and collision, this paper conducts a theoretical analysis of the steady-state fluid, high-speed particles and electrostatic field around the aircraft when flying. And combining with knowledge of fluid mechanics and electromagnetics, this paper also selects proper modules of multi-physics software to perform a simulation. Good agreements between known theories and simulation results are observed.

articleTitle: Research on Broadband Multi-beamforming Network Based on Microstrip Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The paper proposes a method for implementing broadband multi-beamforming network based on microstrip circuit, which is mainly aimed at line source array system<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, especially low frequency system. This is a research method that is different from Rotman lens and Butler matrix method. It mainly adopts the mixed plane integration method of transceiver front end, multi-channel beampower division, delay network and multichannel synthesis circuit. This paper implements a 2-6GHz multi-beamforming network, simulates the microstrip power division and synthesis network, and uses multi-beamforming theory to calculate the physical length matching of adjacent signals, complete the delay network design. The overall network and each circuit have good transmission performance and guarantee miniaturization and high reliability requirements.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Dual-Polarized Base Station Antenna with Stable Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a design of miniaturized dual-polarized antenna with stable radiation pattern. Owning to the vertical metal cylinder loading in the top of the crossed loop-antenna, the proposed antenna with a small radiation size of only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.36\ \lambda_{0}\times 0.36\ \lambda_{0} (\lambda_{0}$</tex> is the wavelength of the high operation frequency 2.7GHz) and a stable 3dB beamwidth of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$65^{\circ}\pm 2.5^{\circ}$</tex> and 10dB beamwidth of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$120.5^{\circ}\pm 3.5^{\circ}$</tex>, which maintains the operating bandwidth from 1.78 GHz to 2.7 GHz for S11.

articleTitle: Potential Application of Antenna-in-Package in LEO Satellite
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: As the key component of millimeter wave (mm-wave) wireless communication systems, antenna-in-package (AiP) technology meets the urgent needs of the low earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation for high integration, low cost and efficient antenna solutions. This paper reviews the key technologies and development trend of AiP from the perspectives of radiators, packages and materials. This paper also discusses the practical difficulties of AiP technology in satellite communication. Finally, current issues for applications of AiP in LEO satellite constellations are presented.

articleTitle: FDTD-TL Method for the Prediction of the Transient Response of Shielded Cable Above the Ground
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to predict the transient responses of shielded cable above the perfectly conducting (PEC) ground illuminated by external electromagnetic pulses, a numerical method in time domain (TD) is presented in this paper. Based on the transmission line (TL) theory, the shielded cable is divided into the internal and external TL models coupled by the transfer impedance of the shield. The corresponding TL equations are derived and the one-dimensional finite-difference time-domain (1-D FDTD) method is adopted to solve the equations. Using the presented method, the terminal responses on the inner cores of shielded cables above the PEC ground are calculated, which shows that the method is accurate and high-efficiency for the transient analysis of shielded cables.

articleTitle: Study of multi-view UAV target recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A target recognition method of UAV Based on multi-view electromagnetic feature fusion is proposed. Firstly, HRRP data from three different angle of view are fused. The N dimensional HRRP data from single view in different azimuth angles are expanded to multi-view 3N dimensional feature data. Then SVM classifier is used for recognition. The simulation results show that multi-view feature fusion can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of UAV target.

articleTitle: Dynamic beam-steering by active Huygens' metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a subwavelength active Huygens' particle whose transmission phase can be adjusted via varactors is reported. By stimulating these particles according to specific coding sequence, a metasurface with dynamic beam-steering from 0° to 70° is designed. The full-wave simulation results are further given, proving the validity of our design.

articleTitle: Study on the Effects of Frequency Selection in Miniature Antenna and System Co-Design: Towards Distributed and Battery-Less Neural Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: With the advancements of neural interface technologies, the development of distributed implanted neural interfaces has emerged as a critical approach for improving system scalability. Subject to the design constraints associated with aspects of miniaturization, power consumption and safety, antennas and system optimizations become extremely challenging.
