This paper demonstrates theoretical analysis and simulations to study the critical trade-offs between important performance indicators including wireless link efficiency, power consumption, and human EM exposure. The study reveals that properly selecting the wireless frequency of operation is very important in the system-level design for miniature and battery-less implanted sensing systems.

articleTitle: Tunable Multi-band plasma FSS realized by artificial defects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A novel method to implement multiband plasma FSS using artificial defects is proposed. In this method, there is no need to change the structure of plasma FSS, and only part of plasma tube is controlled to be in defect state. By changing the defect state of different local small arrays, multi-frequency FSS can be obtained successively, such as dual-frequency, tri-frequency and quad frequency. The advantage of this method is that a single plasma FSS can be used to achieve a variety of stopband functions, which can flexibly adapt to the external varying electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Design of An UWB End-fire Quasi-Yagi Antenna with Dielectric Loading
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The proposed ultra-wide bandwidth (UWB) end-fire quasi-Yagi antenna is designed on the polyimide substrate with a single microstrip-to-slotline (MS) feed. To enhance bandwidth and gain performance, the designed antenna is loaded with a high dielectric constant material. Consequently, it realized a wide operating band of about 116% (3.05 — 11.47 GHz), a high front-to-back ratio (FTBR) of 20 dB and a peak end-fire gain of 9.2 dBi.

articleTitle: The Progress in Optimization of Small-scale Calibration Targets at THz Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the small-sized blackbody (calibration targets) is optimized for better wide-band low-reflectivity performance. The pyramidal unit is optimized with a curved kernel, also with the nonuniform coating layer. The reflectivity performance of the coated pyramids is investigated from 50GHz to 700GHz, based on the full-wave finite difference time domain (FDTD) computations. Comparing to the original uniformly coated pyramid, the optimized design achieves better absorption in the low-frequency region, and eliminates Fabre-Perot(F-P) resonance which leads to frequency ripples at high frequencies. In addition, different structural parameters of the pyramidal unit are investigated, such as periods and height/period ratios. This work provides a reference for the further optimization of the calibration target in the future.

articleTitle: Fast Scattering Calculation of Sparse Array Based on Array AIM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The array AIM for the sparse array is presented in this paper. To eliminate the undesired couplings, the zeros shielding technique is applied on the array projection matrix. Moreover, the matrix-vector multiplication is accelerated by virtual grids technique. The numerical simulations demonstrate the efficiency of the array AIM in dealing with the sparse array.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Wideband Method for Analysis of Periodic Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this study, the frequency and material independent reactions (FMIR) is combined with generalized single source tangential equivalence principle algorithm (GSST-EP A) to calculate the wideband RCS of finite period array structure. By Taylor series expansion of the exponent of Green function, a frequency independent matrix and a frequency dependent phase factor are generated. Therefore, the FMIR can accelerate the frequency sweep and improve the frequency sweep accuracy dynamically, while the memory requirement is large. To deal with this problem, the GSST-EPA can transfer the solution problem on the target to the equivalent surface, so it can improve the matrix condition number and decrease the number of unknowns. The characteristic basis function (CBF) is constructed on the equivalent surface to improve the efficiency of GSST-EPA. A numerical example is shown to prove the accuracy and efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Calculation and Prediction for Backscattering of Hinged Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, the expressions for the backscattering radar cross section (RCS) of the hinged model are derived based on the uniform theory of diffraction (UTD). The hinged model is viewed as a cylindrically curved plate combining with two inclined flat plates. The results calculated by the expressions are compared with that computed by the commercial software CST STUDIO SUITE, and they are in good agreement, which verify the accuracy of the expressions. Furthermore, the numerical formulas require less computing resource when advance the backscattering analysis.

articleTitle: Application of Characteristic Basis Function Method Based on Characteristic Mode Theory to Solve the Monostatic RCS of Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Based on the characteristic mode theory, a novel characteristic basis function method (CBFM) which can acheive a higher calculation efficiency of monostatic radar cross sections (RCS) is proposed. Firstly, the characteristic modes (CMs) of each extended block are obtained from the impedance matrix. Then the characteristic basis functions (CBFs) independent of the excitation are generated by selecting effective modes based on the modal significances (MS). Compared with the CBFM based on singular value decomposition (SVD-CBFM), the accuracy and time performance are both improved by the novel approach. Numerical results have been given to verify the accuracy and time efficiency.

articleTitle: A Deterministic Terahertz Channel Model for Inter-Satellite Communication Link
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Owing to the revolutions in satellite constellation networking and the development of microelectronics, the terahertz band has become an attractive solution for inter-satellite communication links for its promising high date rate. For the accurate estimation of propagation characteristics of THz signals in space, this letter presents a deterministic channel estimation approach. Due to the existence of thermal multilayer insulation (MLI) blankets covering the satellite, the scattering mechanism from the satellite platform at the THz band is complicated and difficult to estimate. In this work, a simplified procedure to model the MLI surface and the physical optics approximation to calculate its scattering are presented. Mento-Carlo simulations are performed to evaluate the impact of the rough MLI surface in channel impulse response and other propagation characteristics.

articleTitle: Massively Parallel Approach of Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm on DCU Clusters for Large Electromagnetic Scattering problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A massively parallel approach of the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) on Deep Computing Unit (DCU) clusters using the Heterogeneous Interface for Portability (HIP) programming model and the Message Passing Interface (MPI) is presented (DCU-MLFMA). The proposed MPI-based multi-DCU parallel implementation is capable of solving challenging problems involving billions of unknowns with a significant speedup, compared with the conventional CPU-based ternary parallelization approach of MLFMA (CPU-MLFMA). Numerical results, including a ship model with length about 6000 wavelengths modeled with 2.6 billion unknowns, are given to demonstrate the capability, as well as the efficiency of the presented method.

articleTitle: Design of In-Phase and Out-of-Phase Filtering Power Dividers with Thin-Film IPD Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper presents a kind of Ku-band filtering power divider(FPD) design with thin-film integrated passive device(IPD) technology and improved isolation structure. The Thin-Film IPD technology can well meet the greater requirements of processing accuracy and circuit layout in higher frequency band. Fourth-order quasi-elliptic filter is employed to realize good passband selectivity and out-of-band rejection. A compound structure including a GaAs-based resistor and an inductive stub is adopted to achieve good in-band isolation and matching. Phase difference can be changed by selecting different feeding point. Finally, two FPDs operating at 16 GHz are designed and adjusted.

articleTitle: Radar Cross Section Evaluation of Chaff Cloud by Pulse Based Method of Moment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: RWG based method of moment (MOM) is invalid in calculating the radar cross section (RCS) of large-scale chaff cloud. It causes unimaginable computational burden. This paper studies in detail the principle and solution process of the method of moments using pulse basis function and obtains the RCS of chaff cloud in a relatively short time. Compared with the MoM with RWG basis function, the proposed method greatly reduces the number of unknowns and thus improves the computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Realization of Sea Surveillance and Imaging Radar Signal Processing System Based on Domestic Digital Signal Processor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a radar signal processing system, which combines pulse doppler mode and stepped frequency mode, is proposed. The pulse doppler mode is used to detect targets and measure their velocity accurately, and then the stepped frequency mode is used to image the targets. The signal processing system has been implemented on the domestic Huarui No. 2 digital signal processor.

articleTitle: UWB Tightly Coupled Array Optimization and Design of Unequal Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of ultra-wideband (UWB), low peak side lobe level (PSLL) and high gain of tightly coupled array antennas, this paper adopts the covariance matrix adaptive ES algorithm based on MOEA/D (MOEA/D-CMA-ES) to optimize the interval of different elements, and uses the aggressive space mapping (ASM) algorithm compensates for the coupling between the array elements, and finally a 1:32 ultra-wideband unequal power divider is designed as the feeder network.

articleTitle: Simplified Modeling of Wireless Power Transmission Problem Based on Focused Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A simplified model of wireless power transmission (WPT) system, which consists of a phased array as transmitter and a single antenna as receiver, is theoretically analyzed in this paper. The maximum transmission coefficient is given, as well as optimum excitations of phased array elements. According to the numerical study, the optimum excitations can be approximated by simply simulating gain patterns of receiver and periodic transmitter element, which almost reaches the maximum power transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of a circularly polarized phased array antenna for satellite applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A circularly polarized (CP) phased array antenna (PAA) is designed for X band satellite communication systems. The proposed phased array antenna has a relative - 10dB bandwidth of 4% with ±60° scanning ability. Moreover, the designed PAA has a compact structure with the utilization of microstrip antenna element and tile integration architecture.

articleTitle: Design of UHF Semi-active Tag Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Ultra-high frequence radio frequence identification tag adopts the way of actively transmitting electromagnetic waves by read-write antenna and passively backscattering by tag antenna, which has the characteristics of high communication data rate and long reading distance. It can support the identification of multiple targets and moving targets at the same time. According to the complexity of structure and application scope, it can be divided into three categories: passive tags, semiactive tags and active tags. Semi-active tags have attracted more and more attention as a new field between passive tags and active tags. Because they carry batteries, the problem of energy supply required for chip operation is solved, which greatly reduces the requirements of tags on the power intensity of input RF signals. Compared with passive tags, the read-write distance and recognition efficiency of tags are greatly improved. According to the latest development trend in Ultra-high frequence(UHF) identification field, a semi-active tag with power supply circuit system with wake-up circuit and amplification circuit is designed in this paper, which not only realizes long-distance effective reading in UHF(915MHz) band, but also greatly reduces standby power consumption.

articleTitle: A Compact Brodband Based Station Antenna with High Gain for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, a compact broadband dual polarized base station antenna operating in 3.3-5 GHz band is proposed. The proposed antenna has four main parts: radiator, T-shaped feeding line, two coaxial cables and reflector. With optimizing the shape of radiator patch, the antenna achieves tight size and wide band. Measured results show that VSWR is less than 1.5 in 3.3–5 GHz, and isolation of two ports is higher than 25 dB. Moreover, it has a high gain (8.34–9.62 dBi) in the operating band. Half power beam width (HPBW) is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$65^{\ \circ}\pm 5^{\circ}$</tex>. The performance of the antenna shows that it is very suitable for the fifth-generation (5G) communication system.

articleTitle: A New Type of Single-layer Dual-polarization Element Used for Folded Reflectarray
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A new dual-polarization reflectarray element working at 11 ∼15 GHz is proposed in this paper based on single-layer PCB. Within the working frequency bandwidth, the reflection phase of the element can be adjusted in a range of over 550° for the two orthogonally polarized incidences, and the frequency responses of the reflection phase show good linearity. The reflection phase for the two orthogonally polarized incidences can be adjusted separately. Different arraying methods of the element are analyzed and compared in detail to reduce the negative effect of the incomplete edge element in the finite array aperture on the antenna performance.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Sparse Antenna Arrays via Iterative Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The design of sparse antenna arrays is realized by a novel and effective method based on convex programming in this paper. By the use of synthesis model in terms of thinned arrays, a novel binary quadratic optimization problem is established for design of sparse array, where the required antenna element number satisfying user-defined constraints (peak sidelobes and directivity) is fully minimized. To reduce computational cost, an effective optimization approach combining the reweighted <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{1}$</tex>-norm minimization with the element location expansion and contraction is proposed. By comparing to fully populated half-wavelength arrays, a numerical example is presented to assess the advantages of the described approach.

articleTitle: Digital processing system of geomagnetic weak signal detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Weak signal detection is very important for the geomagnetic detection system used in the process of underground space exploration and development. In order to improve the stability and reliability of geomagnetic weak signal detection ability, a digital processing system is designed which based on FPGA and upper computer for geomagnetic weak signal detection. The results show that the method in detecting characteristic parameters of the weak signal and improving the signal to noise ratio is a very effective way, the method could effectively detect the desired signal under strong noise background. It could meet the needs of geomagnetic detection system.

articleTitle: Local Time Stepping and Load Balance of DGTD on High-Performance Computing Architectures
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Extremely small meshes of system-in-package severely limit the integration-time step of simulations of time-domain electromagnetic problems. Here, we redesigned a parallel multilevel local time stepping (LTS) algorithms as well as load balance scheme to make our code capable of running on large clusters with high parallel efficiency. Besides, communication cost can be reduced by adjusting the update order of mesh levels. Numerical experiments are given to validate our algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of a Frequency and Polarization Reconfigurable Slot Antenna with S-PINs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes the design of a frequency and polarization reconfigurable slot antenna with surface pins(S-PINs). The basic structure of the antenna is two perpendicular slots with S-PINs. The antenna can realize frequency reconfigurable and polarization reconfigurable, using four S-PINs. The simulated gain at the C and K band are 4.32dBi and 5.2dBi, at 5.76GHz and 18.072GHz, respectively. In this paper, the characteristics of the antenna are verified through simulation, and shows that it can be frequency reconfigurable and polarization reconfigurable.

articleTitle: A Compact Highly-Selective Planar Triple-band Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper present a compact and highly-selective planar triple-band bandpass filter. This filter consists of two pairs of quarter-wavelength short-circuited resonators and a dual-mode resonator. And one pair of short-circuited resonators is embedded in the other pair. The two pairs of short-circuited resonators form the first and second passband, and the dual-mode resonator which used to form the third passband. Moreover, due to the existence of hybrid electromagnetic coupling and source-load coupling, there is a transmission zero on both sides of each passband of the filter. At last, this filter is manufactured and measured, and the mensuration results agree well with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on scattering characteristics of antenna array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A new RCS reduction method for the antenna array is proposed. Previous works have shown that the radiation pattern function of an antenna array is equal to the array element radiation pattern function multiplying the radiation array factor. Similarly, scattering factor is used to express an important parameter for analyzing the scattering characteristics of antenna arrays. The expression equation of the scattering factor of several conventional arrays can be derived directly, and then the maximum scattering direction of the antenna array can be obtained. In order to prove the validation of the scattering factor, several arrays are simulated by integral equation method, and finally proposed the condition of non-scattering-grating-lobe.

articleTitle: On the Discontinuous Galerkin Integral Equation for Half-Space Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Aiming to the efficient electromagnetic scattering analysis from multiscale targets in half-space, the discontinuous Galerkin method is considered in this work. It is found that the widely used mixed-potential integral equation requires proper modifications in order to impose current continuity and zero charge accumulation conditions on the neighboring subdomain contours. Numerical examples and comparisons are carried out to demonstrate the accuracy, versatility, and flexibility of the discontinuous Galerkin scheme in half-space scattering problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Thermal and Electromagnetic Fields Coupling on Active Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The thermal and electromagnetic field coupling problem has been an important bottleneck for active array antennas. This paper analyzes the coupled muti-field effects on both the active devices and passive antenna. The influence of temperature on a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$12^{\ast}12$</tex> array has been simulated.

articleTitle: A Wide-Beamwidth Dual-polarized Printed Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The proposed dual-polarized antenna is formed of two printed dipoles excited by the integrated balun. By adding a metal rectangular patch between the dipole and the ground, the 3dB beam width is broadened from 96° to 126° at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\phi=0^{\circ}$</tex> plane and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\phi=90^{\circ}$</tex> plane when the proposed dual-polarized antenna operating in 3.3–3.6GHz, and the peak gain of the antenna is higher than 2.5dB. The impedance bandwidth of the antenna element is 3.26–4.56GHz <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{S}11 < - 10\ \text{dB})$</tex>, and the isolation between two ports is better than 25dB. The cross-polarization ratio of the proposed dual-polarized antenna operating at 3.4GHz is better than 24dB in the ±45° plane.

articleTitle: Four-Element UWB-MIMO Fractal Antenna with 8.5GHz Band-Notched Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, we have adopted the rectangular block with fractal characteristics and the antenna bandwidth has substantially extended. Besides, the U-slot were etched on the radiation unit to achieve the notch characteristic. We further adopt the four-element array to design the multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) antenna. The antenna size is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$65\times 50\text{mm}^{2}$</tex>. The simulation results show that the operating frequency of antenna is 1.3-14GHz, the maximum of isolation between radiation units is 50 dB. The proposed fractal antenna in this work is promising for UWB-MIMO antenna applications.

articleTitle: Electrically controlled tunable bandpass filter based on inner-rotary complementary split-ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A tunable bandpass filter is developed by utilizing the electrically controlled liquid crystal material. It consists of a half-mode substrate integrated waveguide (HMSIW) with liquid crystal material embedded into the substrate and a modified complementary split-ring resonator (CSRR). The modified CSRR is constituted by a conventional CSRR and two inner-rotary-shape slots. Compared with the conventional CSRR of same size, operation frequency of the proposed inner-rotary CSRR (IRCSRR) can operate at much lower frequency, which is conducive to the realization of circuitry miniaturization. In addition, owing to the load of the metal strip embedded in the substrate, the biasing voltage can be impressed to the liquid crystal more effectively. Numerical results show that by tuning the biasing voltage differently, center frequency of the proposed filter can be shifted from 0.86 GHz to 0.99 GHz, with an insertion loss in passband of 1.71 dB, a return loss better than 15 dB, and stopband suppression better than 40 dB.

articleTitle: Research on Plasma Electron Density Based on Emission Spectroscopy Calibrated by Probe
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Electron density is one of the important parameters of inductively coupled plasma. It is of great significance to study the distribution of electron density in inductively coupled plasma. It is difficult to measure the electron density and its distribution at any position of the cavity only by using emission spectroscopy or probe method. To solve this problem, the electron density of inductively coupled argon plasma is diagnosed by using probe calibrated emission spectroscopy. The feasibility of the proposed method was verified by studying the electron density distribution in the axial direction of the cavity. The electron density and its distribution can be diagnosed by using probe calibrated emission spectroscopy for plasma with little change in electron temperature.

articleTitle: Theoretical Simulation and Experimental Analysis of Electromagnetic Wave Propagation characteristics in Sub-dense Nonuniform Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this paper, reflection, absorption and transmission characteristics of 1-50GHz frequency electromagnetic wave by the sub-dense heterogeneous plasma are studied by combining theoretical modeling and simulation with ground experimental measurement.

articleTitle: Inertia Ratio Parameter Extraction of Typical Ballistic Target Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: This paper proposes a method based on deep learning to extract the inertia ratio parameter of typical ballistic targets. This method performs time-frequency analysis on the target's echoes to generate time-frequency distribution images and construct a dataset. Deep learning neural networks are training to extract the inertia ratio parameter corresponding to different time-frequency distribution images accurately. The results of experiments demonstrate that the extraction error of inertia ratio is lower than 5% when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SNR} \geq 6\text{dB}$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Passive Shaped Beam Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: We present a novel method for passive shaped beam synthesis. This method utilizes the pattern reconfigurable Dielectric Resonator Antenna (DRA) for passive shaped beam synthesis. Compared with the conventional shaped beam synthesis of the base station antenna, it saves the base station power by avoiding the use of active element to shape the patterns with deep nulls and peaks for interference and users respectively. The low-cost artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) is utilized for synthesizing shaped beams to match the desired user patterns. Performance evaluation of the prototyped antenna array is verified to cover the desired users and avoid the interference.

articleTitle: Programmable Digital-coding-feeding Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Metasurfaces, which could control electromagnetic (EM) waves in different characteristics by arranging the artificial micro-structures on a flat interface. In recent years, programmable metasurface is introduced to control the EM waves with multi-function. Here, we propose a programmable digital-coding-feeding metasurface (PDCF-MS) with control circuits to digitally simultaneously manipulate the incident EM waves and radiate the EM waves as an antenna. The multifunction of linearly and circularly polarized conversion, scattering manipulation, radiation and orbit angular momentum (OAM) generation has been comprehensively investigated using PDCF-MS. The presented PDCF-MS with the low profile and power-efficient advantages opens up avenues to realize more advanced multifunctional micro-devices and micro-systems.

articleTitle: Radiation pattern design of Perovskite light-emitting diodes by nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) are drawing great interest due to its promising applications in both high-quality display and lighting. The incorporations of nanostructures into the device have widely used to enhance the light extraction efficiency (LEE). Besides, the spatial emission pattern of PeLEDs can also be modified, which is useful in a range of scientific and industrial applications. Herein, we studied the characteristics of PeLEDs with incorporation of perovskite or Ag nanogratings into electron transport layer with finite difference-time domain (FDTD) numerical simulation method. The results clearly demonstrated that the LEE has enhanced more than three times compared with conventional planar PeLEDs. We further found that the horizontal location of emission source can greatly manipulate the radiation pattern of Ag patterned PeLEDs. The results suggest that the employment of nanostructures opens the possibility of controlling emission light. Moreover, the findings shown here will be useful to performance enhancement of other optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Fast RCS Optimization of Ship Superstructure Based on Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: To reduce the calculation cost of target's radar cross section (RCS) optimization, Kriging surrogate model was used to simulate electromagnetic scattering characteristics in the optimization process. Taking a typical warship superstructure as the optimization object, adaptive genetic algorithm (AGA) and Kriging-AGA algorithm were used for RCS optimization respectively. The optimal stealth design of the superstructure under typical radar parameters was obtained. The results indicate that Kriging surrogate model can reduce the number of electromagnetic calculations by 40%, and thus can greatly improve the optimization efficiency.

articleTitle: Space-Frequency Domain Non-blind Method For Wideband Electromagnetic Imaging Restoration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: Though the wideband electromagnetic imaging system meets the needs of rapid detection of large scale and broadband EMI sources, image blur and low spatial resolution still exist. In this paper, we study space-frequency characteristics and estimate accurate iteration function to optimize non-blind super-resolution. System simulations in wideband and large-scale demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Field-circuit simulation based on parallel FDTD-SPICE method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: In this work, we study the simulation effect of FDTD Method in microwave circuit. The microwave circuit is divided multiple Yee cells, then we can get the relevant parameters through parallel computation and sent they into SPICE for simulation. The numerical example shows that the proposed method has a higher speed than the common SPICE simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Discontinous Galerkin Method for the DC IR-Drop Analysis of Power Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A Robin transmission condition (RTC) enhanced discontinuous Galerkin method (DGM) is proposed for direct current IR-Drop analysis of global PDN. Although DGM is one kind of domain decomposition method (DDM) naturally, it suffers much more number of unknowns compared with finite element method (FEM). To overcome this drawback, RTC is introduced to serve as a transmission condition apart from the numerical flux. As a result, the volume unknowns appeared in traditional DG method is elegantly transferred to the interface among neighboring subdomains. Thus, the DoFs are markedly reduced. To validate the proposed method, a representative numerical result is presented at the last of this paper.

articleTitle: Surface Acoustic Scattering Based on the Small Slope Approximation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study the acoustic scattering characteristics of a one-dimensional random undulating interface based on the PM wind wave spectrum. The small slope approximation method is currently a more commonly used method for calculating sea surface acoustic scattering. This method is very effective in calculating the acoustic scattering of rough surfaces under the condition that the glancing angle of the incident angle is not particularly small and the surface slope is not particularly large. Therefore, this paper uses a small slope approximation method to calculate the scattering intensity of a one-dimensional random undulating interface. Moreover, most of the current researches on sea surface acoustic scattering use Gaussian spectrum, which does not conform to the real sea surface. Scientists have done many studies on real ocean waves and proposed several more mature ocean spectra. Therefore, this paper adopts the PM wind wave spectrum, uses its statistical characteristics and the small slope approximation method to analyze its variation with the scattering angle and incident frequency. The results show that as the scattering angle gets closer to the direction of specular scattering, the intensity of scattering gradually increases, and reaches the maximum in the direction of specular scattering. As the incident frequency increases, the scattering intensity in the forward scattering direction first increases and then stabilizes, and the scattering intensity in the backward scattering direction first increases and then fluctuates around the same value. The research results are of great significance to the development of underwater acoustic technology and sonar technology.

articleTitle: Fast Analyzing Bistatic Scattering Problems of Object Using Higher Level Characteristic Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society (ACES-China) Symposium
abstract: A higher level characteristic modes construction method is proposed for analyzing the bistatic scattering problems of PEC target. In this approach, the higher level characteristic modes (HCMs) are constructed by considering the mutual couplings effects with other blocks. Using these HCMs, the reduced matrix is constructed. The size of the reduced matrix is decreased compared with the traditional MoM matrix. Under such circumstances, the time of matrix equation solution is significantly reduced. Numerical example verify and demonstrate that the proposed method is more effective than the conventional MoM method.
